scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Wow! Thanks a lot!
I don't know how this happened to our ship
but we should go to see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
哇！太感謝了！
我不知道我們的船是怎麼變成這樣的，
但我們得去找船長看看。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
... ohh, it seems my body is too injured.
Maybe you can go without me?
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
...噢，看來我傷得太重了。
也許你可以先走，不用管我？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
NPC Quest Received.
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 資訊 -!^000000
已接受NPC任務。
^4d4dff任務資訊快捷鍵是 Alt + U^000000
您可以隨時在那裡檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Luckily the water has not entered the ship.
I will wait here, you should go see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
幸好海水沒有灌進船艙。
我會在這裡等著，您應該去見見船長。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
I'm fine! I'm fine!
Don't worry about me, you should really go to the captain!
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
我沒事！我沒事！
別擔心我，您真的應該去找船長！

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 資訊 -!^000000
^4d4dff任務資訊快捷鍵是 Alt + U^000000
您可以隨時在那裡檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are still people in the cabins?!
At least you are safe.
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
船艙裡還有人嗎？！
至少你們還安全。
你們沒事吧？

scripts.text: I'm alright, but others need help.
scripts.translation: 我沒事，但其他人需要幫助。

scripts.text: I think I am the last?
scripts.translation: 我想我是最後一個？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are more people left?
I will send a rescue team to them.
Thank you for your report.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
還有其他人沒出來？
我會派救援隊去接他們。
謝謝你的報告。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Alright, that's good.
The storm came unexpectedly but I never thought it would hit us that hard.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
很好，那就好。
這場風暴來得很突然，但我沒想到它會這麼猛烈地襲擊我們。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
At least most people made it to safety.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
至少大多數人已經安全了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Look at the trees there, ^4d4dfffollow them to the southwest^000000 to find a new ship.
The ship will take you to ^4d4dffIzlude^000000, our original destination.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
看看那邊的樹，^4d4dff沿著它們向西南方向走^000000就能找到一艘新船。
那艘船會帶你去^4d4dff依斯魯得島^000000，也就是我們原本的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Ah! Speaking of it, those ^4d4dffPorings^000000 on this island drop several materials we could use for repairs.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
啊！說到這個，島上的那些^4d4dff波利^000000會掉落一些我們可以用來修船的材料。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffKill the Porings and bring 2 Lumbers to the southern crew^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
^4d4dff擊敗波利，並帶2根木材給南邊的船員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
It is a hard task, but you look tough enough.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
這是個艱鉅的任務，但看起來你足夠強壯。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Speaking of Porings, you have to equip your gears.
You should have a ^4d4dffweapon and an armor^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
說到波利，你得裝備好你的武器。
你應該已經^4d4dff裝備了武器和防具^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffYou can equip gear or use items by simply double clicking them.
The item window can be opened by pressing Alt + E or using the menu button.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff只需雙擊物品即可裝備或使用。
按 Alt + E 或使用選單按鈕可以開啟物品視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffEquipped Items can be seen by pressing Alt + Q.
Either double click or drag & drop to equip or unequip them.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以檢視已裝備的物品。
雙擊或拖放即可裝備或卸下物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
Did you check all your equipment?
^4d4dffSkill distribution^000000 should be done.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
你檢查好所有裝備了嗎？
^4d4dff技能分配^000000應該已經完成了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
For a smooth battle, you have to distribute your abilities properly.
^4d4dffIf you want to increase your strength, you need to raise Str^000000. ^4d4dffIf you want to increase your hit, you must raise Dex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
為了戰鬥順利，你需要合理分配能力值。
^4d4dff如果想提升力量，你需要增加Str^000000。^4d4dff如果想提升命中率，你需要增加Dex^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffThe Ship^000000 is anchored in the southwest. It will take you to Izlude.
Don't forget to ^4d4dffget some Lumber^000000 for the ship.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
^4d4dff船^000000停泊在西南方，它將帶你前往依斯魯得島。
別忘了為船準備一些^4d4dff木材^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Don't forget to raise your ^4d4dffskills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
別忘了提升你的^4d4dff技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Everything is ready to sail over to Izlude.
The ship is located at the south-western part of the island.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
前往依斯魯得島的一切準備都就緒了。
船位於島嶼的西南部。

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffYou get a stats bonus for every level you raise.
The status window can be opened and closed with the shortcut Alt + A^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 資訊 -!
^4d4dff每提升一級，你都會獲得屬性加成。
按 Alt + A 可以開啟或關閉屬性視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffPlease properly allocate the stats you need to battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 資訊 -!
^4d4dff請合理分配戰鬥所需的屬性值^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Kill Porings and bring the Lumber to the crew.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
擊敗波利，並將木材交給船員。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Had a good dream?
Soon, we will get to Izlude. And you can talk to other people like you just talked to me.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
做了個好夢？
很快我們就會到達依斯魯得島。到時候你可以像剛才和我說話一樣，和其他人交談。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I think that guy over there lost his memory. I gave him a new name.
Lumin.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
我覺得那邊那位先生失去了記憶。我給他起了個新名字。
盧敏。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Many youngsters visit the ^4d4dffRune-Midgarts Kingdom^000000 to chase their dreams.
Izlude is a satellite city of Prontera, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
許多年輕人來到^4d4dff盧恩·米德加茲王國^000000追尋夢想。
依斯魯得島是盧恩·米德加茲王國首都普隆德拉的衛星城。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Izlude always welcomes young adventurers like you who have just started their journey through the world.
You are one of them, of course.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
依斯魯得島永遠歡迎像你這樣剛剛踏上世界旅程的年輕冒險者。
你也是其中之一，當然。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I would like to tell you more stories, but it's time to get ready for arrival.
There is an academy in Izlude for newcomers like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
我想給你講更多故事，但現在是準備靠岸的時候了。
依斯魯得島有一所學院，專門接待像你這樣的新人。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Let me give you more details later. See you back at the harbor deck.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
稍後我再給你詳細介紹。在甲板見。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
To get off this ship, you should enter the ^4d4dffShining Portal^000000 over there.
All transportation is made through the portals.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
要下船，你應該進入那邊的^4d4dff閃耀傳送門^000000。
所有的交通都是通過傳送門進行的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
是的。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Oh boy.
What a cute reaction.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
哎呀。
真是可愛的反應。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.....
Should I introduce myself?
scripts.translation: 我要自我介紹嗎？

scripts.text: My name is ~!
scripts.translation: 我的名字是~！

scripts.text: - Lu just walked away with a cynical look on his face.
scripts.translation: - 盧一臉不屑地走開了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Looks like... he has a shy personality.
When you go to Izlude, will you check on him?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
看來...他是個害羞的性格。
你去依斯魯得島的時候，能順便去看看他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
From now on I'll be sailing the ship around the island.
Let's go, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
從現在開始，我要駕船繞島航行了。
我們出發吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
These Porings stole my materials to repair the ship. Can you help me to get them back?
There are plenty of Porings on this island.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
這些波利偷走了我修船的材料。你能幫我拿回來嗎？
島上有很多波利。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
I would really appreciate it if you help me.
I am not allowed to set foot on this island.
That's why I ask for your help~
scripts.translation:
[水手]
如果你能幫我就太好了。
我不被允許踏上這座島。
所以才拜託你幫忙~

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Unbelievable, perfect! Any chance you want to join my crew?
Enough talking!!
Come on, we're ready to set sail!
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
難以置信，太完美了！有沒有興趣加入我的船員？
別廢話了！！
快上船，我們要出發了！
非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
If you want to sail with us to Izlude, jump on board!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
如果你想和我們一起去依斯魯得島，就跳上船吧！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Oh, and take these ^4d4dffMagnifiers^000000.
When you hunt monsters you can find ^4d4dffunidentified items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
哦，還有這些^4d4dff放大鏡^000000。
打怪的時候可以撿到^4d4dff未鑑定物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Using a Magnifier will identify the item.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
使用放大鏡可以鑑定物品。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Maybe you already have some unidentified items from your fights with those Porings?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
也許你在和那些波利戰鬥時已經撿到了一些未鑑定物品？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
The ship is heading to Izlude soon~!
I'll let you know when we set sail~!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
船很快就要開往依斯魯得島了~！
出發的時候我會通知你的~！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Why are you here at the wharf?
I guess you are doing well at the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
你怎麼在碼頭？
看來你在學院過得不錯嘛。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'm going to be docking and reparing the ship here for a while.
I will be taking the same route I tried before.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我要在這裡停靠一段時間，修理船隻。
我會走之前嘗試過的那條航線。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You must be a student of the Criatura Academy?
Were you on my ship?
Hmm I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你是克里阿圖拉學院的學生嗎？
你在我船上嗎？
嗯，我想不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Well, anything is fine.
Shall I go easy on you since you said you were a student of the Academy?
I am still the captain of the ship, regardless.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好吧，沒關係。
既然你說你是學院的學生，我就對你客氣點吧？
不過，我依然是這艘船的船長。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I plan on taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
The route will open with ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000 by then.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
修好後我就立刻出發。
到時候航線會通往^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔島^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
This is Izlude.
The best city for you to take wings to your dreams.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
這裡是依斯魯得島。
這裡是讓你夢想展翅高飛的最佳城市。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Although I don't have any particular feelings for you,
I've seen a lot of young people like you, while operating the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
雖然我對您並沒有特別的感情，
但在經營這條航線期間，我見過很多像您這樣的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There were those among them who succeeded and failed and went back after being unable to adjust.
I want you to have a successful start with this place.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他們中有人成功，有人失敗，也有人因為無法適應而離開了。
我希望您能在這裡有一個好的開始。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Did you know this?
Izlude has a new Institute for budding adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
您知道嗎？
依斯魯得島為像您這樣剛起步的冒險者設立了一所新的學院！

scripts.text: You mean the Academy?
scripts.translation: 您是指學院嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Yes! It's called the ^4d4dffRoyal Criatura Academy^000000.
Founded by the Rune-Midgarts lineage to help out new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
沒錯！它叫^4d4dff皇家克里阿圖拉學院^000000。
由盧恩·米德加茲王室創立，旨在幫助新晉冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
He could make a lot of things easier for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的一位朋友在那裡工作，我會為您引薦給他。
他能讓很多事情變得更簡單。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He usually talks to new adventurers near the entrance of the academy.
Go and meet him there.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常會在學院入口附近與新冒險者交談。
請去那裡見他。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his spot on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他的名字是^4d4dff洪^000000
我會在地圖上標記他的位置，請去見他。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
The ^4d4dffMini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
您可以使用+放大，-縮小。NPC標記的路點會顯示在地圖上。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
The quest content can be checked from the quest window.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
您已接受來自^4d4dff船長 卡洛克的任務。
您可以在任務視窗中檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 keys together.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
同時按下^4d4dffAlt + u^000000鍵即可開啟任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says 'Hun'.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果您需要更多地圖幫助，請按<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>這裡
是的，就是寫著“洪”的那部分。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffThe icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中的圖示<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>表示導航指引連結。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with the navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
如果您在目標中選擇任務後按下資訊^4d4dff，
將會彈出一個指向目標位置的箭頭，並附帶導航幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it can help you for your future.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫您辦理學院的註冊手續。
希望這能對您的未來有所幫助。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道您說的是誰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就放心了。
他會向您介紹學院的情況。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好的。我會為您指引方向。您再試一次。
順便問一下，我告訴過您他的名字嗎？他的名字是^4d4dff洪^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
您可以使用+放大，-縮小。NPC標記的路點會顯示在地圖上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果您需要更多地圖幫助，請按<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>這裡
是的，就是寫著[洪]的那部分。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中出現的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 代表
導航指引連結。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標^4d4dff中選擇任務後按下“資訊”，
將顯示指向目標位置的箭頭及導航輔助

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這能對你的旅程有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你願意，現在就可以踏入世界了。
不過，我建議你先去一趟學院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you can make as lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
獨自一人在世界上會很孤獨。
學院裡有可以成為你終身夥伴的人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend Hun will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友洪會在學院入口附近。
如果你找不到路，我會再給你指一次。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says ''Hun''.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你需要更多地圖幫助，請按 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 這裡
是的，就是寫著“洪”的那部分。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中出現的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 代表
導航指引連結。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標^4d4dff中選擇任務後按下“資訊”，
將顯示指向目標位置的箭頭及導航輔助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy.
I hope it will help you out in your journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這能對你的旅程有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Still being dilligent?
I've been busy, also.
I was reparing the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
還在這麼勤勉嗎？
我也很忙。
我在修船。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'll be taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
At that time, the sailing route to ^4d4dffPharos lighthouse ^000000will be opened.
Be excited for it.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
修好後我就出發了。
屆時，前往 ^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔島^000000 的航線將會開放。
敬請期待吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hello?
Is it your first time on Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你好？
你是第一次來依斯魯得島嗎？

scripts.text: Hello?
scripts.translation: 你好？

scripts.text: Let me get on the ship!
scripts.translation: 讓我上船！

scripts.text: I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation: 我不知道該做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
You look strong and able!
I like able people like you!
Always be healthy and strong as you are now.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你看起來很強壯能幹！
我喜歡像你這樣能幹的人！
請一直保持現在的健康與強壯。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I usually travel to ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000.
But I'm resting up due to some problems.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我通常前往 ^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔島^000000。
但因為一些問題，我正在休整。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If it's Alberta or Byalan Island, talk to the next sailor.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果是去艾爾貝塔或拜蘭島，請找下一位水手。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You said you didn't know what to do.
Since you're at Izlude, why don't you visit ^4d4dffCriatura Academy^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你說你不知道該做什麼。
既然你在依斯魯得島，為什麼不去看看 ^4d4dff克里阿圖拉學院^000000 呢？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Izlude has the Institute for budding adventurers like you
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
依斯魯得島有針對像你這樣初出茅廬的冒險者的學院。
我的一位朋友在那裡工作，我會把你介紹給他。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He ususally talks to new adventurers near the entrance of an academy.
Go and meet him personally.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常在學院入口附近與新的冒險者交談。
去親自見見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his location on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他的名字是 ^4d4dff洪^000000
我會在地圖上標記他的位置，所以去見見他吧。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
您可以使用+放大，-縮小。NPC標記的路點會顯示在地圖上。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
Contents of your Quest can be monitored on the Quest information window.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
接取了來自^4d4dff船長 卡洛克的任務。
您可以在任務資訊視窗中檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 key.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
按下 ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 鍵即可開啟委託視窗。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這能對你的旅程有所幫助。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道您說的是誰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就放心了。
他會向您介紹學院的情況。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好的。我會為您指引方向。您再試一次。
順便問一下，我告訴過您他的名字嗎？他的名字是^4d4dff洪^000000

scripts.translation:

總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Ah, it's you.
This guy has also decided to register at Criatura Academy.
This might be a good destiny for you. Hope you and him can be good friends.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
啊，是你啊。
這傢伙也決定在克里阿圖拉學院註冊了。
這或許是你命中註定的緣分。希望你們能成為好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你願意，現在就可以踏入世界了。
不過，我建議你先去一趟學院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you could make into lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
獨自一人在這個世界上是很孤獨的。
學院裡有可以成為你終身夥伴的人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 會在學院入口附近。
如果你不知道路，我會再給你指一次路。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
then, Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那麼，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, We meet again.
Do you by any chance need a ship?
I usually travel to the port in Paros.
If you need to go to Paros later, come see me.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，我們又見面了。
你難道需要船嗎？
我通常前往帕羅斯的港口。
如果你之後需要去帕羅斯，來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
It's been a while!
Looking at your expression, you must be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好久不見！
看你的表情，你過得一定很好。

scripts.text: Take me to Pharos Lighthouse
scripts.translation: 去發樂斯燈塔島

scripts.text: To Alberta
scripts.translation: 去艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Do you want to go to Pharos Lighthouse on the southern coast of Morocc?
The fee is 2800 zeny. I have a crew that needs payment so this fee is non-negotiable.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你想去摩洛克南海岸的發樂斯燈塔島嗎？
費用是2800 Zeny。我有一支需要支付工資的船員，所以這個費用不能商量。

scripts.text: To Pharos Lighthouse!
scripts.translation: 去發樂斯燈塔島！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wing in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
讓我們帶著翅膀在髮間飛舞，一起航行吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的登船費不足。
我需要2800 Zeny來運營。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK.
Do you know this, by the way?
^4d4dffThere's a Rogue hideout at Pharos Lighthouse^000000.
You already knew this?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好的。
順便問一下，你知道這個嗎？
^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔島有一個流氓據點^000000。
你已經知道了？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I thought you knew that I only go to Pharos?
Ask the sailor over there, he's the one that goes there frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我以為你知道我只去發樂斯嗎？
問問那邊的水手，他經常去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There are plenty of other ships that travel to Alberta and Byalan Islands.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
有很多其他船隻往返於艾爾貝塔和拜蘭島。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm. I'm content with the well being of you and other adventurers who passed me by.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯。看到你和其他冒險者安然無恙地從我身邊經過，我很欣慰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Lumin must be doing well too.
I wonder why you feel like my own child even though we've only met from the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
盧敏應該也過得很不錯吧。
雖然我們只在海上見過一面，但我總覺得你像我的孩子一樣。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I am Carocc, the caption of this ship.
Do you need a ship?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我是卡洛克，這艘船的船長。
你需要搭船嗎？

scripts.text: Pharos Lighthouse - 2800z
scripts.translation: 發樂斯燈塔島 - 2800z

scripts.text: Don't need it.
scripts.translation: 不需要

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wind in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
讓我們迎著風，揚帆起航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的登船費不足。
我需要2800 Zeny來運營。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那下次再來吧。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Continue the quest after organizing the inventory.
scripts.translation:
由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。
請整理物品欄後繼續任務。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Oh.. you must be the adventurer Carocc was talking about.
I don't know where your homeland is but Midgard is a good place to start your life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
哦...你就是卡洛克提到的那位冒險者吧。
我不知道你的故鄉在哪裡，但米德加爾特是開始人生旅程的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's a good sight to see new adventurers start their journey.
You must be tired. Need a drink?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒險者開始旅程，真是令人高興的景象。
你一定累了吧。需要喝點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
You can open the Item window by clicking on the 'item' icon on top left portion of the screen.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
點選螢幕左上角的“物品”圖示，即可開啟物品視窗。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品會自動分類為“消耗品”、“裝備”、“其他”和“個人物品”，以便於使用。
系統會根據用途自動排序...

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff雙擊^000000你想使用的物品，
或者將其^4d4dff拖拽到裝備視窗^000000進行裝備。

scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff雙擊物品即可使用或裝備。
快捷鍵 Alt+E 可開啟物品視窗。

[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right click ^000000on that item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
若需檢視單個物品的詳細資訊，^4d4dff右鍵點選^000000該物品即可。
你可以檢視物品的詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffRight-clicking on the item icon^4d4dff  brings up detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff右鍵點選物品圖示^4d4dff 可檢視該物品的詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffWhen you select other players, you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff選中其他玩家時，會彈出社群視窗，你可以與他們交易或組隊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，現在^4d4dff喝掉我給你的蘋果汁^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Hey there.
Rest up for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
嘿。
休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's joyous to see new adventurers starting out.
You want something to drink while you are resting?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒險者開始旅程，真是令人高興。
休息的時候，想喝點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Right clicking on the item icon ^4d4dffon the basic item window at the upper left corner brings up the detailed info on the item
scripts.translation:
[洪]
在左上角的基礎物品視窗中，^4d4dff右鍵點選物品圖示即可檢視該物品的詳細資訊。

[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the invenory being full.
Please try it again after re-organizing your items.
scripts.translation:
由於背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
請整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Hi, how are you?
I am in charge of navigation directions for Izlude's key locations
I wish to propose a simple game along with the navigation, would that be ok?
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
你好，最近怎麼樣？
我負責依斯魯得島主要地點的導航指引。
我想提議在導航的同時玩一個簡單的遊戲，可以嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, let's play!
scripts.translation: 好的，我們玩吧！

scripts.text: I already know them all.
scripts.translation: 我全都知道了。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
First of all, how to check the mini-map.
You can check your location through the mini-map at the top right of the screen
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
首先，如何檢視小地圖。
您可以通過螢幕右上角的小地圖檢視您的位置。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
If you receive information on a town or a city, a waypoint ^4d4dff+^000000 can be marked on the map.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
如果您獲得城鎮或城市的資訊，可以在地圖上標記^4d4dff+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Press ^4d4dff[Ctrl] and [ ~ ] on your keyboard and you can see the world map^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
按下鍵盤上的^4d4dff[Ctrl]和[ ~ ]，您就可以看到世界地圖^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Through the ^4d4dffworld map you can check the location of you, your party members and the level of monsters in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
通過^4d4dff世界地圖，您可以檢視您、隊伍成員的位置以及該區域魔物的等級。^000000

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
This is useful info to remember.
Now then, should we play a simple game?
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
這是值得記住的有用資訊。
那麼，我們要不要玩一個簡單的遊戲？

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
I will ^4d4dffmark three specific locations on the mini-map.^000000
Please ^4d4dffvisit those locations ^000000using the waypoints as reference.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
我會在小地圖上標記^4d4dff三個特定位置^000000。
請以這些標記為參考，^4d4dff前往這些地點^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Think of it as a treasure hunt and go.
I've hidden some useful items there.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
把它當作一場尋寶遊戲去吧。
我在那裡藏了一些有用的物品。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Vist me again after going by all three locations.
I will check up on it.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
在訪問完所有三個地點後，請再次來找我。
我會檢查你的進度。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Ah, there' somebody who started out right before you!
If you don't hurry that person will take all the items!
So, run!
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
啊，有個人在你之前剛剛出發！
如果你不快點，那個人會把所有物品都拿走的！
所以，快跑！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
==== 飛空艇資訊====
依斯魯得島 - 朱諾 - 拉赫
前往^4d4dff施瓦茨瓦爾德共和國^000000或^4d4dff阿魯納菲茲^000000的旅客可在此搭乘飛空艇。

scripts.text: Except the signboard of the free airship, nothing can be found.
scripts.translation: 除了免費飛空艇的指示牌外，什麼也找不到。

scripts.text: Where's the hidden treasure?
scripts.translation: 隱藏的寶物在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yo.
Sorry pal I got here first.
Should've used a Fly wing like I did.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
喲。
抱歉啊，我比你先到。
你應該像我一樣用蒼蠅翅膀的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Why do these wings teleport?
I guess because they're from Creamy monsters...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
為什麼這些翅膀能瞬間移動？
我想大概是因為它們來自克瑞米吧...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
As the captain said, seeing is believing. The world is full of mysteries.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
正如船長所說，眼見為實。這個世界充滿了神秘。

scripts.text:
Seems like Lumin beat you again.
Better get to the next location before Lumin does.
scripts.translation:
看來盧敏又贏了你。
趕在盧敏之前到達下一個地點吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Muahahahaha.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
穆哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧？！

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?
scripts.translation: 寶物在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
No...
Meeting three times in one day must be destiny.
You and I can be friends.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不...
一天之內相遇三次，一定是命運。
我們可以成為朋友。

scripts.text: Or Frenemies!
scripts.translation: 或者是亦敵亦友！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Frene-what? Oh well I'm done with the mission.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
亦敵...什麼？算了，我的任務結束了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底有沒有在聽我說話？！

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report the result to the Information Staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向諮詢人員彙報結果...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ooo Butterfly Wings.
If I hand it over to you, you'll just waste 'em so I'll just keep them.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
噢，蝴蝶翅膀。
如果交給你，你只會浪費掉，所以我還是自己留著吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Come on this is just friendly competition.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
拜託了，這只是友好的競爭而已。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I am doing this for you to make you stronger.
Now, so long.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我這麼做是為了讓你變得更強。
那麼，再見了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report the result to the Information staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向諮詢人員彙報結果...^000000。

scripts.text: Except for the signboard of the free airship, nothing particular was found.
scripts.translation: 除了免費飛空艇的指示牌外，什麼特別的東西也沒找到。

scripts.text: Why is there nothing here?
scripts.translation: 為什麼這裡什麼都沒有？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Of course.
I already packed it in my bag.
There were Butterfly Wings here.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
當然。
我已經把它裝進包裡了。
這裡有蝴蝶翅膀。

scripts.text: So can I have some?
scripts.translation: 那能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's not fair, I was here first so they're mine.
You better get to the next stop faster if you want the prize.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
這不公平，我先來的，所以是我的。
如果你想要獎品，最好快點趕到下一站。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Well, then.....

Lumin disappeared with his long hair in the air.
......
scripts.translation:
盧敏帶著飄逸的長髮消失了。
......

There were potions here...

這裡有藥水...
我等得有點煩了，所以也拿了一些。

Oh well looks like it's all gone.
scripts.translation:

但這藥水為什麼喝不完呢？
*咕咚*
算了，看起來都喝光了。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
No...
Meeting three times in one day must be destiny.
You and I can be friends.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不...
一天之內相遇三次，一定是命運。
我們可以成為朋友。

scripts.text: Or Frenemies!
scripts.translation: 或者是亦敵亦友！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Frene-what? Oh well I'm done with the mission.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
亦敵...什麼？算了，我的任務結束了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底有沒有在聽我說話？！

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report the result to the Information Staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向諮詢人員彙報結果...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Red potions.
If I hand it over to you, you'll just waste 'em so I'll just keep them.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
紅色藥水。
如果交給你，你只會浪費掉，所以我還是自己留著吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Come on this is just friendly competition.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
拜託了，這只是友好的競爭而已。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I am doing this for you to make you stronger.
Now, so long.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我這麼做是為了讓你變得更強。
那麼，再見了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report of the result to Information staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向諮詢人員彙報結果...^000000。

scripts.text: Except for the Arena promotion signboard, nothing can be found.
scripts.translation: 除了競技場的宣傳指示牌外，什麼特別的東西也沒找到。

scripts.text: Why is there nothing?
scripts.translation: 為什麼什麼都沒有？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Of course.
I already packed it.
There were Red Potion hidden here.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
當然。
我已經裝好了。
這裡藏著紅色藥水。

scripts.text: So can I have some?
scripts.translation: 那能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's not fair, I was here first so they're mine.
You better get to the next stop faster if you want the prize.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
這不公平，我先來的，所以是我的。
如果你想要獎品，最好快點趕到下一站。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Well, then.....

Lumin disappeared with his long hair in the air.
This guy...
scripts.translation:
盧敏帶著飄逸的長髮消失了。
這傢伙...

scripts.text:
== Challenge! Arena! ==
Breath taking battle with monsters!
Where is your limit?
PvE party with your comrad!
All these at Arena!!
scripts.translation:
== 挑戰！競技場！ ==
與魔物進行驚心動魄的戰鬥！
你的極限在哪裡？
與夥伴組隊進行PvE戰鬥！
這一切都在競技場！！

Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:

普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位於北方。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found here.

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yo.
Sorry but I am quicker than you.
There were Fly Wings here..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
喲。
抱歉，我比你快了一步。
這裡本來有蒼蠅翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
In fact, I don't like Fly's wings.
Flies are so dirty.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
其實，我不喜歡蒼蠅翅膀。
蒼蠅太髒了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
By the way, why is one of the convenient transportations fly wing shaped?
Perhaps you know?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
順便問一下，為什麼一種便捷的交通工具是蒼蠅翅膀形狀的？
也許你知道？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...you don't know.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...你不知道。

scripts.text:
Defeated by Lumin again.
Keep calm and find the next location.
scripts.translation:
再次敗給了盧敏。
保持冷靜，尋找下一個地點。

scripts.text:

...Hello
scripts.translation:

...你好

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 資訊 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位於北方。

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 資訊 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城市位於北方。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you a student?
Do you have any problem in your body?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你是學生嗎？
身體有什麼不舒服嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the dispensary of the Royal Criatura Academy.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這裡是皇家克里阿圖拉學院的醫務室。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you injured?
Even the emergency treatment didn't work for you?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你受傷了嗎？
連緊急治療都對你無效嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Is that good enough?
Have you recovered?
If you are sane, go to bed and rest before you go.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這樣好點了嗎？
恢復了嗎？
如果你神志清醒，出門前先去床上休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I feel sorry for you but...
I can only give my free healing service to those under base level 20.
You don't look like you're going to die anyways.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
我很同情你，但是...
我只能為基礎等級20以下的學生提供免費治療服務。
而且你看起來也不像會死的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Just take a rest here until you've recovered.
There are lots of vacant beds!
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
就在這裡休息直到你恢復為止。
還有很多空床位！

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You already know about First Aid.
We both are busy. Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你已經知道緊急治療了。
我們都很忙，別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You are commendable!
First Aid is a skill that transfers SP to HP during emergency situations.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你值得稱讚！
緊急治療是在緊急情況下將SP轉化為HP的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Recovery ratio is very minimal...
It can help you avoid dying but won't give you much HP.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
恢復比例非常微小...
它能幫你避免死亡，但不會給你太多HP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Press ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 to open your Skill window to see your skills.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
按下 ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 開啟技能視窗，檢視你的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you press ^4d4dffF12^000000...
The shortcut window will open up with nine small compartments to register your skills to.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
按下 ^4d4dffF12^000000...
會開啟快捷欄視窗，裡面有9個格子可以註冊技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Dragging the right hand corner at the shortcut window, you can open up more skill shortcut pages.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
拖動快捷欄視窗右下角，可以開啟更多技能快捷頁。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
It is a simple use.. ^4d4dffEach slot responds to individual keys from F1 to F9^000000.
Needed skills or items can be immediately used after registering on the corresponding slots.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
用法很簡單.. ^4d4dff每個格子對應F1到F9的獨立按鍵^000000。
將需要的技能或物品註冊到對應格子後，即可立即使用。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
You can register needed items or skills at ^4d4dffshortcut slots by dragging the icons.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
您可以將所需的物品或技能圖示拖拽到^4d4dff快捷欄中進行註冊。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff The registered items and equipment at^4d4dff the slots can be immediately used or armed by pressing the reponding F1 - F9 keys.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff 註冊在格子中的物品和裝備^4d4dff 可以通過按下對應的F1 - F9鍵立即使用或裝備。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
By setting the ^4d4dffshortcut keys as you want, you can use the responding shortcut key.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
您可以按照自己的喜好設定^4d4dff快捷鍵，然後使用對應的快捷鍵。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffyou may register the frequently using items and skills, and use them at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff您可以註冊經常使用的物品和技能，並方便地使用它們。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now open the skill window and register [First Aid] as shortcut key, then use it.
You will find it is more covenient to use this way.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
現在開啟技能視窗，將 [緊急治療] 註冊為快捷鍵，然後使用它。
你會發現這樣使用更方便。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Have you investigated the growing plants in the field?
^4d4dff Red Plant, Blue Plant, Green Plant, White Plant^000000etc..
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你調查過田裡生長的植物嗎？
^4d4dff 紅草、藍草、綠草、白草^000000等等。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can get different colored herbs from the various plants.
Processing herbs turns to be a various useful potions.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你可以從不同的植物中獲得不同顏色的藥草。
加工藥草可以製成各種有用的藥水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now, shall we collect the Red Herb with your hands?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
現在，我們要用手採集紅色藥草嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
A ^4d4dffRed Plant is growing near the academy building.^000000.
I secretly planted it for today.
Go and get ^4d4dff1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff學院建築附近長著一株紅草。^000000
我為了今天特意種下的。
去採集 ^4d4dff1個紅色藥草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You got it.
^4d4dffYou could eat this herb and get the benefit of it immediately but it will be more efficient if you make it into a potion.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你拿到了。
^4d4dff你可以直接吃掉這個藥草立即獲得效果，但製成藥水會更有效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Herbs vary their virtues according to their color.
^4d4dffGreen Herbs^000000 detox you.
^4d4dffBlue Herbs^000000 recover your SP.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
藥草的功效因顏色而異。
^4d4dff綠色藥草^000000 可以解毒。
^4d4dff藍色藥草^000000 可以恢復SP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Any other?
Well, HP is recovering like this red herb.
This like this... Make a nectar and put it into a bottle....
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
還有其他嗎？
嗯，HP恢復就像這個紅色藥草一樣。
就像這樣... 製成糖漿並裝進瓶子裡....

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This becomes the recovering potion possible to take anywhere, anytime.
I will give it to you as souvenir.
And also give you the recipe to make potions easily.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這就變成了可以隨時隨地攜帶的恢復藥水。
我把它作為紀念品送給你。
同時也給你製作藥水的配方。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the book for the simple combination of potion use.
You can make it easily by ^4d4dffusing the combination kit or cooking tool^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這是簡單組合藥水使用的書。
你可以 ^4d4dff使用組合專用工具或烹飪工具^000000 輕鬆製作。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Not only potions but also other easily attainable things can be turned to various tools. Please make use of them.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
不僅可以製作藥水，其他容易獲得的東西也可以變成各種工具。請善加利用。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
For your trial to make it, I gave you a Red Herb and one Apple,
How about making it with the combination kit?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
為了讓你嘗試製作，我給了你一個紅色藥草和一個蘋果，
用組合專用工具製作一下怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Read the combination kit by ^4d4dffright-clicking^000000, and ^4d4dffclick the book shaped icon^000000 which will open up the explanation window.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff右鍵點選^000000組合專用工具，然後^4d4dff點選書本形狀的圖示^000000，即可開啟說明視窗。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Why don't you learn about the virtues of herbs?
Bring one Red Herb by beating the growing Red Herb near the academy building.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你要不要了解一下草藥的功效？
去學院建築附近擊敗生長的紅草，帶一株紅色藥草回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can find it near the entrance of the academy.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你可以在學院入口附近找到它。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I already let you know about the basic medical botany.
By the way, there is something called a ^4d4dffShining Plant^000000 here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
我已經向你介紹了基礎的醫學植物學知識。
順便一提，米德加爾特有一種叫^4d4dff光芒草^000000的植物。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Nobody knows which herb comes out from this plant.
Once I got the fruit of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
沒人知道這種植物會結出什麼草藥。
我曾經得到過世界樹的果實。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
And, in the Alberta merchant guild, there is an old man making potions.
You can ask him for help.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
在艾爾貝塔的商人公會裡，有一位製作藥水的老人。
你可以向他求助。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
^4d4dffAlchemist^000000 or ^4d4dffBiochemist^000000 or the higher class job ^4d4dffGeneticist^000000 are all good at creating potions.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff鍊金術士^000000、^4d4dff生物化學家^000000，或者更高階的職業^4d4dff基因學家^000000，都很擅長製作藥水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you want to have a well-made potion, it may be a good idea to ask for a specialist.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
如果你想要品質優良的藥水，找專家幫忙是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I see...
For emergency situations, in case you've fainted and want to be brought back here, I will save your current location.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
我明白了...
為了應對緊急情況，如果你昏倒了想回到這裡，我會儲存你當前的位置。

scripts.text:
Your inventory is too full so you can't continue this quest.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
你的物品欄已滿，無法繼續此任務。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hey there Turtle
You are really slow.
This Red Plant is no longer useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嘿，烏龜
你動作真慢。
這株紅草對你已經沒用了。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text: Who're you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You heard me.
Aren't you here to collect the Red Plant for the Academy Therapist.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你聽到了嗎。
你不是來為學院治療師採集紅草的嗎。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
But, But something weird just happened.
It happened right before my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
但是，剛才發生了奇怪的事。
就在我眼前發生的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Did you lose your memory?
If the captain hears about it, he'll cry.
It is still ok as long as I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你失憶了嗎？
如果船長知道了，他會哭的。
只要我還記得你就行。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lumin.
.......
How about being happy?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
盧敏。
......
開心點怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Anyway, let me explain it to you, I have just cut all the leaves of this Red Plant.
You can't collect the Red Plant anymore.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
總之，讓我解釋一下，我剛把這株紅草的葉子全剪掉了。
你沒法再採集紅草了。

scripts.text: Ok so give me a ^ff0000Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 那就給我一株^ff0000紅色藥草^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
OK... then...
I don't even need it anyways. I already know all about basic medical botany.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
好吧...那麼...
反正我也用不著。我已經知道所有基礎醫學植物學知識了。

scripts.text: Then, why did you do it?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I didn't do it!
I was just standing here.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不是我做的！
我只是站在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Here take this Red Herb.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
拿著，這是紅色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ah... see it's growing back.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
啊...看，它又長出來了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I guess you should go back to the Therapist.
He's probably waiting for you..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我想你應該回去找治療師。
他可能在等你...

scripts.text:
He seems to think of something deeply.
Disregard it.
scripts.translation:
他似乎在深思什麼。
請忽略這一點。

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亞圖拉學院學生]
......

scripts.text: This student looks familiar...
scripts.translation: 這個學生看起來很眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亞圖拉學院學生]
......

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
呼嚕...呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
呼嚕...呼嚕...

scripts.text:
- A man is lying here
- he's barely breathing.
scripts.translation:
- 這裡躺著一個男人
- 他幾乎停止了呼吸。

scripts.text: - Is this maybe...?!
scripts.translation: - 這難道是...？！

scripts.text:
- an accident...
- yes, this is a murder!
- There's a murderer here!
scripts.translation:
- 意外...
- 不，這是謀殺！
- 這裡有兇手！

scripts.text:
- I swear on some old person's grave
- I will solve this case!
scripts.translation:
- 我對著某位老人的墳墓發誓
- 我一定要偵破此案！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Yawn. Who are you making so much noise next to me...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
哈欠。是誰在我旁邊這麼吵...

scripts.text: You aren't dead?
scripts.translation: 你沒死？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Dead?! Who....?
me? Pu ha ha ha!!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
死？誰...？
我？噗哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sorry for laughing. Ha ha ha!
I was just taking a nap because the weather is good.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
抱歉笑了。哈哈哈！
我只是因為天氣好，所以小睡了一會兒。

scripts.text: But you weren't breathing...
scripts.translation: 但你剛才沒有呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Ahh...... that?
Right it makes sense that you misunderstood.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
啊......那個？
難怪你會誤會。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I used the skill<^ff0000Play Dead^000000> because I didn't want to be disturbed by monsters or someone else.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我使用了<^ff0000裝死^000000>技能，因為我不想被魔物或其他人打擾。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I never thought someone would think of me as an actual dead body.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我從未想過會有人把我當成真正的屍體。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Oh, I see... you are a new novice who just has arrived here?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
哦，我明白了...你是剛到這裡的新手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
這確實出乎意料，但你想學習<^ff0000裝死^000000>嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我相信這對你會有幫助。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text: I want to learn it!
scripts.translation: 我想學！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
I should keep sleeping.
yawning...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
真的嗎？如果你很忙，那也沒關係。
我該繼續睡覺了。
哈欠...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
You made a right decision!
I want to teach you for good.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
你做了一個正確的決定！
我想好好教你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
新手往往不瞭解自己的潛力，也不知道敵人有多強。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
有些新手很愛學習...但我猜我們不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Just take prompt action.
And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
只要迅速採取行動。
有時候你會被強大的敵人打敗...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Huh? You're right this is my story.
I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
嗯？你說得對，這是我的故事。
我厭倦了一再被擊敗。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
有一天，我靈機一動。如果我遇到強大的敵人時假裝死亡...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我面臨著死亡的風險，因為我不擅長裝死。
即使現在回想起來，那依然讓人心驚膽戰...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
let's continue to talk
So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
讓我們繼續聊。
從那以後，裝死對我來說開始奏效了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
And then...
I could not hold a breath for a long time.
That was a problem!
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
然後...
我無法長時間屏住呼吸。
那是個問題！
聰明的魔物會檢查我的呼吸！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
所以我不得不訓練自己長時間屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
聽起來很複雜...但其實很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
如果你覺得打不過敵人，當強大的敵人出現時，就倒在地上假裝死亡。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我會對你進行一個簡單的測試，看看你能否屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
屏住呼吸20秒，然後再來找我。
如果在那之前就來找我，我是不會讓你通過的！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Start!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
開始！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
什麼？你連20秒都屏不住呼吸嗎？
如果你做不到這一點，就無法學習這個技能！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold breath for 20 seconds again!
Then talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
再屏住呼吸20秒！
然後再來找我。

scripts.text: - Learned the <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>skill.

[Instructor Argos]
Okay, good job.
If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
很好，幹得不錯。
如果你能保持這樣的耐心，就能救你一命。沒有魔物能傷害到你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
<^ff0000裝死^000000>技能已經加入你的技能列表，你可以按<Alt + S>開啟它。請別忘了使用它，在危險時刻它能救你一命。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
如果你長大並轉職，就不需要這個技能了，所以不要浪費它！需要時就用，不要猶豫。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我要去睡覺了，別吵醒我。哈欠。

- Let yourself enlightened -
- and please try again -
scripts.translation:
- 喂，等一下！！ -
- 您的物品欄已經裝滿了 -
- 無法再接收物品了 -
- 請整理一下物品欄 -
- 然後再試一次 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
準備好了解異常狀態了嗎？我保證不會再捉弄你了。畢竟我可是個“教官”嘛，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
首先，我來給你講講<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
正如你之前體驗到的，中毒後身體會變成紫色，並且每秒損失少量HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP不會無限流失，所以你不會死於中毒。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眼見為實！我要讓你進入中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你在中毒狀態下會發生什麼。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.

[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你看到中毒狀態的效果了嗎？經過一段時間後，毒素可能會自然消退，但如果持續受到攻擊，指望自然解毒是很危險的。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下來，我來給你講講<^FF0000眩暈^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
處於眩暈狀態時，你的頭頂會轉圈圈，基本上無法移動，也就是處於“無防備”狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
由於處於無防備狀態，你無法移動、使用技能或使用物品。
所以，你無法自行恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有一個例外情況：如果你是修羅，可以使用技能<^0022FF點穴-快^000000>來恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你也可以通過牧師技能<^0022FF恢復^000000>或大主教技能<^0022FF折枝讚頌^000000>來恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我給你演示一下眩暈狀態會發生什麼！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感覺如何？
因為無法移動，你難道沒有感到壓抑嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想像一下，當你處於這種狀態時，魔物正朝你衝來...
相信我，這種情況真的會發生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
這次，我要教你關於<^FF0000睡眠^000000>的知識。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在睡眠狀態下，你會睡著，頭頂會出現一個<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩暈狀態一樣，你毫無防備，但不同的是，你可以從敵人的攻擊中恢復過來。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不過在睡眠狀態下，被敵人攻擊命中“暴擊”的可能性會增加，你會陷入危險並遭受嚴重傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
供你參考，自己無法恢復，只能依靠牧師的<^0022FF恢復^000000>技能。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我給你演示一下睡眠狀態會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感覺如何？想像一下在危險的敵人面前睡著，這可不是什麼好玩的事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠雖然適合恢復，但在戰鬥正酣時並不一定有利。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最後，我要教你關於<^FF0000沉默^000000>的知識。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默狀態下，你無法使用任何魔法技能，頭頂會出現一個<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
但這並不意味著所有攻擊都不可行。沉默狀態下仍然可以進行普通攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默狀態下，你只能進行物理攻擊，或者通過使用藥水來恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我給你演示一下睡眠狀態會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
無法使用技能是不是很令人沮喪？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
特別是當你是一個依賴技能而非物理攻擊的高階職業，或者在戰鬥中陷入睡眠狀態時，你會遭受嚴重傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
此外，還有黑暗、冰凍、詛咒、石化、混亂等狀態，但我可以讓你體驗所有狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我希望這能幫助你體驗一些在外界會遇到的情況。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果你想體驗異常狀態，請隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
為了彌補午餐盒的事情，我會送你一份小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
祝你在冒險中好運！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Hey, you there!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
嘿，你！
請問，你是剛入學的訓練新手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我是教官美因茨，負責這所學院的教務工作。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Which course?
It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哪個課程？
這並不重要，我稍後會告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讀了這麼多書，你一定很累吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
當然，你是... 噢，可憐的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
Do you know who is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
當你需要幫助時，有個人可以幫你。
你知道是誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
That's me!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就是我！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What does that mean?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
這是什麼意思？
意思是我為你疲憊的身體準備了一份特別的禮物！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
A lunchbox for you!!! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
給你的午餐盒！！！哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
既然不是我做的，你就別擔心了。
是我親愛的妻子準備的，所以，請隨意享用！

scripts.text: Don't take it.
scripts.translation: 不要了

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 喝

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你不想要這個午餐盒？那真是你的損失。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Should I just take it for myself then?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
那我乾脆自己吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
是的... 你做了一個正確的決定。
請記住，我其實很想吃，但看你這麼累，才先讓給你的！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你開啟午餐盒，裡面有一些食物 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
It will refresh you from your fatigue!
Eat it~~ Eat it~~
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈哈哈哈哈！別猶豫，快吃吧！
它能幫你恢復疲勞！
吃吧~~ 吃吧~~

scripts.text: - Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 既然你又累又餓，你就不得不收下這個午餐盒了 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物後，突然感到胃部一陣劇痛。你的視線似乎也有些模糊 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh... what happened to you?
You don't look too good!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哦... 你怎麼了？
你看起來氣色不太好！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh, man...
I think you've been poisoned.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
噢，天哪...
我想你中毒了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我給你一瓶解毒劑。吃了可能會好一些。

scripts.text: - You reluctantly take the antidote -
scripts.translation: - 你勉強喝下了解毒劑 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
喂，你到底是怎麼中毒的？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
順便說一句，我聽說皇家克里阿圖拉學院附近有個幽靈在遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I think the ghost must have poisoned you.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我覺得那個幽靈肯定是在你身上下了毒。

scripts.text:
- You roll your eyes at Mainz -
- Mainz turns his head as if he doesn't notice -
scripts.translation:
- 你對美因茨翻了個白眼 -
- 美因茨轉過頭去，裝作沒注意到 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Ehem! Anyway, I am sorry.
Please understand there is no malice.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
咳！總之，我很抱歉。
請理解我並沒有惡意。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
All of these are for you...
Want to know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
這一切都是為了你好...
想知道我的意思嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There are various kinds of monsters on the Midgard continent. And some of them can poison you or put you in abnormal conditions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
米德加爾特大陸上有各種各樣的魔物。其中有些會下毒或讓你陷入異常狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Usually, anybody is too embarrassed to admit being poisoned without knowing.  I just did it on purpose to let you have the experience in case it happens out in the real world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
通常，人們在不知情的情況下中毒時會感到尷尬。我故意這麼做，是為了讓你體驗一下，以防在現實世界中遇到這種情況。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Understand that I didn't intend to pass my wife's lunchbox as if it was a present. It was just another lesson from the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
請理解，我並不是故意把妻子的午餐盒當作禮物送你的。這只是克里阿圖拉學院的一堂課而已。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology, I would like to inform you of several abnormal statuses you might experience in the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
作為道歉，我想向你介紹幾種在米德加爾特大陸上可能遇到的異常狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Don't decline it! Being ready to learn so speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
別拒絕！準備好學習的話，就再來和我對話。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you here for an explanation about the abnormal statuses? What makes you anxious?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你是來了解異常狀態的嗎？是什麼讓你感到焦慮？

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他問題了。

[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
供你參考，自己無法恢復，只能依靠牧師的<^0022FF恢復^000000>技能。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我給你演示一下睡眠狀態會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感覺如何？想像一下在危險的敵人面前睡著，這可不是什麼好玩的事，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠雖然適合恢復，但在戰鬥正酣時並不一定有利。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
還有什麼讓你感到焦慮的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我來教你<^FF0000沉默^000000>的相關知識。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默狀態下，你無法使用任何魔法技能，頭頂會出現一個<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
但這並不意味著所有攻擊都不可行。沉默狀態下仍然可以進行普通攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
在沉默狀態下，你只能進行物理攻擊，或者通過使用藥水來恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我給你演示一下睡眠狀態會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
無法使用技能是不是很令人沮喪？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
特別是當你是一個依賴技能而非物理攻擊的高階職業，或者在戰鬥中陷入睡眠狀態時，你會遭受嚴重傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Do you have any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
If you don't have any more questions, would you please have my lunchbox on behalf of me?
No?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果你沒有其他問題了，能不能幫我吃掉這個便當？
不？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Haaaaa...
What should I do with this lunchbox?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈啊...
這個便當該怎麼辦才好呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
while XXXXXX, but what are you?
Are you the same kind of XXXXX?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~ 賴在藥房裡。
翹課真是酷斃了。
雖然XXXXXX，但你是誰？
你是那種XXXXX嗎？

scripts.text:

Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~ 賴在藥房裡。
翹課真是酷斃了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm... you look like you have some talent.
Being in a good mood, shall I show you something newfangled?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯...你看起來有點天賦。
既然心情不錯，要不要給你看點新花樣？

scripts.text: Newfangled?
scripts.translation: 新花樣？

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是誰..？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: Who are you..?

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I may look ordinary to you but I have a newfangled talent.
Not my fault, if you are shocked at seeing it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
在我眼裡你可能很普通，但我有一項新花樣的天賦。
如果你看到後感到震驚，那可不是我的錯。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK. Where should I start?
First, Bash!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好的。該從哪裡開始呢？
首先，狂擊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hehehe.. Surprised?
I'm just pretending...
It's not a real punch.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嘿嘿嘿..驚訝嗎？
我只是裝裝樣子...
這不是真的拳頭。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Looks like you were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
看來你很驚訝嘛！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Just keep calm
and have a potion
But that's not the last of it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
保持冷靜，喝瓶藥水就好。
不過，這還不是最厲害的。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I have stolen one thread of your hair.
I don't believe in Voodooism.
Regard it as your luck.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我偷了你的一根頭髮。
我不信巫術。
就當是你運氣好吧。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
The last one is a flame, to say the least!
How about it? Newfangled.
Idling away too long,
All the skills learnt over your shoulder could be used.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
最後一個是火焰，至少可以這麼說！
怎麼樣？很新穎吧。
閒逛太久，
你肩膀上學會的那些技能都能派上用場了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ugh, all my SP is gone...
and wasted... I am tired.
I am going back to rest.
So long, Bye-bye~~ Don't bother me anymore.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
唉，我的SP全沒了...
還浪費了...我好累。
我要回去休息了。
再見，拜拜~~ 別再打擾我了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
What? You, disturbing me.
Get away from me kid you're botherin' me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
什麼？你在打擾我。
離我遠點，小鬼，你在煩我。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Me? I'm Novice.
What? Strange? You seein' me for the first time?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我？我是初心者。
什麼？奇怪？你是第一次見到我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If I look shabby, you should go find a mirror.
You and I are wearing the same thing pal.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
如果我看起來很邋遢，你應該去照照鏡子。
你和我穿的一樣，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I'm what you call a Novice of all Novices.
A Jack of all trades but a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我是所有初心者中的初心者。
樣樣通，樣樣松。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If you don't graduate from school and hang around and only mimic other's lifesstyles you'll end up like me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
如果你不畢業，整天閒逛，只模仿別人的生活方式，你最後就會變成我這樣。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Genius and idiot has a paper thin difference.
Those of versatility but of no special capability, that is the Super Novice.
That's what everyone calls us.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
天才與傻瓜之間，只有一紙之隔。
多才多藝卻沒有專長，這就是超級初心者。
大家都這麼叫我們。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
A rose by any other name...
I am what I am. A Super Novice!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
玫瑰無論叫什麼名字...
我就是我。一個超級初心者！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
What? You, disturbing me.
Get away from me kid you're botherin' me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
什麼？你在打擾我。
離我遠點，小鬼，你在煩我。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
You, talking like this, why don't you go and change your job already instead of hanging around here?
Hmm, did you want to be like me maybe?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
你這樣說話，為什麼不去轉職，還在這裡閒逛？
嗯，難道你也想像我一樣？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Aha~ If you want all the different skills...
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~ 如果你想要各種各樣的技能...

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If you do like I do, then you will be a great Super Novice.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
如果你像我一樣，就會成為偉大的超級初心者。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm. Dirty mouth!
When I was at your age,
If I recklessly spoke like you, I was dragged to the backside mountain, and then...
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
哼。嘴巴真髒！
我像你這麼大的時候，
要是像你這樣胡言亂語，就會被拖到後山，然後...

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK... that's enough..
Now I am in a good mood?
When I am using good words,
go away silently, yes?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好了...夠了...
我現在心情不錯？
既然我在好好說話，
就請安靜地離開，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Are you idling around at school?
I don't need to tell you about it.
If you are loafing around here,
Once grown up, you will be a man like me.
Scary, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
你在學校閒逛嗎？
這不用我多說。
如果你在這裡遊手好閒，
長大後就會變成像我這樣的男子。
很可怕，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I know, I know, before we are found by a teacher or even worse the principal.
Go away, gooooooawaaaaaayyyyyyyyy~
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我知道，我知道，在老師或者更糟糕的校長髮現之前。
快走吧，快...走...吧~

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Well,
What am I doing?
I became like this, in the blink of an eye.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯，
我在做什麼呢？
眨眼之間，我就變成了這樣。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
By nature, I had a great dream...
Haaaa~~ Because I dreamt of too many things to do?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
天生...我有著偉大的夢想...
哈啊~~ 是因為我夢想了太多事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Yes, yes, take your way...
I am the Novice of pride and loneliness.
I can enjoy myself.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
是的，是的，請便...
我是驕傲與孤獨的初心者。
我可以盡興地享受自己。

scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -
