Ahh. Hey is Sir. Orleons doing well?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
啊。嘿，查爾斯·奧爾良先生最近好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Are you the new Criatura trainee?
Then go look for Dacquoise.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你是新來的克里圖拉學員嗎？
那就去找達克瓦茲吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I also learned from Sir. Charles Orleans.
Everyone became happy from eating my meals.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我也曾向查爾斯·奧爾良先生學習。
大家吃了我的飯菜都很開心。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Now it is my pleasure to feed the newbies of the Academy....
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
現在能為學院的新人們做飯，是我的榮幸....

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Wonder when my order will get taken... it's already been an hour...
Look at the helpers lingering on the side...
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
不知道什麼時候才能點餐...已經一個小時了...
看看旁邊那些閒逛的助手...

scripts.text:
[Scholarship Trainee]
Ugh... this guy...
I already told you eight hundred times! It's buffet style! Ah!
scripts.translation:
[獎學金學員]
唉...這傢伙...
我已經告訴你八百遍了！這是自助餐！啊！

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Buffet? What's that? Can you eat it?
You look down on me because I'm from the country, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
自助餐？那是什麼？能吃嗎？
你看不起我是鄉下人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Don't tell me it's not difficult to understand! Explain it to me!
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
別告訴我這很難懂！給我解釋一下！

scripts.text:
[Scholarship Trainee]
I've worked at many different places, but this place is the strangest.
scripts.translation:
[獎學金學員]
我在很多地方工作過，但這裡是最奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
Since the prices have risen I try to get my belly full at every chance I get.
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
自從物價上漲後，我只要有空就拼命填飽肚子。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
It's been 21 hours since I've been here.
It's a buffet so you can eat without time limit.
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
我來到這裡已經21個小時了。
既然是自助餐，就可以不限時地吃。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
Eat and digest, eat and digest, heh.
Do you want to join?
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
吃，消化，再吃，再消化，嘿嘿。
你要不要一起？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hey, do you know about the gunslinger's own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
嘿，你知道神槍手專用的武器嗎？

scripts.text: Don't know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Cha, yeah right!
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哈，我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I guessed you were.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
我猜你肯定知道。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Gunslinger handles 5 kinds of guns and each gun has its own character.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
神槍手使用5種不同的槍械，每種槍都有各自的特點。

scripts.text: What character?
scripts.translation: 什麼特點？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hahahaha~ I am also taking the lesson, but I don't know the details as I haven't become a gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哈哈哈~ 我也在上課，但因為我還沒成為神槍手，所以也不清楚細節。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I heard that as it was a dangerous weapon they don't let us use them yet!
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
我聽說因為那是危險的武器，所以還不讓我們使用！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Oh Mr. gunslinger!! Nice.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哦，神槍手先生！真厲害。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
What? Why did you take the other job rather than being a nice gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
什麼？為什麼你選擇了其他職業，而不是成為帥氣的槍手呢？

scripts.text: [Quiet Trainee]
scripts.translation: [安靜的學員]

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Are you coming to take the lesson for gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
你是來上神槍手課程的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Ms. Lusa really looks pretty.
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
露莎老師看起來真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I wish to be a gunslinger, like her.
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
我想像她一樣成為神槍手。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I hope I finish my lessons soon!
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
希望我能快點完成課程！

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Learning is too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
學習好難啊...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
You are a gunslinger? You look great! I want to become a gunslinger......
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
你是神槍手嗎？看起來好厲害！我也想成為神槍手......

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Desperado is the bullet... Blable... Ranged attack... Physics....
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
亡命之徒是子彈...巴拉巴拉...遠端攻擊...物理...

scripts.text: You can't hear her clearly because of her small voice.
scripts.translation: 因為她聲音太小，你聽不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Trainee]
That man looks too scary.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的學員]
那個男子看起來好可怕。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
A sudden poetic inspiration hit me!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我突然有了詩意的靈感！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFIn the night of the Byalan Island under the moonlight, sitting alone in Izlude^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF在拜蘭島的月光之夜，獨自坐在依斯魯得島^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFWearing Tzurugie on my belly, in the deep anxiety,^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF腹中懷著Tzurugie，在深深的焦慮中，^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFHearing I made a fortune from somewhere, killing me softly.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF聽說我從某處發了大財，溫柔地殺死了我的靈魂。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
How about it? It is excellent, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
怎麼樣？很出色，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
I will ^FF0000transcend ^000000and ^FF00003rd job change^000000. Become a nice Minstrel, I can play with a famous Wanderer like Mr. Igoo.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我要^FF0000轉生^000000並進行^FF0000三轉^000000。成為一名優秀的宮廷樂師，就能和像伊古先生那樣的著名浪姬舞者一起玩耍了。

scripts.text: What is transcending?
scripts.translation: 什麼是轉生？

scripts.text: What is the 3rd job change?
scripts.translation: 什麼是三轉？

scripts.text: Who is Igoo?
scripts.translation: 伊古是誰？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
You seem to already know what it is!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
看來你已經知道這是什麼了！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Transcending is great. Very great.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
轉生很偉大。非常偉大。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Basically the 2nd job adventurer gains the base level 99 and job level 50, on then can that person transcend.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
基本上，二轉冒險者達到基礎等級99和職業等級50後，就可以轉生了。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Once you transcend, you can go back to the base level Novice.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
一旦轉生，你就可以回到基礎等級的初心者狀態。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
It is very hard to start your adventure again. However, there is a merit to the hardship.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
重新開始冒險非常艱難。但是，艱難中也有好處。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The most important merit is to learn new skills at a new upgraded level. In my case, I could transfer to not an ordinary Bard but a Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
最重要的好處是在新的升級等級中學習新技能。對我來說，我可以轉職成為不普通的詩人，而是宮廷樂師。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Indeed, be careful as you can only follow the way of the job you chose before transcending.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
確實，要小心，因為轉生後你只能沿著之前選擇的職業道路前進。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
If you are interested in transcending, recommend you visit the Sage castle in ^FF0000Juno^000000. I may be far behind for it.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
如果你對轉生感興趣，推薦你去^FF0000朱諾^000000的賢者城堡。我可能離那裡還很遠。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Oh, you know very well, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
哦，你很清楚，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The 3rd job change is obviously a new job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
三轉顯然是新的職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Adventurers with the 2nd job or can be transferred to the 3rd job class once gaining the base level 99 and the job level more than 50.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
二轉的冒險者，在基礎等級達到99且職業等級超過50後，就可以轉職為三轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
For example, a Bard like me was an Archer in the beginning. Now I became a Bard. As I am diligently adventuring, I may be able to change jobs to a third job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
比如像我這樣的詩人，一開始是弓箭手。現在成為了詩人。只要我努力冒險，也許就能轉職為三轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ah, of course, though I don't make transfer, I could be Minstrel as my final target. However, I won't compromise with the reality. Someday I will be the best Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
啊，當然，雖然我現在還不能轉職，但我的最終目標是成為宮廷樂師。不過，我不會向現實妥協。總有一天，我會成為最棒的宮廷樂師。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
So, if you transfer, you could first be Novice and be a Bard. But someday I could be Minstrel, couldn't I?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
所以，如果你轉職，可以先成為初心者，然後成為詩人。但總有一天，我也能成為宮廷樂師，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Choice is always on you. Be ambitious, adventurer. Someday I will sing an encouraging song for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
選擇權始終在你手中。要有野心，冒險者。總有一天，我會為你唱一首鼓舞人心的歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
No! You don't know the most beautiful girl Wanderer Igoo in this era?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
不！你不知道這個時代最美的浪姬舞者伊古嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Haven't you heard about [Volume 1 - Lost Poring] or [Volume 2 : Poring my love]?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
你沒聽說過《第一卷 - 迷失的波利》或《第二卷：波利，我的愛》嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Then, have you never heard the songs like [It's a Good day for an OCA] or [Baphomet I hardly knew you]

[Lusa]
Ya, know you remind me of my little sister, that scamp couldn't shoot the broadside of barn.. At least not until I taught her.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你知道嗎，你讓我想起我那小妹妹，那傢伙連穀倉的側板都打不中...至少在我教她之前是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Now y'all need to understand, guns aren't some little thing that you just swing at an animal, you don't wiggle those there fingers and shock them to death.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們得明白，槍可不是那種對著動物亂揮的小玩意兒，也不是用手指戳一下就能把對方電死的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
No! You shoot things, which means ya need to aim straight. This takes a lot of ^ff0000dexterity^000000 on the part of the gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
不！你是要射擊目標，這意味著你需要瞄準。這對神槍手來說需要很高的^ff0000敏捷^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Now before ya go running off shooting dem guns in the air, all high fallootin and dancing around. Ya need to understand that this isn't an easy job!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
在你們跑去對著天空亂開槍、手舞足蹈之前，得明白這不是個輕鬆的工作！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Bullets cost zeny so you need to be sure that everything you shoot is worth the price! We attack at range so that nasty cur with the pig sticker doesn't rustle your jimmies!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
子彈很貴，所以你得確保每一發子彈都物有所值！我們是遠端攻擊，這樣那些帶刺的討厭鬼就不會讓你受驚了！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all understand?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Ranged attack?
scripts.translation: 遠端攻擊？

scripts.text: Why is ammo expensive?
scripts.translation: 為什麼彈藥很貴？

scripts.text: Job Change Test?
scripts.translation: 轉職測試？

scripts.text: Yes~!!
scripts.translation: 是的~！！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Those low tech barbarians need both Strength and Dexterity in order to fight properly. This isn't true for gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那些低科技的野蠻人需要力量和敏捷才能正常戰鬥。神槍手則不然。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why our dexterity influences both attack power and accuracy! Remember, Talk slowly but think quickly!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我們的敏捷既影響攻擊力也影響命中率！記住，說話要慢，思考要快！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do y'all see lots of factories around here? Mines? Alchemical labs? All these things take zeny to run and thats how they fund it!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們看到周圍有很多工廠嗎？還有礦山？鍊金實驗室？
運營這些東西都需要Zeny，這就是它們的資金來源！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Some other jobs may think it is safe enough to hand any yonkle the strength to seriously hurt someone.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有些其他職業可能覺得，隨便給一個路人賦予能嚴重傷害他人的力量是安全的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But we have to see that you have grit! Remember, fast is good but accurate is better.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
但我們必須確認你有毅力！
記住，快是好的，但準更好。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all can come back now if you gets any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They tell me Criatura Academy is for the novices not yet decided what job to take.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
聽說克里阿圖拉學院是接待那些還沒決定轉職方向的初心者的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They hired me, gun and all, to show you how to be a gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他們僱了我，連槍帶人，來教你們如何成為神槍手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Would you like me to show you how?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要我教你們嗎？

scripts.text: Yes mam!
scripts.translation: 是的，女士！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hrmm, you didn't look like you had the grit any how.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，你看起來似乎並沒有那種毅力。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hey! What kind of con is this?! You already had a manual!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！這是什麼把戲？！你已經有一本手冊了！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Here take this manual, I ain't too good at that there book learnin' but I can answer your questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
拿著這本手冊吧，我不太擅長讀書寫字，但我可以回答你的問題。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you need the battle training, visit <NAVI>[Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你需要戰鬥訓練，請去拜訪<NAVI>[蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, sorry! Children cannot become Gunslingers!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，抱歉！兒童不能成為神槍手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Perhaps you should talk to your parents about other professions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
也許你應該和父母談談其他職業。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to learn to shoot as a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你要學習射擊，成為神槍手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wooo doggy! You aren't ready for the big city yet!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇哦，你還沒準備好進入大城市呢！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get to ^ff0000Job Level: ^0000ff10^000000 and come back here and I will help ya!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
達到^ff0000職業等級: ^0000ff10^000000後再來這裡，我會幫你的！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all ready to take the test to become a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們準備好參加成為神槍手的測試了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我過去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
When ya are ready, come to me!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
準備好了就來找我！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Okay then, you should find a^ff0000 Mr. Master Miller^000000 and ask him about the test.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好的，你應該去找^ff0000米勒大師^000000，問問他關於測試的事。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Remember, if you find yourself in a hole, the first thing to do is stop digging!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
記住，如果你發現自己陷入了困境，首先要做的就是停止挖掘！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們需要關於那本書的幫助嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們需要關於那本書的幫助嗎？
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: How do I use this book?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼使用這本書？

scripts.text: I can't find the skill.
scripts.translation: 我找不到那個技能。

scripts.text: I don't have a gun....
scripts.translation: 我沒有槍....

scripts.text: No more questions now.
scripts.translation: 現在沒有問題了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh.. I think I know what the problem is,
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦..我想我知道問題出在哪裡了，

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ta use the guide, first ya need to equip it. ^ff0000To open the equipment window the Shortcut key is Alt + E.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要使用指南，首先你需要裝備它。^ff0000開啟裝備視窗的快捷鍵是 Alt + E。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sometimes I forget ta do that too! ^ff0000Drag the item from your inventory to the appropriate slot in the equipment window. Alternatively you can double click the item in inventory.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有時候我自己也會忘記這樣做！^ff0000將物品從物品欄拖到裝備視窗的相應槽位中。或者，你可以雙擊物品欄中的物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們還有其他問題嗎？
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need ta learn how to use the skill?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們需要學習如何使用這個技能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000To open the skill window use the short cut Alt + S. The skill will be located in the ETC tab.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000使用快捷鍵 Alt + S 開啟技能視窗。該技能位於 ETC 標籤頁中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000You can then drag the skill to your hot bar for easy use!.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000然後你可以將技能拖到你的快捷欄中，以便輕鬆使用！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
... and thats how I learned that When in doubt, let your peco do the thinkin'.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
... 這就是我學到的：當猶豫不決時，讓你的佩科（Peco）來思考。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們還有其他問題嗎？
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well, I don't think that you are quite ready to get a shootin iron. So the training book only shows ya skills that don't need guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，我覺得你們還沒準備好拿一把槍。所以訓練書只展示了那些不需要槍的技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們還有其他問題嗎？
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你們還有更多問題，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh! Are you just darling, a newly minted gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦！你真是可愛極了，一位新晉的神槍手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why your shootin iron looks shinier then a silver zeny! Do ya need anything?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
為什麼你的槍看起來比銀色的Zeny還要閃亮！你需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 你能幫我到艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
當然可以，為什麼不呢？記得多花點時間訓練哦！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
快去吧，你這小調皮鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, I am glad to hear that you are so strong!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，很高興聽到你這麼厲害！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah, still in basic training eh? You're not carelessly using Butterfly Wings, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
啊，還在基礎訓練中嗎？你並沒有隨意使用蝴蝶翅膀吧？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to Einbroch to complete basic training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你是要去艾音布羅克完成基礎訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 你能幫我到艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: No, I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 不，我有其他事要做。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
當然可以，為什麼不呢？記得多花點時間訓練哦！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
快去吧，你這小調皮鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, is that so? If you wish to go to Einbroch but not take the Airship, come speak to me.
Because you're still training, I will send you there for free.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，是嗎？如果你想前往艾音布羅克但不乘坐飛空艇，可以來找我對話。
因為你還處於訓練階段，我會免費送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah you're back, and now wearing lovely Gunslinger clothing! It suits you well, congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
啊，你回來了，而且穿上了漂亮的神槍手服裝！很適合你，恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I just received the news from my brother regarding your achievement of completing basic training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我剛收到我哥哥的訊息，說你完成了基礎訓練。

scripts.text: Brother?
scripts.translation: 哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? My brother did not tell you? My brother is the one in charge of Basic Training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？我哥哥沒告訴你嗎？負責基礎訓練的人就是我哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Louie and Lusa are very similar names, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
路易和露莎的名字很相似，對吧？

scripts.text: I guess so...
scripts.translation: 我想也是...

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ha ha~ Well, our relationship is not really that important.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哈哈~ 好吧，我們的關係其實沒那麼重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have been assigned to conduct Combat Training for the Gunslinger guild.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我被指派負責神槍手公會的戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text: Why you?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是你？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers are very fond of freedom, so the Guild had limited choices to choose from.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手們非常崇尚自由，所以公會的選擇範圍很有限。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They suddenly called me to do this. Frankly I think it's a bit absurd.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他們突然叫我來做這件事。說實話，我覺得有點荒唐。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But on the basis of there being no previous Combat Training before, I have agreed to help.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
但鑑於之前沒有戰鬥訓練的先例，我同意幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So it was decided that we would use this opporunity to help get rid of some of the monsters near Prontera and Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
所以決定利用這個機會，順便清理一下普隆德拉和依斯魯得島附近的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
It should help the people of those areas that are plagued by the same monsters every day.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
這應該能幫助那些每天都被同樣魔物困擾的居民。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
In accordance with the principles of guilds, the Combat Training is not mandatory.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
根據公會的原則，戰鬥訓練並非強制要求。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Once you complete a task, talk to me again to complete to process.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
完成任務後，請再次與我交談以完成流程。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well that's all! If a task proves to be too difficult you can cancel at any time, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好了，就這些！如果任務太難，您可以隨時取消，所以請不要擔心。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Haven't started your basic combat training yet have you? What do you want to know about training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您還沒有開始基礎戰鬥訓練吧？您想了解關於訓練的什麼內容？

scripts.text: How long can I train for?
scripts.translation: 訓練可以持續多久？

scripts.text: Where do I receive tasks for training?
scripts.translation: 在哪裡領取訓練任務？

scripts.text: Why do combat training?
scripts.translation: 為什麼要進行戰鬥訓練？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Basic combat training can be performed until Base Level 20.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
基礎戰鬥訓練可以一直進行到基礎等級20級。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You must've thought that the training would be pretty low because this is still the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您一定覺得訓練很簡單吧，畢竟這只是個開始。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sorry! Did I not mention this?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
抱歉！我是不是沒提到這一點？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You can choose any task you wish from the requests on my desk near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您可以從入口附近我桌上的請求中任選一個任務。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Right, ah, why? Well, The Gunslinger guild didn't have any combat training in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
對，啊，為什麼？嗯，神槍手公會最初並沒有戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So they suddenly asked me to perform combat training for new recruits.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
所以他們突然讓我為新成員進行戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
This training is not mandatory if you do not want to do it.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果您不想參加，這個訓練並非強制的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment A>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任務A>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfectly! I have confirmed the 10 Hornets. Kids will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已確認10只蜂兵。孩子們會很開心的。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在檢視報告後，您獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任務B>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您也完成了<任務B>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Roda Frogs. Tonight I should get a good sleep.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已確認10只羅達蛙。今晚我應該能睡個好覺了。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在檢視報告後，您獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment C>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任務C>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment C> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您也完成了<任務C>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirm the 10 Savage Babes. Students who want to develop specialist pets must be very happy.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已確認10只小野豬。想要培養專業寵物的學生一定很開心。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在檢視報告後，您獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment D>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您完成了<任務D>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment D> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
您也完成了<任務D>？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Rockers. Were they hard to catch?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇！您做得完美！我已確認10只蝗蟲。它們很難抓嗎？

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 在檢視報告後，您獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have finished processing your completed tasks. Would you like to cancel any existing tasks?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我已處理完您已完成的任務。您想取消任何現有任務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes

scripts.text: Leave

[Lusa]

[Lusa]

scripts.text:
[Lusa]

scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手是一個遠端攻擊職業。但是，與箭矢不同，子彈很昂貴。這往往會讓新手感到擔憂。

[Lusa]

scripts.text: Isn't that a little too simple?

scripts.text: Nevermind.

scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手是遠端攻擊職業，所以敏捷（DEX）非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you want to increase your attack power, then you must strengthen your hands.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
如果你想提高攻擊力，就必須強化你的雙手。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslinger skills are not like other classes. Each weapon type has skills that can be specifically used with them.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手的技能與其他職業不同。每種武器型別都有專門配合使用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Like with other classes, there is no standard toward which skills you should learn.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
與其他職業一樣，沒有規定你應該學習哪些技能的標準。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers have five different kinds of guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手有五種不同型別的槍械。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Revolvers have low hit rates, but the attack speed is fast.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
左輪手槍命中率較低，但攻擊速度很快。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Rifles are average in their performance, and is typically the weapon of choice for new Gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
步槍效能中規中矩，通常是新手神槍手的武器首選。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Shotguns have strong attack power, but pretty low attack speeds.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
霰彈槍攻擊力很強，但攻擊速度較慢。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gatling guns have quite a fast attack speed, but the attack power is low.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
加特林機槍攻擊速度相當快，但攻擊力較低。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gernade Launchers can be used for strong ground attacks, but the bullets will be consumed quickly.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
榴彈發射器可以進行強力地面攻擊，但彈藥消耗很快。

Take care!

scripts.text: Just Saying Hello

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
你似乎就是那位兄弟提到的人。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
您想要交換公會配發的武器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]

scripts.translation:

讓我們先檢查一下您的槍的狀況。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
如果您想繼續，需要裝備您的武器。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Grenade Launcher?
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
您想要交換公會配發的榴彈發射器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
The gun looks to be in good condition.
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
這把槍看起來狀況良好。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Please select the novice weapon you wish to exchange for your {0}!
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
請選擇您想要用來交換{0}的初心者武器！

scripts.text: Exchange for Revolver
scripts.translation: 交換為左輪手槍

scripts.text: Exchange for Rifle
scripts.translation: 交換為步槍

scripts.text: Exchange for Shotgun
scripts.translation: 交換為霰彈槍

scripts.text: Exchange for Gatling Gun
scripts.translation: 交換為加特林機槍

scripts.text: Exchange for Grenade Launcher
scripts.translation: 交換為榴彈發射器

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You already have that gun, just use it!
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
您已經擁有這把槍了，直接使用即可！

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Gun control management number ^FF0000{0}{1}{2}{3}{4}{5}{6}^000000.

[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Are there any issues?
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text: No issues.
scripts.translation: 沒有問題

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Cherish your gun!
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
請珍惜您的槍！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hi, Good morning!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
嗨，早上好！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
It's time to choose your job? How about Taekwon {0}? You may be a nice adult like me.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
是時候選擇您的職業了？怎麼樣，跆拳{0}？你可以像我一樣成為優秀的成年人。

scripts.text: People following the Taekwon way
scripts.translation: 追隨跆拳之道的人

scripts.text: I want to follow the Taekwon way!!!
scripts.translation: 我要追隨跆拳之道！！！

scripts.text: Good morning! Now it is...
scripts.translation: 早上好！現在正是...

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Do you want to know about taekwon boy/girl? You want to be a cool guy like me right?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你想了解跆拳男孩/女孩嗎？你想成為像我一樣酷的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Make the world wonderful by making a strong body with the right spirit. That's the Taekwondo motto!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
用正確的精神鍛鍊強健的體魄，讓世界變得更美好。這就是跆拳道的座右銘！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Later if you are trained to be a stronger body, you can change your job to ^FF0000Taekwon Master^000000 or a ^FF0000Soul Linker ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
等你鍛煉出更強健的體魄後，就可以轉職為^FF0000跆拳^000000或^FF0000悟靈士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
It is not an easy way. So I don't like to recommend it to you if you aren't fully prepared. But it is definitely a nice and great way to follow!!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
這條路並不容易。如果你沒有做好充分準備，我不太建議你嘗試。但如果你準備好了，這絕對是一條很棒的道路！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Introduction to the class may let you know about what Taekwon in more detail.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
職業介紹可以讓你更詳細地瞭解跆拳。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are really anxious about Taekown, I would like to recommend you a brief introduction. Will you use it?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你真的很急切地想了解跆拳，我推薦你閱讀一份簡要介紹。你要使用它嗎？

scripts.text: After I look around more.
scripts.translation: 我再四處看看。

scripts.text: Yes, let's do this!
scripts.translation: 是的，讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Every adventurer may have their own job! Hope you can find what you want!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
每位冒險者都可以擁有自己的職業！希望你能找到你想要的！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Go to the [Misc] tab on Skill Window after equipping the Manual and there you will see some skills.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
裝備手冊後，請前往技能視窗的[其他]標籤頁，在那裡你會看到一些技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Flying Kick^000000 is the skill to approach rapidly and attack the enemy! It fully contains the typical feature of Taekwon!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000飛腳踢^000000是快速接近並攻擊敵人的技能！它完全體現了跆拳的典型特徵！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Warm Wind^000000 is the skill to change the feature of attacks. This is the essential skill for ^FF0000Taekwon unable to use weapons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000暖風^000000是改變攻擊特性的技能。這是^FF0000無法使用武器的跆拳^000000的必備技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
While taking the Quest, experience the skills of a Taekwon! You could meet an adept trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
在完成任務的過程中，體驗跆拳的技能吧！你可以在一樓遇到一位熟練的教練。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Want to follow the Taekwon way? Let me see....
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想要追隨跆拳之道嗎？讓我看看....

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Taekwon is the tough way training himself rather than learning from somebody. However, if you want to follow, I will recommend you to a trainer.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
跆拳是一條通過自我磨練而非向他人學習來變強的艱難道路。不過，如果你想要追隨，我會推薦你去找一位教練。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Training is on you, but he will give you the direction for training. I can take you about there. Want to go now?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
訓練靠你自己，但他會為你指明訓練的方向。我可以帶你去那裡。現在要去嗎？

scripts.text: Let me think a little more.
scripts.translation: 讓我再想想。

scripts.text: Let's go!!
scripts.translation: 走吧！！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Choose it with discretion. It is a matter of your future adventure.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
請謹慎選擇。這將決定你未來的冒險。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You can find a boy with the same appearance as me, when you get in the town through ^FF0000the west entrance^000000, and continue follow the way ^FF0000to the north^000000 after passing the pub house but just before the archer town.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
從^FF0000西門^000000進入城鎮後，沿著路^FF0000向北^000000走，經過酒館，在到達弓箭手城鎮之前，你就能看到一個長得和我一模一樣的男孩。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
To follow the Taekwon way, you have to get to job level 10. To be a Taekwon, train yourself until you get to job level 10!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想要追隨跆拳之道，必須達到職業等級10。為了成為跆拳，請努力訓練直到職業等級達到10！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you feel difficult in training alone, make a visit to the trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你覺得獨自訓練很困難，可以去1樓找教練。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ahahaha.. It is already time? While I am inside... Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
啊哈哈...已經到時間了嗎？我在裡面...別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are interested in being a Taekwon making a healthy body with strong sprit, you can learn a lot here.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你對成為跆拳感興趣，想要擁有強健的體魄和強大的精神，你可以在這裡學到很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
What do you think? Are you interested in being a Taekwon? I don't push you to do! But if you do, I may become your trainer.. So..
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你覺得怎麼樣？對成為跆拳感興趣嗎？我不會強迫你！但如果你願意，我可能會成為你的教練...那麼...

scripts.text: I have interest!
scripts.translation: 我有興趣！

scripts.text: I have interest in you!
scripts.translation: 我對你有興趣！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Is that so!? You are!? Yaho! Now I am a teacher! Now, ask me whatever!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
是嗎！？你是！？耶吼！現在我是老師了！現在，儘管問我吧！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hahaha.. You are interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哈哈哈...你對我感興趣？

scripts.text: Suddenly, you see Arang's foot flying towards you.
scripts.translation: 突然，你看到阿朗的腳朝你飛了過來。

scripts.text: All you see are stars...
scripts.translation: 你眼前一片金星...

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You look like a naive beginner? If you want to get in the class, come after registering on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你看起來像個天真的初學者？如果你想加入課程，請在1樓登記後再來。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Are you diligently training? Once you are trained well, you could become a Taekwon Master or a Soul Linker.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你訓練得很刻苦嗎？一旦訓練得當，你就可以成為跆拳師父或悟靈士。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You became a nice Taekwon Master!? Please keep in mind power is followed by responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你成為了出色的跆拳師父！請記住，力量伴隨著責任。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Handling spirits is a very delicate job to do, I heard. Excellent! The adventurer led by me has grown up like this.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
聽說操控精靈是一項非常精細的工作。太棒了！我帶領的冒險者已經成長到這種地步了。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ehra! I thought you followed the Taekwon way~~ it is regretful but everyone has their own life, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哎呀！我以為你會追隨跆拳之道~~雖然很遺憾，但每個人都有自己的生活，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
I am propagating the way of Taekwons!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我正在傳播跆拳之道！

scripts.text:
As I can't recall, I feel the shock that something hit me on my head.
^FF0000I should look for somebody to heal me nearby.^000000.
scripts.translation:
我不記得發生了什麼，只感覺頭部受到衝擊。
^FF0000我應該找附近的人給我治療一下。^000000

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much with you? Unload it somewhere and come back.
scripts.translation:
你身上怎麼帶了這麼多東西？
把它們卸在別處，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Emmm. This is?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯...這是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You were never trained by me.
Then, I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你從未受過我的訓練。
那麼，我對你的事不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I see you received a complete education in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
看來你在斐揚接受了完整的教育。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Then again... you may want to learn more.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
不過...你可能還想學更多。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Either way, there is nothing I can teach you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
無論如何，我沒有什麼能教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Ah~ You've become a skilled Archer.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
啊~你已經成為一名熟練的弓箭手了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The difference is great now compared to when you were a novice!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
和你還是初心者時相比，進步真大！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Because of my teachings, you have grown very fast!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
多虧了我的教導，你成長得很快！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Sniff sniff! It is the smell of a novice!
Nice to meet you!!!
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗅嗅！這是初學者的味道！
很高興見到你！！！
什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I can guess most, but hehehehe~~
Please feel comfortable and tell me everything you want!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我大概能猜到，呵呵呵~~
請放鬆，想說什麼就說什麼吧！

scripts.text: I get bored! Play with me!
scripts.translation: 我無聊了！陪我玩！

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於弓箭手的事。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What? Bored? Play with you?
You think this is just some kids playground?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
什麼？無聊？陪你玩？
你以為這裡是小孩遊樂場嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are bored, walk around and punch a monster in the face and see what happens.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
如果你無聊，就去四處走走，打打魔物的臉，看看會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Oh dear~ another sheep here to get a free lesson from me.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
哎呀~又來一隻羊，想從我這裡免費領教。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The main point of Archers is to use bows to attack enemies quickly from a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手的主要特點，是利用弓箭從遠處快速攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Only problem is they are physically weak.
But, it doesn't matter if they are trained correctly.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
唯一的缺點是身體比較虛弱。
但如果訓練得當，這就不是問題。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What do you want to know about an Archer? I will tell you everything~
With my full explanation~, you can be an excellent one.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你想了解弓箭手的什麼？我會告訴你一切~
有了我的詳細解說~，你就能成為優秀的弓箭手。

scripts.text: Archer's stats
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的屬性

scripts.text: Archer's skills
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的技能

scripts.text: I want to become an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成為弓箭手

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Are you curious about the Archer's stats?
Do you know the most necessary stats for Archers?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你對弓箭手的屬性感到好奇嗎？
你知道弓箭手最需要哪項屬性嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
That is ^0000cdDex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
那就是^0000cdDex^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To raise up the attacking power in other jobs, Str should be raised but Archers vary in accordance with their Dex figures.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
要提高其他職業的攻擊力，通常應該提升Str，但弓箭手的情況不同，主要取決於Dex的數值。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is a simple question! What is the name of the stat determining the Archer's attacking power?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
來回答一個簡單的問題！決定弓箭手攻擊力的屬性叫什麼？

scripts.text: Dex!
scripts.translation: Dex！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You are correct~~
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
回答正確~~

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more about the role of other stats, ^0000cdopen the status window by pressing ALT+Q.^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
如果你想了解更多關於其他屬性的作用，^0000cd請按ALT+Q開啟屬性視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are curious about stats except Dex, you can check it out.
If you have a job later, you can reset the stats anyway.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
如果你對Dex以外的屬性感到好奇，可以自行檢視。
以後有了職業，反正也可以重置屬性。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hey, just click this and that!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嘿，只要點點這個，點點那個就行！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmm. You are interested in skills? Then, let's study ^0000cdskill^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯。你對技能感興趣？那麼，讓我們來研究一下^0000cd技能^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I thought you would better experience the skill than talking, so I prepared the experience of the archer's skill in a manual.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我覺得讓你實際體驗技能比光聽講解更好，所以我準備了一本手冊，裡面包含弓箭手技能的體驗內容。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Archer have a lot of very useful skills.
But regretfully as most of them are skills useful only with arrows and bows, you can't experience them.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手有很多非常實用的技能。
但遺憾的是，其中大多數技能只能配合弓箭使用，所以你無法體驗它們。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
There is a useful skill without a bow... Called ^0000cdImprove Concentration^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
有一個不需要弓箭的實用技能...叫做^0000cd心神凝聚^000000

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
At the same time, it will reveal hidden enemies nearby.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
同時，它還能顯示附近的隱藏敵人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more anout skill, then open the skill window by pressing the key  ^0000cdALT+S^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
如果你想了解更多關於技能的資訊，請按^0000cdALT+S^000000開啟技能視窗。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you scoll the mouse on the skill icon, there pops up the details about the skill. Please read it.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
當你在技能圖示上滾動滑鼠時，會彈出該技能的詳細資訊。請閱讀一下。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To use skills, click the skill icon on the skill window. Then drag and register it on the ^0000cdshortcut window^000000 to use conveniently.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
要使用技能，請點選技能視窗中的技能圖示。然後將其拖拽並註冊到^0000cd快捷欄^000000中，以便方便使用。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Will you go and find a hunting teacher on the 1st floor? if you do not want, then no need.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你要去一樓找狩獵老師嗎？如果不願意，那也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
But he may train you with a lot of useful hunting skills for you.
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
You may visit him.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
不過，他可能會教你許多實用的狩獵技能。
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
你可以去拜訪他。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you want to become an^0000cd Archer^000000?
It hasn't been a long time since we met together. But I am sad about saying good bye to you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你想成為^0000cd弓箭手^000000嗎？
我們相識不久。但要說再見，我還是感到有些難過。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Let me check a little while, before you change your job you have to be at job level 10.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
讓我檢查一下。在轉職之前，你的職業等級必須達到10級。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Change conditions satisfied!!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
滿足轉職條件！！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you really want to become an Archer?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你真的想成為弓箭手嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, change me to an Archer.
scripts.translation: 是的，讓我轉職為弓箭手

scripts.text: Let me think of it a little while.
scripts.translation: 讓我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
First, let me explain some things to you about the Job Change.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
首先，讓我向你解釋一些關於轉職的事情。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
An Archer's hometown is ^0000cdPayon^000000; Which has a very long history.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手的故鄉是^0000cd斐揚^000000，那裡有著悠久的歷史。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you are feeling fatigued, you can go there.
You will be given a warm hometown welcome.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
當你感到疲憊時，可以去那裡。
你會感受到故鄉般的溫暖歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The Archers Guild is located to the ^0000cdNorth of Payon Archer Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手公會位於^0000cd斐揚弓箭手村北部^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I will take you to the gates of Payon.
I would love to accompany you the rest of the way, but you must do this alone.
I'll give you the directions which you must remember.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我會送你到斐揚的城門。
我很想陪你走完剩下的路，但這段路你必須獨自走完。
我會告訴你方向，請務必記住。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is where I will send you to.
Once you arrive, you will see the area marked by this ^0000cdRed Circle^000000. Go through there, then...
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
這裡就是我要送你的地方。
到達後，你會看到標記著這個^0000cd紅色圓圈^000000的區域。穿過那裡，然後...

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You will reach the village of Payon.
Follow the direction of the ^0000cdRed Arrow^000000, you will enter ^0000cdArcher Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你將到達斐揚村。
沿著^0000cd紅色箭頭^000000的方向，你將進入^0000cd弓箭手村^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Once you get there, make your way to the ^0000cdCircled Area^000000. Here you will find the ^0000cdArcher Job Change Guild^000000.
Got it? Easy to find, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
到達那裡後，前往^0000cd圓圈區域^000000。在那裡你會找到^0000cd弓箭手轉職公會^000000。
明白了嗎？很好找，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Due to satellite navigation, you shouldn't worry about getting lost.
However, if you are still worried, you can ask the local ^0000cdGuide^000000 where to go.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
由於有衛星導航，你不用擔心迷路。
不過，如果你還是很擔心，可以詢問當地的^0000cd嚮導^000000該往哪裡走。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You can find me after your visit to the guild.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
拜訪完公會後，你可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Now then, I wish you success in becoming an Archer. Until next time!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
那麼，祝你成功成為弓箭手。下次再見！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Yes, come back and see me after reconsideration.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
好的，考慮清楚後再回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmmm. You are a little bit short of Job Level.
Are you coming back after more training?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯。你的職業等級還差一點。
你是訓練完再回來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Visit <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
at Armory on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
前往一樓軍械庫的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[戰鬥訓練師 西比諾]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Really? Then, don't be lazy but get some training.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
真的嗎？那就別偷懶，去好好訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you still here? Are you not going to become an Archer?
Are you going to pursue a different job?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你怎麼還在這裡？不打算成為弓箭手了嗎？
是要轉修其他職業嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Well? How is it being an Archer?
The student has surpassed the teacher, as the saying goes.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
怎麼樣？當弓箭手的感覺如何？
俗話說得好，青出於藍而勝於藍。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You don't seem to be fully registered at the Academy yet.
Hurry and complete your registration.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你似乎還沒有在學院完成註冊。
快去把註冊手續辦完。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Did you directly come here without the entrance application for Critura Academy yet?
You are too in a hurry. Rush to go to the 1st floor for application, and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你還沒去克里圖拉學院提交入學申請就直接來了嗎？
你太心急了。快去一樓辦理申請，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you of a different job snooping around here?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你一個別的職業的人，為什麼在這裡東張西望？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Don't snoop around and get out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
別到處亂看，快從這裡出去！！

scripts.text: - Quest cannot be continued due to your overfilled inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你想了解劍士嗎？
如果想上課，必須先註冊。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go and register at the counter on the 1st floor!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
去一樓櫃檯辦理註冊！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to become a swordsman?
Great decision.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你想成為劍士？
是個很棒的決定。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Fight on the frontline with large swords,
Bringing victory and with a high defense to protect your comrades.
Simply put, we're the best.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
手持大劍衝鋒在前線，
帶來勝利，並以高防禦保護你的同志。
簡單來說，我們是最強的。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
What do you think?
You want to become a Swordsman here?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你覺得怎麼樣？
你想在這裡成為劍士嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text: I want to test Swordsman Skills!
scripts.translation: 我想測試劍士技能！

scripts.text: Change me right now!
scripts.translation: 現在就讓我轉職！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you're not interested in this opportunity,
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
既然你對這個機會不感興趣，

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go hunt Porings and stay
as a novice forever!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
那就去抓波利，
永遠當個初心者吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Calm down, lets's start over.
First, I'll give you a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
Read it carefuly before asking any questions.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
冷靜點，我們重新開始。
首先，給你一本^FF0000劍士入門手冊^000000
在提問之前，請仔細閱讀。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you want to become a Swordman,
You should reach over ^006400Base level 10^000000,
And become more than ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
如果你想成為劍士，
你的^006400基礎等級^000000需要達到10級，
並且職業等級需要超過^0064009級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Get taught here and follow the steps.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
在這裡接受指導，並按照步驟進行。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
前往劍士公會，
繼續你的轉職之路吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會位於依斯魯得島廣場中心的西邊。
應該很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you are equipped with a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
You'll be able to experience the basic skills of the swordsman.
Now let's study the basics of Swordsman skills.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
如果你裝備了^FF0000劍士入門手冊^000000，
你就能體驗劍士的基本技能。
現在讓我們來學習劍士技能的基礎。

scripts.text: Swordman key points
scripts.translation: 劍士要點

scripts.text: Heightened Attack and defense.
scripts.translation: 提升攻擊力和防禦力

scripts.text: Related stats
scripts.translation: 相關屬性

scripts.text: Additional Swordman classes?
scripts.translation: 劍士的進階職業？

scripts.text: I learned enough already.
scripts.translation: 我已經學得差不多了

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman uses strong constitution; shrugs off damage easily from foes and when in a party, is a leader and the protector of others.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士擁有強健的體魄，能輕鬆抵禦敵人的傷害；在隊伍中，他們是領袖，也是他人的守護者。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman prefer to use spears, two-handed swords or combination sword and shield.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士通常使用長矛、雙手劍，或者劍盾組合。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Also the swordsman's vitality is normally high making them able to carry massive amounts of weight.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
此外，劍士的生命力通常很高，能夠攜帶大量的重量。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Desired stats are usually ^0000FFStr^000000, ^0000FFAgi^000000, ^0000FFVit^000000, ^0000FFDex^000000
Of course this is all up to you
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
推薦的屬性通常是^0000FF力量^000000、^0000FF敏捷^000000、^0000FF體質^000000、^0000FF靈巧^000000。
當然，這完全取決於你。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFVit^000000 affects ^FF0000HP recovery rate^000000.
^0000FFStr^000000 affects ^FF0000strength and attacking power^000000.
^0000FFDex^000000 increases ^FF0000accuracy of your attack^000000,

[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFAgi^000000 increases ^FF0000attacking speed^000000 and ^FF0000evasion rate^000000,
^0000FFLuk^000000 affects ^FF0000probability of critical^000000.

[Trainer Adric]
After changing to a Swordsman you can change to a ^0000FFKnight^000000 or ^0000FFCrusader^000000.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
轉職為劍士後，你可以進一步轉職為^0000FF騎士^000000或^0000FF十字軍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go raise your strength while figuring out if you're offensive or defensive.
This is something you should do.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
去提升你的力量，同時思考你是偏向進攻還是防禦。
這是你應該做的。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The study material can be retaught by Neals the assitant trainer.
Remember this.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
學習材料可以由助理訓練師尼爾斯重新講解。
請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Using the Swordman Manual I gave you train by hunting monsters.
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
使用我給你的劍士入門手冊，通過狩獵魔物來訓練。
去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Raise your level to ^006400job level 10^000000 and get to ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000, come back here again.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
將你的等級提升到^006400職業等級10^000000，並達到^006400初心者技能等級9^000000，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you have enough job levels,
you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
既然你的職業等級已經足夠，
就不需要再聽我囉嗦了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那就到此為止吧。

scripts.text: But I want to listen more.
scripts.translation: 但我還想多聽一些。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想立刻成為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You surpassed the study material to raise your level.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你超越了學習材料，提升了等級。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
令人印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
Everything I taught you if you remember them well, that's all you need.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
沒有其他特別要教你的了。
只要好好記住我教你的內容，就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need additional training,
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino
on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
如果你需要額外的訓練，
去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾。

scripts.text: This is very tedious.
scripts.translation: 這太繁瑣了。

scripts.text: I need more training.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多訓練。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想立刻成為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
A simple No would've sufficed.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
直接說“不”就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
If you think you're ready, come back here.
You need to change to a Swordsman job soon!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾。
如果你覺得準備好了，就回來找我。
你很快就需要轉職為劍士了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your transfer to a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
前往劍士公會，
繼續你的劍士轉職吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會位於依斯魯得島廣場中心的西邊。
應該很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
前往劍士公會，
繼續你的轉職之路吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會位於依斯魯得島廣場中心的西邊。
應該很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You still don't have enough to become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你還不夠資格成為劍士。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need some battle training find Subino on the first floor Armory of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
如果你需要戰鬥訓練，去學院一樓軍械庫找蘇比諾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
前往劍士公會，
繼續你的轉職之路吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會位於依斯魯得島廣場中心的西邊。
應該很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
During this period, you must train really hard.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
在此期間，你必須刻苦訓練。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Continue to improve your abilities to change to an amazing job!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
繼續提升你的能力，轉職為更厲害的職業吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You're already a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你已經是劍士了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
沒有其他特別要教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Hey! You already have a job!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
嘿！你已經有職業了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
走開！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register and come back here.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你想了解劍士嗎？
如果你想轉職，請先登記，然後回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
As you are at the enough job level, you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你的職業等級已經足夠，不需要再聽我囉嗦了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那就到此為止吧。

scripts.text: Become a swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 立刻成為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Before the training starts, you already raised your level.
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
在開始訓練之前，你已經提升了等級。
令人印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
It seems that you have fully grown.
Head to the Swordsman Guild to become a swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
看來你已經完全成長了。
前往劍士公會，成為劍士吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
The Swordsman Guild is located in Izlude square
From the center, go west.
It should be easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
劍士公會位於依斯魯得島廣場。
從中心向西走。
應該很容易找到。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You are now a swordsman!
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你現在已經是劍士了！
沒有其他特別要教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You already have another job!
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你已經有其他職業了！
走開！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prerequisite of Swordsmanhood, this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
讓我們複習一下成為劍士的先決條件，這是一次複習課！

scripts.text: Swordman key points
scripts.translation: 劍士要點

scripts.text: Heightened Attack and defense.
scripts.translation: 提升攻擊力和防禦力

scripts.text: Related stats
scripts.translation: 相關屬性

scripts.text: Additional Swordman classes?
scripts.translation: 劍士的進階職業？

scripts.text: I learned enough already.
scripts.translation: 我已經學得差不多了

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Swordsman uses strong constitution; shrugs off damage easily from foes and when in a party, is a leader and the protector of others.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
劍士擁有強健的體魄，能輕鬆抵禦敵人的傷害；在隊伍中，他們是首領和眾人的守護者。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Swordsman prefer to use spears, two-handed swords or combination sword and shield.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
劍士通常使用長矛、雙手劍，或劍盾組合。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Also the swordsman's vitality is normally high making them able to carry massive amounts of weight.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
此外，劍士的體力通常很高，能夠攜帶大量的重量。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Desired stats are usually ^0000FFStr^000000, ^0000FFAgi^000000, ^0000FFVit^000000, ^0000FFDex^000000 Of course this is all up to you
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
推薦的屬性通常是 ^0000FF力量^000000、^0000FF敏捷^000000、^0000FF體力^000000、^0000FF幸運^000000。當然，這完全取決於你。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
^0000FFVit^000000 affects^FF0000HP recovery rate^000000.
^0000FFStr^000000 affects ^FF0000strength and attacking power^000000.
^0000FFDex^00000 increases ^FF0000accuracy of your attack^000000.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
^0000FFVIT^000000影響^FF0000HP恢復速度^000000。
^0000FFSTR^000000影響^FF0000力量和攻擊力^000000。
^0000FFDEX^00000提升^FF0000攻擊命中率^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFAgi^000000 increases ^FF0000attacking speed^000000 and ^FF0000evasion rate^000000.
^0000FFLuk^000000 affects ^FF0000probability of critical ^000000.

[Assitant Trainer Neals]
After changing to a Swordsman you can change to a ^0000FFKnight ^000000or ^0000FFCrusader^000000.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
轉職為劍士後，你可以轉職為 ^0000FF騎士 ^000000或 ^0000FF十字軍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Go raise your strength while figuring out if you're offensive or defensive.
This is something you should do.
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prequisite of swordsmanhood,
this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
去提升你的力量，同時弄清楚你是偏向進攻還是防守。
這是你應該做的事情。
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
讓我們複習一下成為劍士的先決條件，
這是一次複習課！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Ask again anytime.
I'll answer everything!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
隨時都可以再問。
我會回答一切！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prequisite of swordsmanhood,
this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
讓我們複習一下成為劍士的先決條件，
這是一次複習課！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Feeble people like you can become a gallant Swordsman soon.
Yes, you can. Be ambitious.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
像你這樣柔弱的人，很快就能成為英勇的劍士。
是的，你可以。要有雄心壯志。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I am the one in charge of magic studies in Criatura Academy
^0000FFA genius Mage^000000~!
^0000FFMage Chuck^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我是克里阿圖拉學院負責魔法研究的
^0000FF天才魔法師^000000~！
^0000FF魔法師 查克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Someone like you who has magic talent but doesn't know how to become a Mage.
For a ^FF0000Novice^000000 like you I'm offering my training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
像你這樣有魔法天賦，卻不知如何成為魔法師的人。
對於^FF0000初心者^000000的你，我願意提供指導。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
How about it?
Do you wanna try out my priceless lessons?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
怎麼樣？
想試試我無價的課程嗎？

scripts.text: I will learn.
scripts.translation: 我要學習。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you don't listen to me, you'll regret of it.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
如果你不聽我的話，你會後悔的。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
When you change your mind, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
如果你改變主意了，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Good! If that's your decision, I will do my best.
How much you learn depends on your own effort.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
很好！既然這是你的決定，我會盡力的。
你能學到多少，取決於你自己的努力。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To become a Mage, you need to be very studious.
Ask me what you want to learn!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
要成為魔法師，你需要非常勤奮。
告訴我你想學什麼！

scripts.text: What is a Mage's primary role?
scripts.translation: 魔法師的主要職責是什麼？

scripts.text: What ^8B4513stats^000000 are good for Mage?
scripts.translation: 什麼^8B4513屬性^000000適合魔法師？

scripts.text: What are Mage's ^8B4513skill^000000s?
Can I try some skills?!
scripts.translation: 我可以試試技能嗎？！

scripts.text: I want to ^8B451Cchange job^000000 to Mage!
scripts.translation: 我想^8B451C轉職^000000為魔法師！

scripts.text: I'll get back to you later
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
A Mage's primary role is to use magic to inflict powerful attacks.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
魔法師的主要職責是使用魔法發動強力攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
We have low defense but have various attack ^006400skills^000000.
Be careful about the damage you take as a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我們防禦力低，但擁有各種攻擊^006400技能^000000。
作為魔法師，要小心受到的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
記住這些小事，你就能成為偉大的魔法師。
隨著魔力增長，昂首闊步吧~

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't a Mage remind you something solid?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
魔法師難道不讓你想起什麼堅實的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Sheer physical force is for brutes who increase their ^006400STR^000000.
For a ^0000FFgenius Mage^000000 like myself that's a waste.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
純粹的體力是那些提升^006400STR^000000的蠻幹者的專利。
對於像我這樣的^0000FF天才魔法師^000000來說，那是浪費。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Become wise and clever with your^006400 mind power^000000.
This is Mage's primary attribute- ^006400INT^000000, it's what's most important!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
用你的^006400精神力^000000變得睿智而聰明。
這是魔法師的主要屬性——^006400INT^000000，它是最重要的！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
記住這些小事，你就能成為偉大的魔法師。
隨著魔力增長，昂首闊步吧~

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Mages have powerful magical skills.
The basis of these skills are the attributes ^006400<Water, Wind, Earth, Fire>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
魔法師擁有強大的魔法技能。
這些技能的基礎是屬性^006400<水、風、土、火>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
As each element has its own^006400 range attack magic^000000, these are useful when dealing with many enemies~!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
每種元素都有各自的^006400範圍攻擊魔法^000000，這在對付大量敵人時非常有用~!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ok enough talk.
I will show you my power by offering a demonstration.
You should be honored to be witnessing this!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好了，說夠了。
我要通過表演來展示我的力量。
你能見證這一幕，真是你的榮幸！

scripts.text: [Mage Chuck]
scripts.translation: [魔法師 查克]

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Detecting hidden enemies
^006400Sight^000000 !!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
探測隱藏的敵人
^006400火狩^000000!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Deflect all physical attacks
^006400Safety Wall^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
反彈所有物理攻擊
^006400暗之障壁^000000!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Fire damage premier ~!!!
^006400Fire Ball^000000!!!!

[Mage Chuck]
Wall of Fire~!!
^006400Fire Wall^000000!!!!

[Mage Chuck]
Want a taste of thunder?
^006400Lightening Bolt^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
想嚐嚐雷電的味道嗎？
^006400閃電^000000!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Get lost in the storm!
^006400Thunder Storm^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
在風暴中迷失吧！
^006400雷暴術^000000!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What killed the dinosaurs?
The Ice Age!
^006400Frost Diver^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
是什麼殺死了恐龍？
是冰河時代！
^006400冰河時代^000000!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't it shake your heart to see my skills?
You won't get hurt so don't worry~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
看到我的技能，難道不讓你心潮澎湃嗎？
你不會受傷的，所以別擔心~!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I think you already received a ^FF0000Mage Manual^000000~!
I can't offer you two of them.
One is good enough~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我想你已經收到了一本^FF0000魔法師入門手冊^000000~!
我不能給你兩本。
一本就足夠了~!

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
裝備^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000後，試著使用一下技能。
然後在技能視窗中使用授予你的技能進行狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Right, you must be set with your heart firm on becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
很好，看來你已經下定決心要成為一名魔法師了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
OK! Then I'll give you a chance to taste what it is to become a Mage.
Take this ^006400Mage Manual^000000.
I'll let you borrow it!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好的！那我就給你一個機會，讓你體驗一下成為魔法師的感覺。
拿著這本^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000。
我借給你用！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
裝備^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000後，試著使用一下技能。
然後在技能視窗中使用授予你的技能進行狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
It's a valuable item so don't lose it.
If you want to become a genius ^0000FFMage^000000 like me, follow in my path.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
這是貴重物品，別弄丟了。
如果你想成為像我這樣的^0000FF天才魔法師^000000，就沿著我的道路前進吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you want to become a Mage lighten up your inventory load.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
如果你想成為魔法師，請減輕你的背包負重。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊~ 你想轉職為魔法師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I seem to have used a great deal of magic sending you before...
Because of too many students like you, I cannot send you again!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我剛才似乎消耗了大量的魔力來傳送你...
因為像你這樣的學生太多了，我無法再次傳送你！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you really want to go, then please go speak to the Kafra Staff and use their Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
如果你真的想去，請去和卡普拉 職員對話，使用他們的瞬間移動服務。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊~ 你想轉職為魔法師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To change your job to a magician, you must visit the Magician's Guild.
I can send you close to there, but...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
要轉職為魔法師，你必須前往魔法師公會。
我可以把你傳送到附近，但是...

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You must first reach ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你首先必須達到^006400職業等級 10^000000和^006400基本技能等級 9^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You don't seem ready!
If you want to change your job, you must first be ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
Then come back and see me!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你似乎還沒準備好！
如果你想轉職，首先必須達到^006400職業等級 10^000000和^006400基本技能等級 9^000000。
然後回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah, it seems that you already have those requirements!
Do you want to change your job immediately?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊，看來你已經滿足那些要求了！
你想立即轉職嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Okay, when you have decided please come back!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好的，當你決定好了請回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想知道什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
In that case, I'll use magic to send you near ^8B4513Geffen^000000, where the Magician's Guild is.
It is there that you will be able to become a magician.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
那樣的話，我會用魔法把你傳送到^8B4513吉芬^000000附近，那裡有魔法師公會。
在那裡，你將能夠成為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Once I send you, you will speak to the ^0000FFMage's Guild Guide^000000.
They will be able to assist you further.
Let's go! I'm ready to send you there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
一旦我傳送你，你就要去和^0000FF魔法師公會嚮導^000000對話。
他們會進一步協助你。
走吧！我準備好傳送你了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Whoosh Whoosh
Ooo... Ooo... Hum... Hmm!
Teleport!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
呼 呼
噢... 噢... 哼... 哼！
瞬間移動！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Yes~ Go meet other teachers then come back.
Of course, Mages are most alluring of them all.~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
是的~ 去見見其他老師，然後回來。
當然，魔法師是最迷人的~

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You'll choose Mage again I have no doubt about it~~!!
Haha see you later~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我毫不懷疑你會再次選擇魔法師~~！！
哈哈，回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
First you'll have to complete your ^8B4513registration^000000 at the Academy front desk.
If you go to the 1st floor of the academy someone will help you register.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
首先，你必須在學院前臺完成^8B4513註冊^000000。
如果你去學院一樓，會有人幫你註冊。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You're no longer the innocent ^8b4513Novice^000000 who doesn't know anything~?
I don't have anything to teach you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你不再是那個什麼都不懂的^8b4513初心者^000000了~？
我沒有什麼可教你的了~！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
It seems that you've come from Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
看來你是從克里阿圖拉學院來的。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
You look a little exhausted...
Though.. to become a magician is exhausting in a way...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
你看起來有點疲憊...
雖然...成為魔法師確實是一種消耗...

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
首先，我的任務是引導你前往魔法師公會！
一直向右走！
在^8B4513過橋^000000之後，你就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口了！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
到了那裡，
你應該能找到我們的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會嚮導]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他對話，他會繼續引導你前往魔法師公會！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
首先，我的任務是引導你前往魔法師公會！
一直向右走！
在^8B4513過橋^000000之後，你就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口了！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
到了那裡，
你應該能找到我們的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會嚮導]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他對話，他會繼續引導你前往魔法師公會！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我負責將^8B4513克里阿圖拉學院^000000的學生帶到魔法師公會。
最近學院有很多新生，我很高興能在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Ah, you made it all the way here. Very good for an academy student!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
啊，你竟然一路走到了這裡。作為學院的學生，真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Before this step-by-step guide, they would get lost and frustrated.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
在有了這種循序漸進的指引之前，他們總是迷路並感到沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Anyways, let's keep this short.
I will now tell you the route to the Mage's Guild!
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
總之，我們長話短說。
我現在就告訴你去魔法師公會的路！
路線很簡單...
從這裡出發，朝11點鐘方向走，就能看到魔法師公會了。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
直接進去，稍微上樓一點，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會成員]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
在那裡，他會協助你成為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
路線很簡單...
從這裡出發，朝11點鐘方向走，就能看到魔法師公會了。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
直接進去，稍微上樓一點，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會成員]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
在那裡，他會協助你成為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我負責將^8B4513克里阿圖拉學院^000000的學生帶到魔法師公會。
最近學院有很多新生，我很高興能在這裡工作。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ehm?
This class only for Novices just starting their adventure.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
嗯？
這個職業只適合剛開始冒險的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Looking at you, you seem like you need some help. How about going to another place?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
看你的樣子，似乎需要一些幫助。不如去別的地方看看？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
At a glance, hey, you like the lost baby sheep.. Here the non registered passengers are prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦~
一眼看去，嘿，你像是隻迷路的小羊羔...這裡禁止未登記的乘客進入。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If you want to look around this area without physical prohibiton, you would better register first at the info desk at the Academy entrance.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
如果你想在這個區域自由走動而不受限制，最好先去學院入口的資訊臺登記一下。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ho Oh~
You look like you're ready to change to a first job.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
噢~
你看起來已經準備好轉職為第一職業了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
How about it? Are you interested in the way of the Merchant? If so, I may be helpful for you.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
怎麼樣？你對商人的道路感興趣嗎？如果是的話，我或許能幫到你。

scripts.text: Not interest.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text: Interested.
scripts.translation: 感興趣

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh.. No...
Well, there is no way. Our Criatura Academy put the priority to the adventurer's choice.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦...不...
好吧，沒辦法。我們克里阿圖拉學院尊重冒險者的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Then, I will send you to the town of Alberta. There you can become a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
很好~ 那麼，我將把你送到艾爾貝塔。在那裡你可以成為商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Do not go elsewhere, immediately enter the town.
Find the <NAVI>[Forge]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
不要亂跑，立即進入城鎮。
找到<NAVI>[鍛造廠]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Not yet ready.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好

scripts.text: I'm Ready!
scripts.translation: 我準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, I understand. When you are ready, let me see you again.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是的，我理解。當你準備好了，再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Please go to the Forge and find me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
很好~ 請去鍛造廠找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
Hey, you like a lost sheep. Do you know why you've come here?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦~
嘿，你看起來像只迷路的羊。你知道自己為什麼來這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Don't Know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh... you don't?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦...你不知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ you seem like a quick learner.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦~ 看來你學得挺快。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Well, I should at least give a briefing.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好吧，我至少應該做個簡要介紹。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
I am ^0000ffSalim Hamid^000000 in charge with training the merchant course here at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
我是^0000ff薩利姆·哈米德^000000，負責在克里阿圖拉學院教授商人課程。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This classroom is for Merchant applicants. In fact, this room is mainly for doing the finacial management of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
這間教室是給申請成為商人的學員用的。實際上，這個房間主要用於處理克里阿圖拉學院的財務管理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Next time, if you want to observe the merchant course, you can visit me, Salim Hamid and register.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
下次，如果你想旁聽商人課程，可以來找我，薩利姆·哈米德，進行註冊。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ You came back. Do you want to experience the Merchant training course? It is a little bit difficult to the average beginner.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦~ 你回來了。你想體驗一下商人培訓課程嗎？這對普通初學者來說有點難。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝！

scripts.text: Sign me up!.
scripts.translation: 給我報名！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ though it is a bit hard, it is worth learning. Sadly, there's no other way.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦~ 雖然有點難，但值得學習。遺憾的是，沒有其他辦法。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh, yes... Then, first will you register your name in this student list?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦，對了...那麼，首先你要在這個學員名單上登記你的名字嗎？

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text: Put your name on the list.
scripts.translation: 把名字寫在名單上

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Resistance from the beginning? This isn't the way to start training.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
一開始就抗拒？這不是開始訓練的方式。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ummm~ Your name is...
^0000ff{0}^000000...... right?

[Salim Hamid]
First to observe the Merchant course, you need to have the Merchant mindset. A trader with less than 100 zeny could not be called a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
首先，要旁聽商人課程，你需要具備商人的心態。一個持有Zeny少於100的商人不能被稱為商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
{0}^000000 come back to me with 100 Zeny in hand before the next class.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
{0}^000000，在下節課之前，帶著100 Zeny回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, that money won't be taken. It is only A test to see your basic mindset to being a Merchant. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
當然，那筆錢不會被拿走。這只是測試你作為商人的基本心態。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Wow, you really came back with 100 zeny in hand. I feel your desire to learn clearly.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哇，你真的帶著100 Zeny回來了。我能清楚地感受到你學習的渴望。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now. I will give you a Merchant's manual. Equipped with it. Press Alt + S key and look at the skill window.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
現在，我會給你一本《商人入門手冊》。裝備上它，按下Alt + S鍵，檢視技能視窗。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Clicking the [MISC] tab on the skill window, you can see the Merchant manual skills.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
點選技能視窗中的[雜項]標籤，你就能看到商人手冊的技能了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now~ as we should go to the next course, equip the guide and see the skill, then speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
現在~ 既然我們要進入下一課，請裝備好手冊並檢視技能，然後再來和我對話。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hohohong.. Test is not easy? Will you give it up now?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
呵呵呵... 測試不容易嗎？你要現在放棄嗎？

scripts.text: Can't do it.
scripts.translation: 做不到

scripts.text: Give it up.
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Will you? 100 zeny isn't hard to get pal.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你要放棄嗎？100 Zeny並不難賺，小傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好吧，等你改變主意時，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, how about attending the class concerning various basic skills which merchants should have for making money.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，現在來上一堂關於商人賺錢所需的各種基本技能的課吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This might be better for you to learn from the steward working on the field next door. Go to him for the Merchant theory course, then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
也許讓你去隔壁田裡工作的管家那裡學習會更好。去那裡上商人理論課，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Haven't you gone to him for the class? Go to the steward next to me and return after completing the Merchant skill theory.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你還沒去上那堂課嗎？去我旁邊的管家那裡，完成商人技能理論後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Have you come after a good lesson from the steward concerning what a Merchant can do?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你聽完管家關於商人能做什麼的課了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
By any chance, {0} do you have mind to learn more about Merchants here?
