scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
順便問一下，{0}，你想在這裡多瞭解一些關於商人的知識嗎？

scripts.text: I will look around at more jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想看看其他職業

scripts.text: Let me do it a little more.
scripts.translation: 讓我再學一會兒

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, your open mind is good for you. As this academy has many other lecturers besides Merchants.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是的，你這種開放的心態對你很有好處。畢竟這所學院除了商人，還有很多其他講師。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Whenever you feel like learning again, come back to me {0}.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
無論何時你想再學習，都歡迎回來找我，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Is that so? OK, now how about learning the major effects of Merchant's stats? If you are ready, speak to me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是嗎？好的，那麼現在來學習一下商人屬性的主要作用吧。如果你準備好了，就來和我對話。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Trader's stats are classified as two major series. One is for manufacturing, the other is for battle.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
商人的屬性分為兩大系列。一個是用於製造的，另一個是用於戰鬥的。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, these are for farther down in the future. At this moment, you are even short of stats to invest DEX enabling you to hunt a monster.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
當然，這些是更長遠的事情。就現在而言，你甚至缺乏足夠的DEX（敏捷）來狩獵魔物。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But, there is a big difference between your knowledge of the basic rules and being ignorant of it.
Let's learn about it one by one.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
但是，瞭解基本規則與對此一無所知有著天壤之別。
讓我們逐一學習吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，我們從哪個系列開始呢？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，我們從哪個系列開始呢？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，這節課就到此結束了。
如果您對商人還有更多疑問，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text: Already know it.
scripts.translation: 我已經知道了。

scripts.text: Battle Stats.
scripts.translation: 戰鬥屬性。

scripts.text: Crafting Stats.
scripts.translation: 製造屬性。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It will be OK as it is, won't it?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
保持現狀也沒問題，對吧？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 我全都知道了。

scripts.text: Please make another explanation.
scripts.translation: 請再解釋一遍。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, you are {0} I am pleased to meet a quick-to-learn student like you. It also saves my time.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是的，你是{0}。很高興遇到像你這樣學得快的學生。這也節省了我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Aha~ I think I got you wrong. Let's start the lecture again.
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
啊哈~ 看來我誤會你了。讓我們重新上課吧。
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，這節課就到此結束了。
如果您對商人還有更多疑問，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Being in a trader role, the stats affecting the figure of battle power are two ^4d4fffSTR & DEX^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
作為商人，影響戰鬥力的屬性主要有兩項：^4d4fffSTR（力量）和DEX（敏捷）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
STR is related to the basic attacking power, DEX is to hit ratio and recovery from damage.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
STR與基礎攻擊力相關，DEX則影響命中率以及從傷害中恢復的速度。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
In you future, according to the 2nd and 3rd jobs you choose, you can learn additional attacking stats such ^4d4fffINT or AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
在未來，根據你選擇的二轉或三轉職業，你還可以學習額外的攻擊屬性，例如^4d4fffINT（智力）或AGI（敏捷）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
To back up your shortage, you can increase LUK a little.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
為了彌補不足，你可以適當提高一點LUK（幸運）。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Rather than worry yourself, it may be a good idea to learn from other Merchants. You know ask others for advice.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
與其自己憂心忡忡，不如向其他商人學習。你知道的，向他人尋求建議是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
還有其他問題嗎？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，這節課就到此結束了。
如果您對商人還有更多疑問，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The stats concerning crafting is simpler than that concerning battle. Only difficulty is how to cultivate it.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
與戰鬥相關的屬性相比，製造相關的屬性更簡單。唯一的難點在於如何培養。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It is common that you increase ^4d4fffDEX & LUK^000000 as the base and, if you have surplus, you invest the rest in ^4d4fffINT^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
通常的做法是以^4d4fffDEX（敏捷）和LUK（幸運）^000000為基礎，如果有剩餘的點數，則投入^4d4fffINT（智力）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, the allocation of the portion should be properly adjusted in accordance with your equipments and the status you are in.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
當然，具體的點數分配應根據你的裝備和當前狀態進行適當調整。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
One thing you should keep in mind is it may be a very boring and ascetic way to grow alone as Merchant specializing in crafting.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
有一點需要牢記：作為專注於製造的商人，獨自成長的過程可能會非常枯燥且清苦。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If possible, make use of your friends and their items if you can.
This is my personal opinion only.
It is absolutely not the official standpoint of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
如果可能的話，儘量利用朋友及其物品。
這只是我個人的看法。
這絕對不是克里阿圖拉學院的官方立場。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
還有其他問題嗎？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，這節課就到此結束了。
如果您對商人還有更多疑問，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那麼，這節課就到此結束了。
如果您對商人還有更多疑問，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You came back again. {0} this time, shall we have a practical training by doing a simple errand?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你又回來了。這次，{0}，我們要通過完成一個簡單的跑腿任務來進行實戰訓練嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Can you see the noisy vending machine at the corner of this classroom? It was originally a soft drink vending machine but swallows coin very much...
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你能看到教室角落裡那臺吵鬧的自動售貨機嗎？它原本是一臺軟飲料自動售貨機，但吞幣非常厲害...

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Anyway, due to this reason, it is now being used for the trainees' practice of skills. Please check the prices for Garlet and Zargon.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
總之，由於這個原因，它現在被用於學員的技能練習。請檢視加勒結晶和剎勒空結晶的價格。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But! You should come back wit the information about ^4d4fffthe discounted prices equipped with the merchant's manual and applied with the discount rate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
但是！你應該帶著^4d4fff裝備了商人手冊並應用了折扣率後的低價^000000資訊回來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Don't buy them. Just come back with the checked prices only. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
不要購買它們。只需要帶著查好的價格回來即可。你能做到嗎？

scripts.text: I will do it next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再做。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我會去做的。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. Then you challenge it next time.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好的。那麼下次再挑戰吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好的~ 回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes. Let's see the prices you checked.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是的。讓我們看看你查到的價格。

scripts.text: I will come back after rechecking them.
scripts.translation: 我重新核對後再回來。

scripts.text: Garlet 39z Zargon 450z
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶 39z 剎勒空結晶 450z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 448z
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶 37z 剎勒空結晶 448z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 446z
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶 37z 剎勒空結晶 446z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 444z
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶 37z 剎勒空結晶 444z

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. You come back after rechecking them in detail.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好的。你重新仔細核對後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK~ You correctly checked the prices equipped with Merchant's Manual.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好的~ 你正確地查到了裝備商人手冊後的價格。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Perhaps, if you become a Merchant and use the high level of discount skill, you can buy what you want at much cheaper prices.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
也許，如果你成為商人，並使用高等級的低價買進技能，就能以更低的價格買到你想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The practice of overcharge will be the same.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
高價賣出的練習也是同樣的道理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You don't need to practice the overcharge as well. You experience it while selling items earned during the other courses.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你不需要專門練習高價賣出。在修讀其他課程期間出售物品時，你自然會體驗到它。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now the Merchant training at the Academy is finished.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
現在，學院裡的商人訓練結束了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Did you correctly check them?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你核對正確了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hahaha. {0} you have completed the Merchant theory course at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哈哈。{0}，你已完成克里阿圖拉學院的商人理論課程。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
When you want to test the other battle skills in the Merchant's Manual,
visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
如果你想測試商人手冊中的其他戰鬥技能，請前往一樓的<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You can fully experience the battle related practice through him.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
通過他，你可以充分體驗與戰鬥相關的練習。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The guide for the next course {0} will be serviced when you reach job level 10. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
下一門課程的嚮導{0}將在你達到職業等級10時提供服務。祝你好運。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded.
scripts.translation: - 由於你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Mr. Hamid sent you here. Nice to meet you. Being busy in organizing the account book, I will make time for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哈米德先生派你來的。很高興見到你。我正在整理賬本，我會抽出時間接待你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
There are many ways to make margin on trading.. A threat, a concillation, black-market dealings, etc.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
在貿易中獲取利潤有很多方法...威脅、和解、黑市交易等等。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If necessary, even various violent and bloody shortcuts (wow this guy is serious!)
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
如果有必要，甚至可以使用各種暴力和血腥的捷徑（哇，這傢伙很認真！）

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
OH wait, what did I tell you?
These are legally prohibited behaviors. So, Merchants will be given two skills. Those are ^4d4fffOvercharge and Discount^000000..
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哦等等，我剛才說了什麼？
這些是法律禁止的行為。所以，商人將獲得兩個技能。它們是^4d4fff高價賣出和低價買進^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides, there are some other helpful skills such as ^4d4fffPush Cart Vending, Item Appraisal^000000 etc.. Which are not related directly to them though.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
此外，還有一些其他有用的技能，例如^4d4fff手推車、物品鑑定^000000等。雖然它們與上述技能沒有直接關係。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Any questions among them?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
你對其中有任何疑問嗎？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 我全都知道了。

scripts.text: Overcharge & Discount
scripts.translation: 高價賣出與低價買進

scripts.text: Other skills
scripts.translation: 其他技能

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鑑定

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Really are you OK with it?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
你真的確定嗎？

scripts.text: Wait I know it all.
scripts.translation: 等等，我全都知道了。

scripts.text: No, please explain them again.
scripts.translation: 不，請再解釋一遍。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ You don't have any questions?
OK. You are a person of practice rather than of theory.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
呵呵~ 你沒有任何問題嗎？
好吧。看來你是注重實踐而非理論的人。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
The additional lecture will be provided by Mr. Salim Hamid. Ah. I have something to give you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
接下來的課程將由薩利姆·哈米德先生負責。啊，我還有東西要給你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This is a box containing the defective equipments leaving from the inventory organization here.
Please practice the Item Appraisal skill in the Merchant Manual with it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
這是一個裝有整理庫存時留下的瑕疵裝備的箱子。
請用它來練習《商人入門手冊》中的物品鑑定技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I anticipate to see you next time in a good shape.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
期待下次見到你時，你能以更好的狀態出現。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ Sorry but I got you wrong.
Let's start the class.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
呵呵~ 抱歉，是我誤會了。
讓我們開始上課吧。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
It is simple to use Overcharge and Discount.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
高價賣出和低價買進的使用很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
These two skills are passive skills. If you become familiar with these, {0} these will automatically perform in trading with merchant NPC without your operation.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
這兩項技能是被動技能。熟悉之後，{0}，在與商人NPC交易時，無需手動操作即可自動生效。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Once you've learned Overcharge, when selling commodities to a merchant NPC, you can gain the sales money composed of the regular sales price plus additional money as per the Overcharge skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
學會高價賣出後，當你向商人NPC出售商品時，除了正常的售價外，還能根據技能等級獲得額外的收益。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Oppositely, Discount is the skill, on your buying commodities from a merchant NPC, you can purchase it at the price discounted on the regular selling price as per the skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
相反，低價買進則是當你從商人NPC購買商品時，可以根據技能等級以低於正常售價的價格購買。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Be carefult that these two skills are to be used only in trading with usual merchant's NPC, not with other manufacturing NPC or among adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
請注意，這兩個技能僅在與普通商人NPC交易時使用，不適用於其他製造類NPC或冒險者之間的交易。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Do you have more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Enlarge Weight Limit, Push Cart, Vending. These three skills have close relationships.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
負重量上升、手推車、露天商店。這三個技能有著密切的關係。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
First talking about ^4d4fffEnlarge Weight Limit^000000 skill, is the skill to increase th character's basic earned points. It is an automatic operational passive skill when you learn it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
首先說說^4d4fff負重量上升^000000技能，它是用來增加角色基礎負重上限的技能。學會後，它是一個自動生效的被動技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This earned point skill reaching a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffPush Cart^000000
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
當這個負重技能達到一定等級時，你就可以使用名為^4d4fff手推車^000000的技能了。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
But this Push Cart skill has the disadvantage of the slowdown of moving speed, though the advantage of high loading capacity.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
但是手推車技能有一個缺點，就是移動速度會變慢，不過它的優點是載重量很高。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
When this Push Cart skill reaches at a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffVending^000000. This is used to sell your own items to other players.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
當手推車技能達到一定等級時，你就可以使用名為^4d4fff露天商店^000000的技能了。這是用來向其他玩家出售自己物品的。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除了這些，你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Item Appraisal skill is a supplementary skill rather than the essential one.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
物品鑑定技能是一個輔助技能，而不是必須的技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If you learn this skill you can identify items without having to use a Magnifying Glass Item.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
如果你學會這個技能，就可以直接鑑定物品，而不需要使用放大鏡道具。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除了這些，你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I am very busy clearing an account book, so how about talking next time?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
我正在忙著整理賬本，下次再來找我談吧？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.......... Then
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……那麼

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see, Lu make it as you want.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
明白了，盧，隨你便吧。

scripts.text: Uh, hi...
scripts.translation: 呃，你好……

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am sorry...
Are you a student of Criatura Academy?
I didn't intend to ignore you.
He is also one of the students in this class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
抱歉……
你是克里阿圖拉學院的學生嗎？
我並沒有故意無視你。
他也是這個班的學生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Hello {0}
I am Mayssel  the section chief of the Veins section of the Assassin Guild.
I came here to give you some information about the Thief class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你好，{0}
我是梅塞爾，刺客公會伯仁斯分部的主管。
我來這裡是為了向你介紹盜賊職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Do you want to know about the Thief class?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你想了解盜賊職業嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請。

scripts.text: No, I won't be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 不，我不想成為盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want it....
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你想要的話……

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Well a thief is commonly thought of as a criminal.
But our guild is not about taking from those that are in need of it.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
通常人們認為盜賊是罪犯。
但我們的公會並不是從那些需要幫助的人那裡奪取財物。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
First, we should make it clear.
We don't steal other's belongings.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
首先，我們要明確一點。
我們不偷竊他人的財物。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
How about monsters?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
那魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Now monsters...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
至於魔物……

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Hey, take it easy.
You said it was a mission for something important. But only a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
嘿，冷靜點。
你說這是為了重要的任務。但只有這種地方……

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I was upset...
Let me continue.
A Thief uses techniques that common thieves use to be fast and nimble.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我有點激動……
讓我繼續說。
盜賊使用普通盜賊的技巧，以追求速度和敏捷。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
We use stealth to blend into our surroundings and strike our foes.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我們利用暗影追蹤融入周圍環境，並攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Our primary weapon is a dagger and we compensate their attack strength by adding poison property to our attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我們的主要武器是短劍，我們通過給攻擊附加毒素屬性來彌補攻擊力的不足。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The higher class jobs in Thief class are Assassin and Rogue.
Verkhasel is a Guillotine Cross which is the third class of the Assassin Job.
and......
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
盜賊職業的高階職業是刺客和流氓。
維爾卡塞爾是十字斬首者，這是刺客職業的第三轉職。
還有……

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Mr. Vicente... I called Dumk..
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
維森特先生……我剛才叫的是鄧克……

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, that is... Mayssel..
As you know well about Master.
I can explain about Rogues to you.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊，那是……梅塞爾……
正如你所知，關於師父的事。
我可以向你解釋一下流氓職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see...
{0} Sorry but you can learn about the Shadow Chaser class from them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了……
{0} 抱歉，關於逐影獵人的職業介紹，您可以向他們請教。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Anyway, these two gentlemen will help you.
^4d4dffCome back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
總之，這兩位先生會協助你的。
^4d4dff請在與維爾卡塞爾和維森特交談後回來找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you learned something about Thief, Assassin and Rogue?
You don't need to understand everything right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你瞭解盜賊、刺客和流氓了嗎？
現在不需要完全理解所有內容。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
The next course is how to use the experience guide... Let's skim it over.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責告知大家這些職業的存在……
下一課是如何使用經驗指南……讓我們快速瀏覽一下。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The guide for skill experience provided by the academy can be used up to level 12.
Regretfully, only the explanation is available for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
學院提供的技能經驗指南可以使用到12級。
遺憾的是，目前只能向你提供說明。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你想成為盜賊，只需回到這裡。
我可以幫你完成轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
謝謝你的努力。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
Then, let's talk about the Thief's skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責告知大家這些職業的存在……
那麼，讓我們來談談盜賊的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will give you the guide to borrow the thief's skill temporarily.
Organize the guide items, you can see the useful skills on the 'ETC' skill window.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我會給你一份指南，讓你暫時借用盜賊的技能。
整理指南物品後，你可以在“其他”技能視窗中看到有用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
By making use of the guide, you may take the missions being asked by Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
利用指南，你可以接受維爾卡塞爾和維森特釋出的任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Verkhasel and Vicente will give you various information related to the higher class jobs.
So, come back to me after listening to them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
維爾卡塞爾和維森特會給你提供關於高階職業的多種資訊。
所以，請在聽完他們的講解後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Preparation for real battle is next.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
接下來是實戰準備。

scripts.text: I see...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is completed.
Come back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
任務完成後我會給你補償。
請在與維爾卡塞爾和維森特交談後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see..
This course is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了……
這節課現在取消了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you learned something about Thief, Assassin and Rogue?
You don't need to understand everything right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你瞭解盜賊、刺客和流氓了嗎？
現在不需要完全理解所有內容。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...?
The next course is how to use the experience guide... Let's skim it over.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責告知大家這些職業的存在……？
下一課是如何使用經驗指南……讓我們快速瀏覽一下。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The  guide for skill experience provided by the academy can be used up to level 12.
Regretfully, only the explanation is available for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
學院提供的技能經驗指南可以使用到12級。
遺憾的是，目前只能向你提供說明。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你想成為盜賊，只需回到這裡。
我可以幫你完成轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You've worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
Then, let's talk about the Thief's skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責告知大家這些職業的存在……
那麼，讓我們來談談盜賊的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will give you the guide to borrow the thief's skill temporarily.
Organize the guide items, you can see the useful skills on the 'ETC' skill window.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我會給你一份指南，讓你暫時借用盜賊的技能。
整理指南物品後，你可以在“其他”技能視窗中看到有用的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
By making use of the guide, you may take the missions being asked by Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
利用指南，你可以接受維爾卡塞爾和維森特釋出的任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you got a sense what it is to be a Thief?
If you want to use the skill like double attack, visit ^4d4dffMr. Subino on the 1st floor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你有感覺到成為盜賊的感覺了嗎？
如果你想使用二刀連擊等技能，請去^4d4dff一樓找蘇比諾先生^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
<NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> will give you several battle missions.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> 會給你幾個戰鬥任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I hope you experience other skills with battle Quests.
Double attack is somewhat an exciting skill.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
希望你能通過戰鬥任務體驗其他技能。
二刀連擊是一個相當令人興奮的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Make a decision after you've at least experienced it.
You still have a long way and enough time before you make a decision... Think of it deeply.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
至少體驗過之後再做決定吧。
在你做出決定之前，還有很長的路要走，也有足夠的時間……請深思熟慮。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你想成為盜賊，只需回到這裡。
我可以幫你完成轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for you hard work.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
感謝你的辛勤付出。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
In the battle training, the actual fighting is more important than theory.
To use the skill once is better than all this talking.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
在戰鬥訓練中，實戰比理論更重要。
使用一次技能勝過千言萬語。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you carry out the mission asked by Verkhasel and Vicente, I will go to the next class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你完成了維爾卡塞爾和維森特釋出的任務，我就進入下一節課。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is complete.
Come back to me after listening to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
任務完成後我會給予你補償。
聽完維爾卡塞爾和維森特的話後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see.
This course is now cancelled.
The ongoing lower courses are cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了。
這門課程現在取消。
正在進行的低階課程也一併取消。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes, cancel the course.
scripts.translation: 是的，取消課程

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Fortunately...
Good to see you have patience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
幸好……
很高興看到你有耐心。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
All the ongoing courses are cancelled.
These are not your aptitude.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
所有正在進行的課程都取消了。
這些並不適合你的天賦。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
What are you curious about?
If you want to know about battle, visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你對什麼感到好奇？
如果你想了解戰鬥，請去<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>那裡。

scripts.text: Change job to Thief.
scripts.translation: 轉職為盜賊

scripts.text: Thief Stat Explanation
scripts.translation: 盜賊屬性說明

scripts.text: Thief Skill Explanation
scripts.translation: 盜賊技能說明

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You made up your mind.
Welcome to the world of shadows.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你下定決心了。
歡迎來到陰影的世界。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you are ready, I will send you to the deserts of Morocc to embrace the shadows.
The journey will be both strange and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果你準備好了，我將把你送往莫洛克的沙漠去擁抱陰影。
這段旅程既新奇又充滿挑戰。

scripts.text: At once please.
scripts.translation: 請立刻出發

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Yes, after a sufficient survey of other jobs, you may make a decision.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
是的，在充分調查其他職業後，你可以做出決定。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffFind the Pyramid^000000 in the ^4d4dffNorthwest^000000 of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
在摩洛克^4d4dff西北方^000000尋找^4d4dff金字塔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I'm sorry but you are short of job levels to change your job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
很抱歉，您的職業等級不足，無法轉職。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Level composes of Base level and Job level.
Job level is what determines your current job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
等級由基礎等級和職業等級組成。
職業等級決定了您當前的職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThe 1st job condition condition is job level 10.^000000
You need more experience so fight more and level up first.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff一轉的條件是職業等級10。^000000
您需要更多的經驗值，所以請先多戰鬥並提升等級。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You want to know more about stats?
As Vicente already told you, stats don't have a fixed answer.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
您想更多地瞭解屬性嗎？
正如維森特告訴您的那樣，屬性並沒有固定的答案。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If I choose one among them,
^4d4dffAGI is related to flee ability^000000,
^4d4dffDex is related with hit ratio
STR raises physical attacking power^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果我在其中選擇一個，
^4d4dffAGI與移花接木能力有關^000000，
^4d4dffDEX與命中率有關，
STR提升物理攻擊力^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Vit, Luk, Int are valued according your target chosen.
For your reference, Verkhasel has high level of Luk.
A weapon called Katar is good for Critical.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
VIT、LUK和INT的價值取決於您選擇的目標。
供您參考，維爾卡塞爾擁有很高的LUK。
一種名為拳刃的武器很適合暴擊。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
But thief's primary weapon is a dagger.
In the end, you have only to supplement your weak point, after evaluating you and your enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
但盜賊的主要武器是短劍。
最終，您只需要在評估自己和敵人後，彌補自己的弱點即可。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If your attack doesn't hit the enemy, you come to think of the hit ratio.
Hope you find the right stats that are suitable to your fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果您的攻擊無法命中敵人，您就會想到命中率。
希望您能找到適合自己戰鬥風格的正確屬性。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Which skill are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
您對哪個技能感到好奇？

scripts.text: Improve Dodge
scripts.translation: 殘影

scripts.text: Double attack
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊

scripts.text: Hiding and Steal
scripts.translation: 隱匿和偷竊

scripts.text: Envenom and Detoxify
scripts.translation: 施毒和解毒

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
As the name implies, ^4d4dffthis skill increases a certain amount of evasion ratio^000000
You want to avoid taking damage from enemy attack, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
顧名思義，^4d4dff這個技能會增加一定比例的迴避率^000000
您想要避免受到敵人攻擊的傷害，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThis skill allows you to deal two damages with only one attack.^000000
Even though this dagger looks poor, it can damage your enemy severely by the fast two attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff這個技能允許您僅用一次攻擊造成兩次傷害。^000000
雖然這把短劍看起來不起眼，但通過快速的兩次攻擊，它可以對敵人造成嚴重傷害。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffHiding means exactly that... to hide.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff隱匿的意思就是...躲藏。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffSteal is the skill of stealing enemy's items^000000.
You can steal one item from one enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff偷竊是竊取敵人物品的技能^000000。
您可以從一名敵人身上偷取一件物品。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffEnvenom is used to poison your enemy.^000000
If poisoned, it can make a physical attacks slowly eat away at your foe.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff施毒用於毒害您的敵人。^000000
如果中毒，物理攻擊會緩慢地消耗敵人的生命值。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Oppositely, the name implies, Detoxify removes poison status.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
相反，顧名思義，解毒可以移除中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is good you have enough knowledge.
Supplementary the field experiences will make you perfect.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
很高興您擁有足夠的知識。
補充實戰經驗將使您變得完美。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Is that so?
Like other job guilds, there is a limit learned through theory.
I would like to recommend you to experience battle first-hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
是嗎？
和其他職業公會一樣，僅靠理論是有侷限的。
我建議您先親身體驗一下戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are a stranger.
Excuse me but I was invited to explain about the jobs for the students,
I have no words to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
您是陌生人。
抱歉，我被邀請來為學生講解職業知識，
沒有多餘的話可以告訴您。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is almost miracle to meet you and me living far away from the light of ground.
We should abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
能在遠離地面光芒的地方遇到您和我，幾乎是個奇蹟。
我們應該遵守規定。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Attending the class, first you may be a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
要參加課程，首先您必須是克里阿圖拉學院的學生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
However, if you want the information about the thief job itself, I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
不過，如果您想了解盜賊職業本身的資訊，我會告訴您。

scripts.text: About the useful stats for a Thief
scripts.translation: 關於盜賊的有用屬性

scripts.text: About Thief's primary skills

補充實戰經驗將使您變得完美。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
After you register as a student, you can take lessons and gain more experience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
註冊成為學生後，您可以上課並獲取更多經驗。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are on the way of thief.
Thief is the 1st job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
您正在走向盜賊的道路。
盜賊是一轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Someday, you would transfer to the 2nd job.
It would be better to think of whether becoming  a Log or an Assassin now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Here is an assignment.
Can you see the ornamental Poring cage?
Steal ^4d4dffone Stone from Poring by using the Steal skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這裡有一個任務。
你能看到裝飾用的波利籠子嗎？
使用偷竊技能從波利身上偷取^4d4dff一塊石頭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal has a possibility to fail so don't quit.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
偷竊有失敗的可能性，所以不要放棄。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, excellent!
Keep the stone as a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，太棒了！
把這塊石頭留作紀念吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, it is good enough for your skill experience purpose, let's finish the class here.
If you haven't finished Mr. Verkhasel's assignment, keep going with it.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
總之，對於你的技能經驗來說已經足夠了，讓我們在這裡結束課程吧。
如果你還沒有完成維爾卡塞爾的任務，請繼續完成它。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal one Stone from a Poring.
Wasn't it fun?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
從波利身上偷取一塊石頭。
是不是很有趣？

scripts.text: It didn't give me a stone.
scripts.translation: 我沒有得到石頭。

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm? All porings were stolen of their stones?
I will summon Porings again, and you, try it once again.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯？所有的波利都被偷走了石頭嗎？
我會再召喚一些波利，你再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. Is that so?
This is not your aptitude.
I see. This mission is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯。是這樣嗎？
看來這不是你的天賦所在。
我明白了。這個任務就此取消。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ahhh. Boring, Boring...
Now I can understand why Master ran away.
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊哈。真無聊，真無聊...
現在我終於明白師父為什麼要逃走了。
我想回家了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
So do I.
Mayssel... what did she think of...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我也是這麼想的。
梅塞爾...她到底在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hmmm. Did she go AWOL?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯。她擅離職守了？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Are you kidding me?!
Would you rather be carrying out a fatal mission!?!
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你在開玩笑嗎？！
難道你想執行一個致命的任務嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah... I don't like it.
I would rather evaluate jewelry sitting at the workshop as usual...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊...我不喜歡這樣。
我還是想像往常一樣，在工作室裡鑑定珠寶...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
.... .. ..
I will accept Verkhassel's wish.
Don't worry hohoho...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
.... .. ..
我會接受維爾卡塞爾的請求。
別擔心，呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
The mood is becoming gloomy.
Should I get out of here?
scripts.translation:
氣氛變得有些陰沉。
我該離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are doing well.
I hope to see you again someday.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你做得很好。
希望有一天能再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, for your reference, I am operating a small workshop in Lighthalzen.
Visit me there someday.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊，順便告訴你，我在裡希塔樂鎮經營著一家小工作室。
有空的時候來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Perhaps, I won't forget you...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
也許，我不會忘記你...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are not a student of Criatura Academy.
If you want more explanation about this job, you better register as a student of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你並不是克里阿圖拉學院的學生。
如果你想要了解更多關於這個職業的資訊，最好去學院註冊成為學生。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Though only novices can register...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
不過只有初心者才能註冊...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, you became a good thief.
Don't you want to be a shadow chaser in your future?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，你成為了一個優秀的盜賊。
你未來不想成為逐影獵人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This is the higher class applied by the elite Rogues of good artistry.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這是由技藝精湛的精英流氓所追求的高階職業。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Above job level 40, any Thief can be transferred to a Rogue anytime.
Fortunately, the sailing service from Izlude wharf to Pharos lighthouse is available!!
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
職業等級40以上，任何盜賊都可以隨時轉職為流氓。
幸運的是，從依斯魯得島碼頭到發樂斯燈塔島的渡輪服務已經開通！！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
First, is it courteous to ask whether you can be a Rogue or not?
If it is an application for an Assassin, what happens to you?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
首先，禮貌地問一下你是否能轉職為流氓，這合適嗎？
如果是申請成為刺客，那結果會怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha. You like a bloody job?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈。你喜歡血腥的職業？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha... Calm down...
Don't respond to every tiny matter..
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈...冷靜點...
不要對每件小事都做出反應...

scripts.text: The atmosphere became very tense.
scripts.translation: 氣氛變得非常緊張。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome to the Criatura Academy.
Here, I am teaching the basics to the people wishing to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
歡迎來到克里阿圖拉學院。
在這裡，我負責教導那些希望成為盜賊的人基礎知識。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So, in other words, I am handling the Novices wanting to be thieves.
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
也就是說，我負責處理那些想成為盜賊的初心者。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What? It interrupts me.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
什麼？你在打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Eheee, Eheee, It can't be a joke.
Mayssel's class...
Did you call upon me for this kind of nasty thing?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
呵呵，呵呵，這可不是開玩笑的。
梅塞爾的課...
你叫我來處理這種麻煩事？

scripts.text: ...Let's keep working?
scripts.translation: 繼續上課

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It's a pity. That man is scary.
But as long as I am with you, don't be afraid of him.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
真遺憾。那個男人很可怕。
但只要我在你身邊，就不用怕他。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What are you talking about this time?
In the beginning, Lue.. You should not be here...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這次又怎麼了？
一開始，盧...你不應該在這裡...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.........Who am I?
Assistant.... Trainer?

[Verkhasel]
Zt...
Well, which one are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
嘖...
好吧，你對哪方面比較好奇？

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Improve Dodge and Hide
scripts.translation: 殘影和躲藏

scripts.text: About you
scripts.translation: 關於你

scripts.text: That's enough.
scripts.translation: 夠了

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You  may already know the primary weapon of a Thief is a dagger.
A Thief's specialty is the ^4d4dffDouble Attack^000000 by a dagger.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你可能已經知道盜賊的主要武器是短劍。
盜賊的專長是使用短劍進行^4d4dff二刀連擊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you are short of attacking power, it can be covered at a certain degree.
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果攻擊力不足，可以在一定程度上彌補。
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is a skill called ^4d4dffEnvenom^000000 to intoxicate your enemy with poison and
the other skill called ^4d4dffDetoxify^000000 to remove the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
有一個技能叫^4d4dff施毒^000000，可以用毒讓敵人中毒；
另一個技能叫^4d4dff解毒^000000，可以解除中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can tell the poisoned status by its very pretty purple color.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你可以通過非常漂亮的紫色來識別中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
In case, you are poisoned, venom will decrease your vitality rapidly,
you either detoxify right away or take the antidote potion.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果你中毒了，毒素會迅速降低你的生命力，
你必須立即解毒或服用解毒劑。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you have more interest in poison, you may be an assassin.
They officially use poison.
Then next!
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果你對毒更感興趣，你可能適合成為刺客。
他們正式使用毒藥。
那麼接下來！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Thiefs train the skill called ^4d4dffImprove Dodge^000000.
This makes the enemy powerless by evading its attack.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
盜賊訓練一個叫^4d4dff殘影^000000的技能。
這可以通過閃避敵人的攻擊使其無效化。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Rather than being patient after being hit, it is more suitable for a less defensive thief to avoid from it fast.
Being this reason, agility [AGI] can't be neglected.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
與其在被打中後忍耐，對於防禦力較低的盜賊來說，快速躲避更為合適。
因此，敏捷[AGI]不容忽視。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
^4d4dffHiding^000000 is the skill for refuge.
If successful, others can't see you.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
^4d4dff隱匿^000000是用於隱蔽的技能。
如果成功，其他人將無法看見你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Ah, as it is said you can't cheat a ghost.... You would be found by evil.
Also sensitive insects recognize it...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
啊，俗話說得好，你騙不了幽靈……你會被邪惡發現的。
而且敏感的昆蟲也能察覺到……

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Other than these, it will be useful for avoiding emergency situations.
When you become higher jobs like Rogue or Assassin, you can learn more useful skills like Refuge.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
除此之外，它在躲避緊急狀況時也很有用。
當你轉職為流氓或刺客後，可以學到更多實用的技能，比如隱蔽。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Me? I am a chief of the Guillotine Cross.
......
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我？我是十字斬首者的首領。
......

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
As one of the assassins, I am in charge of punishing the law violators, as the member of the execution group.
For your reference, the primary weapon of Verkhasel is Katar.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
作為刺客之一，我負責懲罰違法者，是行刑小組的成員。
供你參考，維爾卡塞爾的主要武器是拳刃。

scripts.text: How do you know that?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道的？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's my hope.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
那是我的希望。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Oh.. Smart funk~~
That's enough, Lu.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
哦.. 聰明的傢伙~~
好了，盧。
還有別的問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can steal one item from one enemy.
I feel mortified at stopping here, but it's worse to be neglected...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你可以從一個敵人那裡偷取一件物品。
我覺得停在這裡很尷尬，但被忽視更糟...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK.
Considering your favor not to ignore me, let's finish it now.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
好的。
考慮到你不忽視我的好意，我們現在就結束吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Honestly, I don't think you need to know the details about the thief's skills.
Then, just be aware there is something like that..
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
老實說，我覺得你不需要知道盜賊技能的細節。
只要知道有這種東西就行了..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean it is good enough now.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我的意思是，現在這樣就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Anything else you're curious about?
I will give you an answer after you finish Mayssel's class.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
還有什麼你好奇的嗎？
在你完成梅塞爾的課程後，我會給你答案。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean that she knows it.
Mayssel will do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我的意思是她知道。
梅塞爾會為你做的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lazy boy.
Tell me the truth... You are annoying..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
懶散的男孩。
告訴我實話... 你很煩..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
.......You........
Zt.. I don't know the enemy..

[Verkhasel]
Actual experience assignments about the skill?
To do it, your level is too high.
I can't use the guide.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
關於技能的實際經驗任務？
要做這個，你的等級太高了。
我無法使用嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Originally, I will let you hunt porings with envenom.
No way, if I can't use the skill....
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
原本，我會讓你用施毒去獵殺波利。
沒辦法，如果我不能用這個技能....

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
施毒是用於中毒的技能。
如果不讓他中毒，你可以利用毒素的特性對他造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
記住這些。對你來說可能已經足夠了。
這是讓你瞭解你能做什麼的課程。
讓我們完成技能經驗。
去和梅塞爾確認。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你做得很好。
施毒具有中毒效果，並且毒素本身也能造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
技能經驗已經足夠了。
去和梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can't equip the Thief Manual?
Your level is too high.
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你無法裝備盜賊入門手冊？
你的等級太高了。
沒有其他辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
施毒是用於中毒的技能。
如果不讓他中毒，你可以利用毒素的特性對他造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
記住這些。對你來說可能已經足夠了。
這是讓你瞭解你能做什麼的課程。
讓我們完成技能經驗。
去和梅塞爾確認。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
This is about the use of skill.
Now if you were an assassin, shall I let you test the skills related to venom which you may continue to use?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這是關於技能的使用。
現在，如果你是一名刺客，讓我測試一下你可以繼續使用的與毒素相關的技能，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Load the thief guide receved by Mayssel and open the skill window by pressing Alt+S key,
Register Envenom regisstered on the ETC compartment,  by pressing shortcut key^000000
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
載入從梅塞爾那裡獲得的盜賊嚮導，按下Alt+S鍵開啟技能視窗，
按下快捷鍵將註冊在ETC欄中的施毒^000000

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Then, approach the Poring's cage in the center of this room and
Aim at Poring, and ^4d4dff' hunt one poring by using
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
然後，靠近房間中央的波利籠子，
瞄準波利，使用^4d4dff'獵殺一隻波利

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
That's my assignment to you.
You definitely use envenom to Poring in this room.
don't go out faraway to find Porings.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這就是我的任務。
你必須在這個房間裡對波利使用施毒。
不要跑太遠去找波利。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Eummm.
It's sad..
Please accept my condolence in advance, as you can't experience envenom... hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯。
真可惜..
請提前接受我的哀悼，因為你無法體驗施毒...呵呵呵...

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
From now, I am going to hunt Poring..
...Don't misunderstand me for challenging you, as such I  want to make a bet with you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
從現在開始，我要去獵殺波利..
...別誤會我在向你挑戰，我只是想和你打個賭。

scripts.text: Lumin is betting win or loose.
scripts.translation: 盧敏正在賭輸贏。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你做得很好。
施毒具有中毒效果，並且毒素本身也能造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
技能經驗已經足夠了。
去和梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Come close to a poring cage and use envenom to poring.
You must do it only to porings in this room.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
靠近波利籠子並對波利使用施毒。
你只能對這個房間裡的波利這麼做。

scripts.text: I see..
scripts.translation: 我明白了..

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK. Until you kill all the porings in the cage, attack them with venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
好的。在殺死籠子裡所有波利之前，用毒素攻擊它們。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
These are not your aptitude.
I will cancel my assignment, and the other assignments from Mayssel to be cancelled by her.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這不是你的專長。
我會取消我的任務，梅塞爾那邊的其他任務也會由她取消。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: I will continue..
scripts.translation: 我會繼續..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Cancel the mission to hunt poring with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
取消用施毒獵殺波利的任務。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Have you changed your mind?
Then, until you kill all the poring in the cage, keep attacking them with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你改變主意了？
那麼，在殺死籠子裡所有波利之前，繼續用施毒攻擊它們。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Now you fully understand what skill venom is..
As you completed my assignment, go and check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
現在你完全理解毒素技能了..
既然你完成了我的任務，去和梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the bung finished Mayssel's class complete.
Any more questions, ask Mayssel.
It is the end of my class.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你終於完成了梅塞爾的課程。
如果還有問題，去問梅塞爾。
我的課程到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you become a thief, we may meet together in far future..
If you become an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果你成為盜賊，我們也許會在遙遠的未來再次相遇..
如果你成為刺客。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is no words to tell you guy not belonging to our academy.
In fact, I pulled out here unwillingly, I don't have mind to be kind of you...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
對於不屬於我們學院的人，我無話可說。
事實上，我是被迫來到這裡的，我並沒有想要對你們好...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Wait, Verkhasel.....
Don't get even with other innocent....
How about helping my class for me?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
等等，維爾卡塞爾.....
不要對無辜的人發火....
不如幫我代一下課？

scripts.text: ... everyone seems tense..
scripts.translation: ... 大家似乎都很緊張..

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Yo~ You...
What do you want to be?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
喲~ 你...
你想成為什麼？

scripts.text: An Assassin!
scripts.translation: 刺客！

scripts.text: A Rogue!
scripts.translation: 流氓！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Welcome to your joining in the way of bloody darness.
My comrad.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
歡迎加入血腥黑暗之道。
我的戰友。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
..............
(Verkhasel glancing at sky)
...
... Ha...!
The mood is becoming strange.
scripts.translation: 氣氛變得有些奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Go over there.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
去那邊。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh... Mr. Verkhasel...
Don't play like this among a family.
Why are you dividing us into teams?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
噢... 維爾卡塞爾先生...
家人之間不要這樣玩鬧。
為什麼要把我們分成兩隊？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I've never been in your family.
Originally, you are not a Rogue.
You were only a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我從未屬於過你們的家族。
原本，你也不是流氓。
你只是個商人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh.. No.. What a dirty word.
Have I asked you for buying something from me?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
噢.. 不.. 真是難聽的話。
我有向你買過什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
..........You look friendly.. Two of you...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
..........你們看起來關係不錯.. 你們兩個...

scripts.text: The mood has become tense.
scripts.translation: 氣氛變得緊張起來。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the guy knows everything you need.
Are you coming to watch only? Emmm?
Why don't you help the juniors without watch only?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你是那個什麼都知道的人。
你只是來看著嗎？嗯？
為什麼不多幫幫後輩，只在一旁看著呢？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務。
請整理物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Your eagerness and efforst to complete mission moved me to offer something.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你完成任務的熱情和努力打動了我，讓我想提供點東西。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
^4d4dff It is to hunt all 4 Porings here within 30 seconds^000000.
If you do, I will yield to you all the earned item in my hand.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺這裡所有的4只波利^000000。
如果你做到了，我會把手中獲得的物品全部讓給你。

scripts.text: If I fail?
scripts.translation: 如果我失敗了？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It is our bet. You have to give up yours as you lost.
Emmm. As I am generous, I will receive ^4d4dff10 beginner's red potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
這是我們的賭注。如果你輸了，就必須放棄你的東西。
嗯。既然我很大方，我會收下^4d4dff10瓶初級紅色藥水^000000。

scripts.text: Give Up.
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text: I Accept.
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Eh...
Coward!
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……呃……
膽小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Good!
Now, ^4d4dffspeak to me once you finish hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……很好！
現在，^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺4只波利後，再來與我對話。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
The intoxicated enemies won't die only from poisoning.
They only come close to death.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
中毒的敵人不會僅因中毒而死。
它們只是接近死亡狀態。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.. Why do Porings turn their back?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……為什麼波利會背對著我？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... 30 seconds have passed and you have not yet hunted 4 porings.
Then, it is not interesting.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……30秒已經過去了，你還沒有獵殺4只波利。
那麼，這就不有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
If you don't like do it... no way.
As I am generous, I disregard the bet this time.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
如果你不想做……算了。
既然我很大方，這次就免除賭注吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You may be too busy in^4d4dff hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
Hey, time passes now...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你可能正忙著^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺4只波利。^000000
嘿，時間正在流逝……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Oh... You are very powerful!
Now then, as agreed I will give you everything I have.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
哦……你非常強大！
那麼，按照約定，我會把我所有的東西都給你。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I've had a lot of fun because of you!
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
因為你，我玩得很開心！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Regretfully, 30 seconds has passed.
.....
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
遺憾地是，30秒已經過去了。
……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I will give them to you anyways.
Come on, take it.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不管怎樣，我會把它們給你的。
來吧，拿去吧。

scripts.text: Why are you treating me like this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼這樣對我？

scripts.text: Didn't I loose?
scripts.translation: 我不是輸了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You spent time with me.
Get it free. I stole them from Porings.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你陪我度過了時光。
免費送你。我是從波利那裡偷來的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
We may meet again.
Becoming familiar with others is pleasrue and sad.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我們可能會再見面。
與他人變得熟悉，既令人愉快又令人傷感。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... It may be in trouble if it dies upfront...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
……如果它先死了，可能會有麻煩……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At last, the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
終於，這一天來了。

scripts.text: Lumin changing clothes piece by piece.
scripts.translation: 盧敏正在一件一件地換衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I was carrying out my mission.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我在執行任務。

scripts.text: No need to make an excuse....
scripts.translation: 不用找藉口……

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At least to you, I don't want to be a stranger.
Forget what you saw today, as I have to introduce to the way of Thief Guild as many people as possible.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
至少對你，我不想做一個陌生人。
請忘記你今天看到的，因為我必須向儘可能多的人介紹盜賊公會的規矩。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Did you ^ff0000register with the Criatura Academy^000000?
You can register at ^ff0000information center of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
你^ff0000在克里阿圖拉學院註冊^000000了嗎？
你可以在^ff0000克里阿圖拉學院的資訊中心^000000進行註冊。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is annoying... but you need to register so you can receive ^ff0000lots of education and service of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
雖然有點麻煩……但你需要註冊，這樣才能接受^ff0000克里阿圖拉學院提供的眾多教育和服務^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh Odin!
Nice to meet you.
I am Alice Yisha ^ff0000in charge of Acolytes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哦，奧丁！
很高興見到你。
我是^ff0000負責服事事務^000000的愛麗絲·伊莎。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Welcome~
Glad to meet you again.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
歡迎~
很高興再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
If you did not select Acolyte as a job, why don't you study more about it?
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
如果你沒有選擇服事作為職業，為什麼不更多地瞭解一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
I guess you do not need my help any more.
Do you have any questions about Acolytes?
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
看來你不再需要我的幫助了。
關於服事，你還有什麼疑問嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte serves ^ff0000Odin^000000 so it can use ^ff0000Holy skills^000000 according to the will of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事侍奉^ff0000奧丁^000000，因此可以根據奧丁的意志使用^ff0000神聖技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Most skills are based on ^ff0000the purpose of treatment or aid^000000 so it is a very important job for ^ff0000party hunting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
大多數技能都基於^ff0000治療或輔助的目的^000000，因此對於^ff0000隊伍狩獵^000000來說是非常重要的職業。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is a ^ff0000hybrid job^000000 which can change ^ff0000attack type^000000 depends on increased status, but the range of weapon is narrow because they don't use fatal killing weapons for religious reason.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
這是一個^ff0000混合職業^000000，可以根據提升的屬性改變^ff0000攻擊型別^000000，但由於宗教原因不使用致命武器，所以武器範圍較窄。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte is categorized as ^ff0000support type^000000 and ^ff0000physical attack type^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事被歸類為^ff0000輔助型^000000和^ff0000物理攻擊型^000000。

scripts.text: Support type
scripts.translation: 輔助型

scripts.text: Attack type
scripts.translation: 攻擊型

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000INT^000000 is important status for ^ff0000support type Acolytes^000000.
^ff0000INT^000000 enhances ^ff0000treatment function^000000 and increases ^ff0000SP^000000 which is necessary for using skills.
It also helps ^ff0000SP recovery^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000INT^000000是^ff0000輔助型服事^000000的重要屬性。
^ff0000INT^000000能增強^ff0000治療功能^000000，並增加使用技能所需的^ff0000SP^000000。
它還有助於^ff0000SP恢復^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
But  aid type acolyte has a weakness point such as ^ff0000It is difficult to hunt alone^000000.
So it goes huning with ^ff0000party^000000 or use ^ff0000heal^000000 skill to monsters with ^ff0000fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
但是輔助型服事有一個弱點，比如^ff0000很難獨自狩獵^000000。
所以它們通常與^ff0000隊伍^000000一起狩獵，或者使用^ff0000治癒術^000000攻擊具有^ff0000火屬性^000000的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is like ^ff0000heal skill with holly power is fatal to undead with fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
就像^ff0000帶有神聖力量的治癒術對具有火屬性的不死系魔物是致命的^000000一樣。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
The important status FOR ^ff0000physical attack type^000000 acolyte is ^ff0000STR, VIT, AGI, DEX^000000.
The status seem to be complicated compare to support type but it is simple indeed.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000物理攻擊型^000000服事的重要屬性是^ff0000STR、VIT、AGI、DEX^000000。
與輔助型相比，這些屬性看起來比較複雜，但實際上很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000STR is the power, increases attack power, VIT is physical power, AGI is attack , speed and dodge, DEX increases hitting rate and skill casting speed.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000STR是力量，提升攻擊力；VIT是體質，提升物理防禦力；AGI是敏捷，提升攻擊速度、移動速度和迴避率；DEX是靈巧，提升命中率和技能施放速度。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
For the character of ^ff0000Attack type^000000, ^ff0000DEX^000000 will be most important status...no?
If the attack does not hit the enemy, the attack is meaningless.
You may increase STR, VIT, AGI according to your style.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
對於^ff0000攻擊型^000000角色來說，^ff0000DEX^000000應該是最重要的屬性...對吧？
如果攻擊無法命中敵人，那麼攻擊就沒有意義。
您可以根據自己的風格來提高STR、VIT和AGI。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
You might think an Acolyte is not strong enough because it has no attack type skill, it enables use of sub essential skills which enhance the powers as much as you want. It helps your stable hunting.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
您可能覺得服事沒有攻擊型技能，所以不夠強大，但它可以使用輔助性技能，將能力增強到您想要的程度。這有助於您穩定地進行狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
如果您還有更多問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte has lots of skills.
All those skills are useful.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事擁有許多技能。
這些技能都非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000Heal^000000 is for the wounds, It is also used to attack undead with opposite attribute.
Increase the power related to ^ff0000speed^000000 and ^ff0000[Increase Agi]^000000 to increase  ^ff0000movement speed^000000
^ff0000[Blessing]^000000 can ^ff0000enhance^000000 ^ff0000STR, INT, DEX^000000 at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000治癒術^000000用於治療傷口，也可用於攻擊具有相反屬性的不死系魔物。
提高與^ff0000速度^000000和^ff0000[增加AGI]^000000相關的屬性，可以增加^ff0000移動速度^000000。
^ff0000[天使之賜福]^000000可以同時^ff0000增強^000000^ff0000STR、INT、DEX^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000[Teleport]^000000 is to ^ff0000move^000000 to other places.
^ff0000[Warp Portal]^000000 can open a gate to the ^ff0000Places saved in memory^000000.
There are still more skills as well.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000[瞬間移動]^000000用於^ff0000移動^000000到其他地點。
^ff0000[傳送之陣]^000000可以開啟通往^ff0000記憶中儲存的地點^000000的大門。
此外還有更多技能。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask ^ff0000if you want to experience skills of an Acolyte, ask the sister next to you^000000.
Now I am reading an introductory skill.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000如果您想體驗服事的技能，請詢問您旁邊的修女^000000。
我現在正在閱讀入門技能介紹。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh my!
So.. you decided to be an Acolyte?
Odin welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哎呀！
那麼...您決定成為服事了？
奧丁歡迎您。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
您真的希望成為神的侍從嗎？
讓我看看您是否準備好了...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Please visit ^ff0000Father Mareusis^000000 at the church in the ^ff0000northeast corner^000000 of ^ff0000Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
請前往^ff0000普隆德拉^000000^ff0000東北角^000000的教堂，拜訪^ff0000馬魯西斯神父^000000。
在^ff0000職業等級10^000000時，您可以加入教會。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哎呀？您還沒有完成基礎練習嗎？！您還有很長的路要走！提高您的職業等級後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Wonderful! I'll transfer you to the local ministry at Prontera.
^ff0000Please visit Father Mareusis at the church in the northeast corner of Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
太好了！我會將您轉介到普隆德拉的當地教會。
^ff0000請前往普隆德拉東北角的教堂拜訪馬魯西斯神父。^000000
在^ff0000職業等級10^000000時，您可以加入教會。

scripts.text: Go to the field south of Prontera
scripts.translation: 前往普隆德拉南方的野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
如果您還有更多問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Good, I wish you luck~
Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
很好，祝您好運~
我們出發吧~

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
如果您還有更多問題，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...這所學院真令人驚歎？
不像我過去訓練時那樣。

scripts.text: - You have too many items. Clear inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄已滿。請清理物品欄後重試。 -

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...這所學院真令人驚歎？
不像我過去訓練時那樣。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You can ^ff0000register^000000 at the ^ff0000information center of the Criatura Academy^000000, it will be a great help.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您可以在^ff0000克里阿圖拉學院資訊中心^000000^ff0000登記^000000，這會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Ahem..~
Who are you?
Are you interested in this ^ff0000introductory course^000000?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
咳咳..~
您是誰？
您對這門^ff0000入門課程^000000感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[A nun]
This introductory manual is mysterious! It enables the ^ff0000use a couple of an Acolyte's skill^000000.
Will you borrow it?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
這本入門手冊很神秘！它允許^ff0000使用幾個服事的技能^000000。
您要借用它嗎？

scripts.text: Take the Acolyte Course.
scripts.translation: 參加服事課程

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Well.. if you are not interested.. fine.
murmuring
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
既然...您不感興趣...那好吧。
（低聲嘟囔）

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You already have one.
We do not give two.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您已經有一本了。
我們不會發放兩本。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Then, use it for good.
^ff0000Equip (double click or drag to equipment window)^000000 and open the ^ff0000skill window(Alt+S)^000000 to see the skills in manual.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
那麼，請善用它。
^ff0000裝備（雙擊或拖拽至裝備欄）^000000，並開啟^ff0000技能視窗（Alt+S）^000000檢視手冊中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I do not wish to speak to you. Leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我不想和你說話。現在離開...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
如果你想接受忍者訓練，去拜訪Hono O吧，他就在你升級的那個房間的隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[小織]
如果你想接受忍者訓練，去拜訪Hono O吧，他就在你升級的那個房間的隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
How was it?
Although he is very blunt, he does care very deeply about newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[小織]
感覺如何？
雖然他說話很直，但他其實非常關心新人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am the guide to the way of the Ninja for newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我是為新人指引忍者之道的嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am not interested in the people who are already on their path.
Take your leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我對已經踏上這條道路的人不感興趣。
請離開...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A child cannot accept the life of the Ninja.
It is not easy to qualify for such a life, so do not feel sorry...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
孩子無法承受忍者的生活。
獲得這種生活的資格並不容易，所以不要感到遺憾...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
First of all, you must enroll in the Academy and visit me again.
Everything has to follow the correct procedures and being clumsy is no excuse.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
首先，你必須註冊學院，然後再來找我。
一切都要遵循正確的程式，笨拙不是藉口。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Hmmm. So a new beginner has come eh?
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
嗯。看來來了個新初學者？
你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Explanation about the Ninja.
scripts.translation: 關於忍者的說明

scripts.text: I decided to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我決定成為忍者

scripts.text: I don't have any business here.
scripts.translation: 我沒什麼事

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A beginner wishing to be a Ninja....
Ask me what you are curious about.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
想成為忍者的初學者...
問問你好奇的事情吧。

scripts.text: What can I do if I become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成為忍者後能做什麼？

scripts.text: What is required to become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成為忍者需要什麼條件？

scripts.text: I want to experience Ninja skills.
scripts.translation: 我想體驗忍者技能

scripts.text: I don't have any worries about Ninjas.
scripts.translation: 我對忍者沒有疑問

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja is a profession that allows you to attack while sneaking for maximum damage.
As Ninja has various kinds of deception skills, which is good for soloing.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者是一種可以在潛行中發動攻擊，以造成最大傷害的職業。
由於忍者擁有各種各樣的幻術技能，因此非常適合單人作戰。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Not only can you learn Ninja technique similarly as magic, you can also make direct attacks, deal critical damage or throw knives at enemies.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
你不僅可以像魔法一樣學習忍術，還可以進行直接攻擊、造成暴擊傷害，或者向敵人投擲飛刀。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
But you can't do all of these things perfectly without sufficient equipment.
You will take more damage than others if you are hit.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
但是，如果沒有足夠的裝備，你無法完美地做到這一切。
如果你被擊中，受到的傷害會比其他人更多。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Therefore, if the person who is not completely weary of this world chooses this job, with no discretion, they will not fail.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
因此，如果一個人沒有完全厭倦這個世界，並且不加選擇地選擇了這個職業，他絕不會失敗。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja can be trained in a variety of courses.
Everything has both one merit and one demerit.
You would better make your own decision after profound consideration.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者可以接受多種課程的訓練。
每樣東西都有其優點和缺點。
你最好在深思熟慮後做出自己的決定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There are two major status which affect the degree of damages.
One is ^ff0000Power^000000, the other is ^ff0000Intelligence^000000,
Power affects the damages by^8E2323 physical attacks^000000 and^8E2323 throwing attacks^000000.
Intelligence affects the damage by ^8E2323Ninja's skill ^000000
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
有兩個主要屬性會影響傷害程度。
一個是^ff0000力量^000000，另一個是^ff0000智力^000000。
力量影響^8E2323物理攻擊^000000和^8E2323投擲攻擊^000000的傷害。
智力影響^8E2323忍者技能^000000的傷害

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
In addition to these, you can learn
other statuses not from the professional trainers like us
but from the trainers teaching the basic skills for battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
除了這些，你還可以學習其他屬性，
這些屬性不是從像我們這樣的專業訓練師那裡學到的，
而是從教授戰鬥基本技能的訓練師那裡學到的。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
For example, to raise up the hit rate,
What should you do?
To raise the defense, what do you wear? Etc...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
例如，要提高命中率，
你應該怎麼做？
要提高防禦力，你應該穿什麼？等等...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
你可以裝備這本手冊來體驗一些技能。
按下<Alt+S>開啟技能視窗，並在“雜項”選項卡中找到這些技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
學院樓下有一位訓練師，他會給你進行戰場訓練。去見他並訓練你的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
他會給你一些需要完成的任務。在戰鬥中，使用手冊來幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Make every useful moment count.
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
充分利用每一個有用的時刻。
你可以裝備這本手冊來體驗一些技能。
按下<Alt+S>開啟技能視窗，並在“雜項”選項卡中找到這些技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
學院樓下有一位訓練師，他會給你進行戰場訓練。去見他並訓練你的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
他會給你一些需要完成的任務。在戰鬥中，使用手冊來幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Do you understand everything I told you?
That's all... You don't have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
你明白我告訴你的所有事情了嗎？
就這些...你沒有任何問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I appreciate your braveness but, first of all, you have to be familiar with the current profession.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我很欣賞你的勇氣，但首先，你必須熟悉當前的職業。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Before you decide to become a Ninja,
you need to come back after reaching the novice's job level 9. Then, I will accept you.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
在你決定成為忍者之前，
你需要在達到初心者職業等級9之後回來。然後，我會接受你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
This may be your last warning.
Becoming a Ninja means leading a difficult life.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
這可能是我最後的警告。
成為忍者意味著過一種艱難的生活。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
As Ninja don't belong to a guild, it is easily obtainable to Novices.
Make sure your decision is final!
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
由於忍者不屬於公會，因此對初心者來說很容易獲得。
請確保你的決定是最終的！

scripts.text: I will reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text: I already made up my mind.
scripts.translation: 我已經下定決心了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Well thought actions can often bring good results.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
深思熟慮的行動往往能帶來好的結果。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you're so assertive, I have no choice but to guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
既然你如此堅決，我也只能帶你去那裡了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will send you close to where you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我會把你送到可以轉職的地方附近。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will give you a special hint.
Amatsu town is where you are going to arrive. Find the hidden tunnel in a vacant house.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我給你一個特別的提示。
你將到達櫻花城。在一棟空房子裡找到隱藏的隧道。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There you will meet a person who will guide you to becoming a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
在那裡，你會遇到一位能引導你成為忍者的人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you get lost in the town, well there is no way... Being ninja requires a level of observation power.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
如果你在城裡迷路了，那就沒辦法了...成為忍者需要具備一定的觀察力。

scripts.text: -Select ^ff0000Confirm^000000 to go to Amatsu.
scripts.translation: -選擇 ^ff0000確認^000000 前往櫻花城。

scripts.text: Confirm
scripts.translation: 確認

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
............

[Ninja Guide]
......

[Ninja Guide]
I have no words to say, if you don't have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
如果你沒有事找我，我無話可說。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hello? My name is Han to lead the next generation of refining culture in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你好？我是韓，致力於引領盧恩·米德加茲下一代的精煉文化。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Entering this market lately, if I don't have old customers, it is not easy to operate. So, I do the advertising by myself.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
最近進入這個市場，如果沒有老顧客，經營起來並不容易。所以，我自己來做宣傳。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Are you interested in ^3E86C3refining^000000 to make your items strong?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你對 ^3E86C3精煉^000000 感興趣嗎？它可以強化你的物品。

scripts.text: I have no interest.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣。

scripts.text: refining? Is it edible?
scripts.translation: 精煉？能吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah, I am sorry. I caught a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
啊，抱歉。我打擾到一位忙碌的人了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Refining means to strenghthen your equipments with  ^3E86C3rare metal^000000 obtainable from monsters and so on.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
精煉是指使用從魔物等處獲得的 ^3E86C3稀有金屬^000000 來強化你的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
If weapons are refined, their attacking power increases. If shields are refined, their defensive power increasesand helps to reduce pain against monster's hits on you.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
如果武器經過精煉，攻擊力會增加。如果盾牌經過精煉，防禦力會增加，並有助於減輕魔物攻擊帶來的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
So you kind of get the jist of it right?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
所以，你大概明白其中的道理了吧？

scripts.text: Oh... refining...

[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, that's it. Refining is good but it can get addicting.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
沒錯，就是這樣。精煉雖然好，但很容易讓人上癮。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I don't usually do it, but will give you a special chance to experience refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我平時不這麼做，但這次給你個特別機會，讓你體驗一下精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Whatever 1st level weapon level can be used it doesn't matter! If you use the ^3E86C3refining machine Wagjak^000000 over there!!
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
無論是一級還是其他等級的武器，都可以使用！只要用那邊的^3E86C3精煉機 瓦格傑克^000000就行！！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^I will give you ^FD4F02just! one refining service free of charge.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
^我會給你^FD4F02一次！免費的精煉服務。^000000

scripts.text: Only once?
scripts.translation: 只有一次？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hey I need to make a living you know! Don't go telling everyone I'm doing this for free ok?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
喂，我也得謀生啊！別到處去說我是免費做的，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You haven't used the refining machine Wagjak.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你還沒有使用過精煉機 瓦格傑克。

scripts.text: Refining Machine Wagjak
scripts.translation: 精煉機 瓦格傑克

scripts.text: Why is it called Wagjak?
scripts.translation: 為什麼叫瓦格傑克？

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 還有什麼我該知道的嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The refining machine Wagjak is a machine I made after 8 years of research.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
這臺精煉機 瓦格傑克是我經過8年研究製造出來的機器。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I made it for more precious refining. It is my personal refining machine. Well, thanks to it, I have made several contracts.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我製造它是為了更珍貴的精煉。這是我的私人精煉機。多虧了它，我簽訂了好幾份契約。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The name doesn't mean anything it's just a name. Wagjak! What a weird name right?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
這個名字沒什麼特別含義，只是個名字而已。瓦格傑克！是不是很奇怪的名字？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Absolutely!
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
絕對沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
But I subscribe to the idea that seeing is believing... You know what I mean? Try it out yourself instead of asking questions.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
但我相信眼見為實...你懂我意思吧？與其問東問西，不如親自去試試。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ohoh... as you don't have a service coupon.. You may have already used Wagjak...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
哦哦...既然你沒有服務券...你可能已經用過瓦格傑克了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I hope you have a brief understanding of refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我希望你對精煉有初步的瞭解。

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 還有什麼我該知道的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, yes, we have... Safety refining indications and refining price... such small things...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
是的，是的，我們有...安全精煉說明和精煉價格...這類小事...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
For an explanation ^3E86C3weapon levels^000000 & ^3E86C3safety refining^000000...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
關於^3E86C3武器等級^000000和^3E86C3安全精煉^000000的說明...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You can learn from ^3E86C3Mr. Taddae^000000 selling Phracon and Emveteracon
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你可以向出售強化武器金屬-級數一和Emveteracon的^3E86C3塔達埃先生^000000學習。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I recommend you visit and listen to Mr. Tadde about weapon levels and safe refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我建議你去找塔德先生，聽聽他關於武器等級和安全精煉的講解。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你聽得懂嗎？他講得清楚嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just between us, there is a rumor that lots of employees complain about me.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
悄悄告訴你，有很多員工都在背後抱怨我。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I sent you there to monitor the situation.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我派你去那裡，就是為了讓你監視一下情況。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Welcome. The owner told me to explain to you about ^3E86C3the weapon levels^000000 and ^3E86C3safety refining.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
歡迎光臨。店主讓我向您解釋一下^3E86C3武器等級^000000和^3E86C3安全精煉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
In fact, it is better to get to know while questing yourself. But anyway if you have any questions, please ask to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
其實，自己在任務中瞭解會更好。不過，如果您有任何問題，請隨時問我。

scripts.text: Weapon level
scripts.translation: 武器等級

scripts.text: Safety refining.
scripts.translation: 安全精煉

scripts.text: Finish the question.
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Weapons have level, whereas Armors don't. The more ^3E86C3upscaled a weapon^000000 is, the higher the weapon level is.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器有等級，而防具沒有。武器^3E86C3升級^000000的次數越多，武器等級就越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
That means ^A20B09the upscaled weapons are more difficult to obtain.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這意味著^A20B09升級後的武器更難獲得^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Considering the customers coming to refine, the ones for refining level 1,2 weapons are more than those for level 3,4 weapons.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
就前來精煉的顧客而言，精煉1級、2級武器的人數多於精煉3級、4級武器的人數。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Safety refining differs from the levels of Armor or weapon, so basically each level has a ^3E86C3different safe upgrade level.^000000
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
安全精煉與防具或武器的等級不同，基本上每個等級都有^3E86C3不同的安全升級上限^000000。

scripts.text: Level 1 Weapon
scripts.translation: 1級武器

scripts.text: Level 2 Weapon
scripts.translation: 2級武器

scripts.text: Level 3 Weapon
scripts.translation: 3級武器

scripts.text: Level 4 Weapon
scripts.translation: 4級武器

scripts.text: Armor

scripts.text: Question finished

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[塔德]
1級武器精煉到^A20B09+7^000000是安全的。武器等級越低，可以安全精煉的數值就越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]

scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，它比1級武器有更強的效果。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]

scripts.translation:
[塔德]
2級武器精煉到^A20B09+6^000000是安全的，雖然安全精煉的數值比1級武器要低。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，它比1級武器有更強的效果。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 3 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+5^000000. Simply speaking, it looks like the safety refining goes down by 1 according to each weapon level.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
3級武器精煉到^A20B09+5^000000是安全的。簡單來說，隨著武器等級的提高，安全精煉的數值會依次降低1。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
The higher the weapon is, the increasing effect of +1 becomes higher as well.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器等級越高，+1帶來的效果提升也越大。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 4 weapons are safe up to ^A20B09+4^000000. Numbers of level 4 weapons are so rare that not so many customers bring them here.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
4級武器精煉到^A20B09+4^000000是安全的。4級武器非常稀有，很少有顧客會拿來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As it is one of the most luxurious weapons, the effect of refining is the strongest.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
作為最高階的武器之一，它的精煉效果是最強的。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Armors are safe when refined up to^A20B09+4^000000, just like a level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
防具精煉到^A20B09+4^000000是安全的，和4級武器一樣。

scripts.text:
