Oh dear...my apologies, but you don't have enough money.
I'm sorry we can't give it to you cheaper...we're only a small business.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
哎呀...很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
抱歉我們不能給您更便宜的價格...我們只是個小生意。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Er...please sorts your inventory before you take these...
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
呃...請整理一下您的物品欄，然後再領取這些...

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
This is what you wanted. Thank you very much!
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這是您想要的東西。非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Any questions about the weapon level and safety refining?
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
關於武器等級和安全精煉，您還有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Any questions about the weapon level and safety refining?
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
關於武器等級和安全精煉，您還有什麼問題嗎？
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text: Weapon level
scripts.translation: 武器等級

scripts.text: Safety refining.
scripts.translation: 安全精煉

scripts.text: Finish the question.
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Weapons have level, whereas Armors don't. The more ^3E86C3upscaled a weapon^000000 is, the higher the weapon level is.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器有等級，而防具沒有。武器^3E86C3升級^000000的次數越多，武器等級就越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
That means ^A20B09the upscaled weapons are more difficult to obtain.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這意味著^A20B09升級後的武器更難獲得^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Considering the customers coming to refine, the ones for refining level 1,2 weapons are more than those for level 3,4 weapons.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
考慮到前來精煉的顧客，精煉1、2級武器的比精煉3、4級武器的要多。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Safety refining differs from the levels of Armor or weapon, so basically each level has a ^3E86C3different safe upgrade level.^000000
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
安全精煉與防具或武器的等級不同，基本上每個等級都有^3E86C3不同的安全升級上限^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Safety refining differs from the levels of Armor or weapon, so basically each level has a ^3E86C3different safe upgrade level.^000000
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
安全精煉不同於防具或武器的等級，基本上每個等級都有^3E86C3不同的安全升級等級。^000000
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text: Level 1 Weapon
scripts.translation: 1級武器

scripts.text: Level 2 Weapon
scripts.translation: 2級武器

scripts.text: Level 3 Weapon
scripts.translation: 3級武器

scripts.text: Level 4 Weapon
scripts.translation: 4級武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Question finished
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 1 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+7^000000. The lower the level of weapon is, the higher the figure of the refining is possible.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
1級武器精煉到^A20B09+7^000000是安全的。武器等級越低，可以安全精煉的數值就越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，它比1級武器的效果更強。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 2 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+6^000000, even though refining figure is lower than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
2級武器精煉到^A20B09+6^000000是安全的，雖然安全精煉的數值比1級武器要低。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，它比1級武器的效果更強。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 3 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+5^000000. Simply speaking, it looks like the safety refining goes down by 1 according to each weapon level.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
3級武器精煉到^A20B09+5^000000是安全的。簡單來說，隨著武器等級的提高，安全精煉的數值會依次降低1。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
The higher the weapon is, the increasing effect of +1 becomes higher as well.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器等級越高，+1帶來的效果提升也越大。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 4 weapons are safe up to ^A20B09+4^000000. Numbers of level 4 weapons are so rare that not so many customers bring them here.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
4級武器精煉到^A20B09+4^000000是安全的。4級武器非常稀有，很少有顧客會拿來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As it is one of the most luxurious weapons, the effect of refining is the strongest.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
作為最奢華的武器之一，其精煉效果是最強的。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Armors are safe when refined up to^A20B09+4^000000, just like a level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
防具精煉到^A20B09+4^000000是安全的，和4級武器一樣。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As most refiners are used to making weapons it's hard for them to safely upgrade armors.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
大多數精煉師習慣製作武器，因此很難安全地升級防具。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
You look like you've had enough explanations about the safety refining.
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
看來您已經聽夠了關於安全精煉的解釋。
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
This is all I can explain to you.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這就是我能解釋的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
The explanations about the charge and effect of the safe refining will be covered by Mr. Locas.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
關於安全精煉的費用和效果，將由洛卡斯先生為您說明。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You are the one sent by the owner. What did he order me to do?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
你是老闆派來的。他讓我做什麼？

scripts.text: You have a lot of complaints, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你有很多抱怨，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Yes, I do. Absolutely, the owner will threaten me with his stupid performance ratings.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
是的，確實如此。絕對地，老闆會用他那愚蠢的績效考核來威脅我。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
He isn't the man he used to be.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
他已不再是以前那個人了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
He thinks if somebody leaves, a replacement will show up immediately.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
他認為如果有人離職，馬上就會有替補出現。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Anyway, the employee should do what the owner wants him to do... Ask me your questions.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
總之，員工應該做老闆想讓他做的事... 請問你有什麼問題。

scripts.text: Refining Price
scripts.translation: 精煉價格

scripts.text: Refining Effect
scripts.translation: 精煉效果

Perhaps the most important thing my owner thinks is this...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我認為老闆最看重的是這一點...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]

scripts.translation:

強化武器金屬-級數一是最常見的金屬，你可以從魔物身上獲得，也可以向塔德購買，價格是200 Zeny。

scripts.translation:

精煉3級武器需要^3E86C3神之金屬和10,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Oridecon is such a rare metal that I don't sell it... But,
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
神之金屬非常稀有，所以我並不出售...但是，

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If you have 5 Rough Oridecon obtainable from some monsters, you can refine them to make one Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果你收集到5個從某些魔物身上掉落的神之金屬原石，我可以將它們精煉成1個神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining level 4 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 20,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉4級武器需要^3E86C3神之金屬和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
鋁和神之金屬一樣稀有。如果你給我5個從某些魔物身上掉落的鋁原石，我會將它們精煉成1個鋁。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining the Armor requires ^3E86C3Elunium and 20000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉防具需要^3E86C3鋁和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
鋁和神之金屬一樣稀有。如果你給我5個從某些魔物身上掉落的鋁原石，我會將它們精煉成1個鋁。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You look like you've had enough explanations about the refining prices.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
看來你對精煉價格已經瞭解得差不多了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
I think you are now knowledgeable enough about refining.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我想你現在對精煉已經有足夠的知識了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Now I will explain to you about ^3E86C3the effect of refining^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
現在我要向你解釋^3E86C3精煉的效果^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
This time I won't give you explanations about individual items. It is better you do the physical experiences by yourself instead of verbal explanations.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
這次我不打算逐一解釋各個物品了。與其聽口頭說明，不如你自己去親身體驗一下。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Anyway, here are the explanations. From level 1 weapon,
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
總之，以下是說明。從1級武器開始，

scripts.text:
[Locas]
1 level weapon has ^A20B09the attacking power increased 2^000000 by each +1 refining. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
1級武器每次+1精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 2 ^000000。你明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Well???

[Locas]
I thought my explanations to you were easy, but it wasn't...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我以為我的解釋很簡單，看來並不是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
So, if you refine a knife with 17 attacking power and by +1, it will become 19 attacking power.. Like this.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
所以，如果你把一把攻擊力為17的刀精煉+1，它的攻擊力就會變成19。就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
In fact, there is no need to talk too much here. You just experience it later.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
其實，這裡不需要說太多。你之後親自體驗一下就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 2 weapon will add ^A20B093^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
2級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 3 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 3 weapon will add ^A20B095^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
3級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 5 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]

scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
最後，4級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 7 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Ah, I missed the Armor. The Armor can be add ^A20B091^000000 to the defense power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
啊，我忘了說防具。防具每次精煉，防禦力提升^A20B09 1 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Well, by now the explanations were only for the effect of the safe refining....
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
好了，到目前為止，我只解釋了安全精煉的效果...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You would better learn yourself ^A20B09the effect of over refining^000000 regardless of potential risk.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
關於^A20B09過度精煉的效果^000000，無論風險如何，你最好自己親自去了解一下。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If I tell you all the details, it is likely you start reading an epic novel of 10,000 pages, I'll tell you the ending of it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果我告訴你所有細節，那就像讓你讀一本一萬頁的史詩小說一樣。我就直接告訴你結局吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]

scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
有一點必須明確：如果你過於急切，要小心不要弄壞你的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Locas]

scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
看來你沒有什麼進一步的問題了。謝謝你聽我講這麼長的故事。

scripts.translation: 1級武器

scripts.text: Level 2 Weapon
scripts.translation: 2級武器

scripts.text: Level 3 Weapon
scripts.translation: 3級武器

scripts.text: Level 4 Weapon
scripts.translation: 4級武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Question Finished
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining of level 1 weapons requires ^3E86C3Phracon and 1000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉1級武器需要^3E86C3強化武器金屬-級數一和1000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
As Phracon is the most popular metal, you can get it from monsters but also from Tadde at 200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
強化武器金屬-級數一是最常見的金屬，你可以從魔物身上獲得，也可以向塔德購買，價格是200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining level 2 weapons requires ^3E86C3Emveretarcon and 20,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉2級武器需要^3E86C3強化武器金屬-級數二和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Emveretarcon is also a relatively popular metal. You can get it either from monsters or from Tadde at 1000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
強化武器金屬-級數二也是一種比較常見的金屬。你可以從魔物身上獲得，也可以向塔德購買，價格是1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining of level 3 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 10,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉3級武器需要^3E86C3神之金屬和10,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Oridecon is such a rare metal that I don't sell it... But,
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
神之金屬非常稀有，所以我並不出售...但是，

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If you have 5 Rough Oridecon obtainable from some monsters, you can refine them to make one Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果你收集到5個從某些魔物身上掉落的神之金屬原石，我可以將它們精煉成1個神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining level 4 weapons requires ^3E86C3Oridecon and 20,000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉4級武器需要^3E86C3神之金屬和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
鋁和神之金屬一樣稀有。如果你給我5個從某些魔物身上掉落的鋁原石，我會將它們精煉成1個鋁。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Refining the Armor requires ^3E86C3Elunium and 20000 zeny.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
精煉防具需要^3E86C3鋁和20,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Elunium is as rare a metal as Oridecon, like Oridecon, if you bring me 5 Rough Elunium obtainable from some monsters, I will refine them to make a Elunium for you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
鋁和神之金屬一樣稀有。如果你給我5個從某些魔物身上掉落的鋁原石，我會將它們精煉成1個鋁。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You look like you've had enough explanations about the refining prices.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
看來你對精煉價格已經瞭解得差不多了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
As I think it would be better for you to experience the effect of refining rather than explantion, I really give you a brief explanation about it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我覺得讓你親自體驗精煉的效果比聽我解釋更好，所以我只做簡要說明。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Let's start from level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
讓我們從1級武器開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
1 level weapon has ^A20B09the attacking power increased 2^000000 by each +1 refining. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
1級武器每次+1精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 2 ^000000。你明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Well???

[Locas]
I thought my explanations to you were easy, but it wasn't...
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
我以為我的解釋很簡單，看來並不是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
So, if you refine a knife with 17 attacking power and by +1, it will become 19 attacking power.. Like this.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
所以，如果你把一把攻擊力為17的刀精煉+1，它的攻擊力就會變成19。就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
In fact, there is no need to talk too much here. You just experience it later.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
其實，這裡不需要說太多。你之後親自體驗一下就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 2 weapon will add ^A20B093^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
2級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 3 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Level 3 weapon will add ^A20B095^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
3級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 5 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Lastly, level 4 weapon will add ^A20B097^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
最後，4級武器每次精煉，攻擊力提升^A20B09 7 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Ah, I missed the Armor. The Armor can be add ^A20B091^000000 to the defense power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
啊，我忘了說防具。防具每次精煉，防禦力提升^A20B09 1 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Well, by now the explanations were only for the effect of the safe refining....
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
好了，到目前為止，我只解釋了安全精煉的效果...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You would better learn yourself ^A20B09the effect of over refining^000000 regardless of potential risk.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
關於^A20B09過度精煉的效果^000000，無論風險如何，你最好自己親自去了解一下。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If I tell you all the details, it is likely you start reading an epic novel of 10,000 pages, I'll tell you the ending of it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
如果我告訴你所有細節，那就像讓你讀一本一萬頁的史詩小說一樣。我就直接告訴你結局吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
One thing to be clear is you should be careful about destroying your equipment if you get over-eager.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
有一點必須明確：如果你過於急切，要小心不要弄壞你的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Thank you for your listening to a long story. This is all I can explain you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
感謝您耐心聽我講完這個長故事。這就是我能告訴您的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Regarding the levels of weapons and safety refining, consult with Mr. Tadde. He will kindly answer to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
關於武器等級和安全精煉的問題，請諮詢塔德先生。他會樂意為您解答。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome. Welcome to the enchant association. I am ^142CEBMounds^000000- head of Izlude branch of the Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎光臨。歡迎來到附魔協會。我是^142CEB蒙茲^000000——附魔協會依斯魯得島分部的負責人。

scripts.text: Oh... a cat can speak???
scripts.translation: 噢...貓會說話？？？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you never seen a talking cat?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您從沒見過會說話的貓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There is an island called ^FD4F02Malangdo^000000 where only cats live and I am from there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
有一個叫^FD4F02馬拉格多^000000的島嶼，那裡只有貓居住，我就來自那裡。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There are cats like me who can speak the human language very well, but some cats speaking human and cat language are a mess.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
像我這樣能流利說人類語言的貓是有的，但也有些貓說話時人類語和貓語混在一起，亂七八糟的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, that can be checked in Malangdo later are you interested in ^FD4F02Enchantments^000000?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
嗯，這些以後去馬拉格多島就能確認了。您對^FD4F02附魔^000000感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Enchant Association?
scripts.translation: 附魔協會？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The Enchant Association is the group made by those of us who can enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
附魔協會是由我們這些能進行附魔的人組成的團體。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This association is composed of two divisions of ^FD4F02the socket enchant division^000000 and ^FD4F02the hidden enchant division^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這個協會由兩個部門組成：^FD4F02插槽附魔部^000000和^FD4F02隱藏附魔部^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您是不是對這兩個部門都感到好奇？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您是不是對這兩個部門都感到好奇？
[蒙茲]
您沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text: Socket Enchant?
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔？

scripts.text: Hidden Enchant
scripts.translation: 隱藏附魔

scripts.text: Question finished
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You are curious about the socket enchant.. Here is the explantion.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您對插槽附魔很好奇... 這裡是相關說明。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
From unknown reason, There has been existing ^FD4F02card slots^000000 on the equipments obtainable from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
出於未知的原因，從魔物身上獲得的裝備上一直存在^FD4F02卡片插槽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
People started to question, 'Can we make a device to insert cards to these?'
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
人們開始質疑：“我們能製造出一種裝置，把卡片插進去嗎？”

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
At last, one day a man called ^142CEBSeyablem^000000 showed up with the technology of socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
終於有一天，一位名叫^142CEB塞亞布勒姆^000000的人帶著插槽附魔的技術出現了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Nobody knew how he got the technology....
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
沒人知道他是怎麼獲得這項技術的....

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Someday later, a younger brother of Seyablem called ^142CEBLeyablem^000000 introduced a different device from his brother to socket enchant other equipments.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
後來有一天，塞亞布勒姆的弟弟^142CEB雷亞布勒姆^000000出現，他帶來了一種與哥哥不同的裝置，用於為其他裝備進行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many people using the brothers' socket enchanting services, they stole the technology
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
許多使用兄弟倆插槽附魔服務的人，偷走了這項技術。

scripts.text: Ok seems simple enough...
scripts.translation: 嗯，聽起來挺簡單的...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The brothers happened to join the enchant association. And from time to time, they teach the technology to us in Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
兄弟倆恰好加入了附魔協會。時不時地，他們會把這項技術傳授給我們在馬拉格多的人。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Learning the technology diligently, some day will come when others can do socket enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
只要認真學習這項技術，總有一天，其他人也能進行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah, my story went off topic.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊，我的故事跑題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, conclusion is this, socket enchant means to add a card socket to the common equipment being sold at any shops.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
總之，結論就是，插槽附魔是指在商店出售的普通裝備上新增一個卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is called socket enchant. Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這就叫插槽附魔。你對其他分支好奇嗎？
[蒙茲]
你沒有更多問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah ! Are you curious about the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊！你是對隱藏附魔好奇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
OK. First, I have to let you know how the hidden enchnat skill was born.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
好的。首先，我得告訴你隱藏附魔這項技能是如何誕生的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The original inventor was looking for a way to unlock the 4th slot of a 3 slotted weapon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
最初的發明者一直在尋找一種方法，來解鎖3插槽武器的第4個插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
So he studied the technology to make use of the remaining slot.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
於是，他研究瞭如何利用剩餘插槽的技術。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When the study was finally successful he taught it to his apprentices and was never heard from again.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當研究最終成功時，他把技術傳授給了學徒，然後便杳無音訊了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
His technology reinforced the equipment with a gem that had special properties similar to monster cards.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
他的技術是用具有類似魔物卡片特殊屬性的寶石來強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
That technology has been developed and improved to make the current ^FD4F02Enchant association ^000000
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這項技術經過開發和改進，形成了現在的^FD4F02附魔協會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Briefly speaking, to make a stronger equipment with a special enchantment is the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
簡而言之，通過特殊附魔來製作更強大的裝備，就是隱藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你對其他分支好奇嗎？
[蒙茲]
你沒有更多問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你沒有更多問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Later, if you want to experience the hidden enchant or socket enchant, I will give you a hand.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
以後，如果你想體驗隱藏附魔或插槽附魔，我會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome.. Ah, we've met before right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎...啊，我們以前見過，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you coming to experience the hidden enchant or the socket enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你是來體驗隱藏附魔，還是插槽附魔？

scripts.text: I am just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過

scripts.text: Came to experience it.
scripts.translation: 來體驗一下

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You may be on the way to Prontera. Be careful and come back.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你可能是要去普隆德拉吧。路上小心，歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You want an experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你想體驗一下。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The experience course starts from the experience of the simple socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
體驗課程將從簡單的插槽附魔開始。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
For this, you need material. Will you buy a cotton shirt at Izlude Armor shop?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
為此，你需要材料。你會去依斯魯得島的防具店買一件棉襯衫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the cotton shirt, we will immediately start ^FD4F02the socket enchnat experience^000000 course.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當你帶來棉襯衫時，我們將立即開始^FD4F02插槽附魔體驗^000000課程。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Oh this is a socketed shirt already!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
哦，這件襯衫已經有插槽了！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It must be a plain cotton shirt.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
必須是一件普通的棉襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the plain cotton shirt from the Armor shop, we will start the socket enchant experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當你從防具店帶來一件普通的棉襯衫時，我們將開始插槽附魔體驗。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Bring us the normal shirt without holes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
請帶來一件沒有孔洞的普通襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Not like all other enchants, the socket enchant is being worked without items installed.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
與其他附魔不同，插槽附魔是在未鑲嵌任何物品時進行的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, let's start the socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
那麼，讓我們開始插槽附魔吧。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！二！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have suceeded in socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你成功完成了插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the equipment? It now has an empty slot in it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你檢查過裝備了嗎？現在它上面有一個空的插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
But, like this time the success rate is not always ^FD4F02100%^000000 as you are still in the studying phase.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
不過，就像這次一樣，成功率並不總是^FD4F02100%^000000，因為你仍處於學習階段。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Please keep in mind that there always risks of failure and if failed, the equipment will be broken.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
請記住，失敗的風險始終存在，如果失敗，裝備將會損壞。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If you want to know more about the socket enchant, go and consult with Leyablem or Seyablem who are working at Prontera or Payon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
如果你想了解更多關於插槽附魔的資訊，可以去普隆德拉或斐揚諮詢正在那裡工作的蕾亞布姆或塞亞布姆。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Now it's time for your experiencing the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
現在，是時候體驗隱藏附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Equipped with the just socket enchanted cotton shirt, get the hidden enchant from
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
穿上剛剛完成插槽附魔的棉襯衫，去那裡找負責隱藏附魔的貓阿爾蒙德 J 進行隱藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Almond J, the cat in charge with the hidden enchant over there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
阿爾蒙德 J 是負責隱藏附魔的貓，就在那邊。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Get the hidden enchant from Almond J with wearing the cotton shirt socket enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
穿著完成插槽附魔的棉襯衫，去找阿爾蒙德 J 進行隱藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? You came earlier than expected? I though it might take time after listening to all the explanations.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咦？你來得比預期早啊？我以為聽完所有解釋後，你會花點時間呢。

scripts.text: Explain about the situation.
scripts.translation: 解釋一下情況

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Keuh~~ It happened....
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咳~~ 發生了...意外...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I should beware of you, when you were making a big noise to do the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
我本該提防你的，當你大聲喧譁著要做隱藏附魔的時候。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Anyway, I am sorry.. Though it is short, I will make the explanation for you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
總之，我很抱歉...雖然時間很短，但我會為你做個簡短的說明。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你檢查過隱藏附魔了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我聽過。

scripts.text: No. I haven't.
scripts.translation: 沒有，我還沒檢查

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
既然你已經檢查過了，我的說明就簡單多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hmmm. Recommend you examine the condition of your cotton shirt, opening item window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
嗯。建議你開啟物品視窗，檢查一下你的棉襯衫的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
既然你已經檢查過了，我的說明就簡單多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I explained you just before, the hidden enchant is the work to insert to weapoon or Armor a gem with a special option into the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
正如我剛才解釋的，隱藏附魔是將帶有特殊選項的寶石插入武器或防具的操作。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you know it, if you checked, you may notice something new was at the no. 3 and 4 slots at the bottom of item information window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
如果你檢查了，可能會注意到物品資訊視窗底部的第3和第4插槽出現了新的變化。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant is being proceeded with the similar equipment worn as Almond J's.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隱藏附魔的過程與阿爾蒙德 J 使用的類似裝備的操作方式相同。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Of course, there are some other places to do the hidden enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當然，還有其他地方可以進行隱藏附魔。

scripts.text: Satisfied.
scripts.translation: 滿意

scripts.text: A little short.
scripts.translation: 有點短

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is fortunate. Do you have any experience to be added? If so, please write it to me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
真是幸運。您有什麼經驗想要補充嗎？如果有，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Experience seems not be satisfactory with you. Can you write me what was it?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
看來您對經驗值不太滿意。能告訴我具體是什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I will refer it for planning the next experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
我會參考您的意見，以便規劃下一次的體驗。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your valuable advice.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
感謝您寶貴的建議。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your patience listening to my boring explanation.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
感謝您耐心聽我這些枯燥的解釋。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This is a small gift hoping your continuous support for our enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這是一份小禮物，希望您能繼續支援我們的附魔協會。

scripts.text: Received the explanation about the enchants, some experience and Kafra storage free coupon.
scripts.translation: 收到了關於附魔的說明、一些經驗值和卡普拉倉庫免費券。

scripts.text: Received the explanation and Kafra free storage coupon.
scripts.translation: 收到了說明和卡普拉倉庫免費券。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
那麼，我們下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome to the enchant association. I am Mounds - head of Izlude branch of Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎來到附魔協會。我是蒙茲——附魔協會依斯魯得島分部的負責人。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? Your appreance is familiar. Have we met before?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咦？你的樣子很眼熟。我們以前見過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I can't remember all the people I met as they are too many, strangely you have a face not to forget.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
我見過的人太多，記不全所有面孔，但奇怪的是，你的臉讓我很難忘記。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Perhaps, are you here to learn about enchanting? I will kindly explain you about it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
也許，你是來了解附魔的？我很樂意為你解釋一下。

scripts.text: Socket enchant
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔

scripts.text: Hidden enchant
scripts.translation: 隱藏附魔

scripts.text: Give regards
scripts.translation: 致意

scripts.text: No questions at all.
scripts.translation: 沒有問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Socket enchant is the skill to make card slots appear in Weapon or Armor.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
插槽附魔是一種讓武器或防具出現卡片插槽的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you meet the Seyablem and Leyablem brothers around the towns of Rune-Midgarts they can help you with this service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當你在盧恩·米德加茲的城鎮中遇到塞亞貝爾姆和萊亞貝爾姆兄弟時，他們可以為你提供服務。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If they fail to put a new slot in your item say farewell to it...
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
如果沒能成功新增新的插槽，那就只能和它說再見了...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It's usually a good idea to have more than 1 item to add a slot to because it can fail a lot sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
通常建議準備多於一件要新增插槽的物品，因為有時候失敗率很高。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant means to put enchanted gems into the hidden slots of an item.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隱藏附魔是指將附魔寶石鑲嵌到物品的隱藏插槽中。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have to be wearing the item that is being enchanted as it uses the wearers fortune as the success rate.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你必須穿戴著要附魔的物品，因為成功率取決於穿戴者的運氣。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many places are providing the various hidden enchant service in different ways, if you have time, please visit one of them.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
許多地方都以不同的方式提供隱藏附魔服務，如果您有時間，請去其中一家看看。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
News? Enchant association doesn't have a big issue going on.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
新聞？附魔協會目前沒有發生什麼大事。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah!! I remember that Almond J sent with me from Izlude branch wanted to do advertising...
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊！！我想起來了，阿爾蒙德 J 從依斯魯得島分部派來的人想做廣告...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
He drafted the initiative for the free service of hidden enchant to the beginner's weapons. I approved it as it looked a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
他起草了為新手武器提供免費隱藏附魔服務的提案。我覺得這是個好主意，所以批准了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
What? If you have a beginners weapon, it may not hurt to try it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
什麼？如果你有一件新手武器，不妨試試。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me whenever you have a question about the enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
如果您有關於附魔協會的任何問題，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一定發生了什麼奇怪的事情。如果這種情況持續下去，請聯絡客服。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 由於您的物品欄已滿，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hello, I am Almon J of the enchant association.~
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
你好，我是附魔協會的阿爾蒙德 J。~

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
If you have anything to do with the enchant association, please consult with Mounds inside.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
如果您有關於附魔協會的事情，請諮詢裡面的蒙茲。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Welcome.. I have been waiting for you. Are you coming for the hidden enchant service on your cotton shirt?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
歡迎...我一直在等您。您是來為您的棉襯衫做隱藏附魔服務的嗎？

scripts.text: Ench? Whatis?
scripts.translation: 附魔？什麼？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Eummm?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Oh... finally you came...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
哦...您終於來了...

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Has your ^142cebCotton Shirt[1]^000000 been equipped? Shall we start now? Ready?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
您的^142ceb棉襯衫[1]^000000裝備好了嗎？我們現在開始嗎？準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: You look excited.
scripts.translation: 你看起來很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh... is that so? Frankly, it is my first time... I am really excited.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿...是嗎？說實話，這是我第一次...我真的好興奮。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Are you ready? Yes? Do it now. Now!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
準備好了嗎？是的？那就開始吧。現在！！

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 開始隱藏強化！！

scripts.text: Wait for a while.
scripts.translation: 稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh? Eh? Hik?! Come here quick.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿？啊？什麼？！快過來。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Please come back after you have equipped the Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
請先裝備好棉襯衫再回來。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hing, it is not a normal Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
聽好了，這不是普通的棉襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Now!! Start the first hidden enchant!! Start!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
現在！！開始第一次隱藏強化！！開始！！！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！

scripts.text: Wow, that was quick.
scripts.translation: 哇，好快。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？你不覺得隱藏強化很棒嗎？要不要再來一次隱藏強化？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
真好玩。我想再來一次。嘿，再試一次好嗎？啊啊啊！！我想再做一次隱藏強化。

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你漸漸沉浸在自己的世界裡了。你最好回到蒙茲那裡去。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？你不覺得隱藏強化很棒嗎？要不要再來一次隱藏強化？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
真好玩。我想再來一次。嘿，再試一次好嗎？啊啊啊！！我想再做一次隱藏強化。

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你漸漸沉浸在自己的世界裡了。你最好回到蒙茲那裡去。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh heh... how are you? I am doing a ^142CEBservice of free hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon to advertise the enchant association.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿嘿...你好嗎？我正在為新手武器提供^142CEB免費隱藏強化服務，以宣傳強化協會。^000000

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
一定發生了什麼奇怪的事情。如果這種情況持續下去，請聯絡客服。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
As you are still a beginner, you don't have a very, very, very functional jewelry, but soon you will have.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
既然你還是個新手，你還沒有非常、非常、非常強力的首飾，但很快你就會有的。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Will you try the hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon free of charge?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？要不要免費嘗試新手武器的隱藏強化？

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 開始隱藏強化！！

scripts.text: What weapons are you enchanting?
scripts.translation: 你在強化什麼武器？

scripts.text: Just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ah!! Weapons? Hehehe.. I didn't explain it to you enough.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
啊！！武器？嘿嘿嘿...我好像沒跟你解釋清楚。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
The weapon to be serviced with the free hidden enchant has the ^FD4F02Novice^000000 name in front of the weapon.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
享受免費隱藏強化的武器，其名稱前會有^FD4F02初心者^000000的標識。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
^FD4F02For Novices-
Cutter, Mace, Rod, Axe, Etc.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
^FD4F02適合初心者-
短劍、鈍器、法杖、斧頭等。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ye?!?!?!?!?!
Where are you going? You should do the hidden enchant before going.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
耶？？？？？？？！
你要去哪？你應該先做完隱藏強化再走啊。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hehehe... hidden enchant makes me excited. But you should come back with your weapon armed.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿嘿...隱藏強化讓我很興奮。但你得帶著武器回來才行。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! ^142cebthe Novice Knife^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
沒錯！！^142ceb初心者短劍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! The ^142ceb{0}^000000.

[Almond J]
Ehee.. It is not a Novice Weapon. Leaving this expensive weapon to us and if broken... I'm not taking that chance.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
呃...這不是初心者武器。把這麼貴的武器交給我們，萬一壞了...我可不敢冒這個險。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
But this weapon might be strange to add a hidden enchant? Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
但這把武器可能不適合加隱藏強化？抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is a good weapon Then!! Let's start the hidden enchant!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
這是一把好武器！那麼！！開始隱藏強化！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
As I'm too excited, I can't check the options. Please check it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！
我太興奮了，沒法檢查選項。請你自己檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Repairing broken equipment!! If you have broken equipment, bring it to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理破損的裝備！！如果你有破損的裝備，隨時可以拿來給我。

scripts.text: Repair it.
scripts.translation: 修理它。

scripts.text: Nothing to be repaired now.
scripts.translation: 現在沒有需要修理的。

scripts.text: What is repairing?
scripts.translation: 什麼是修理？

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
You must treat your equipment carefully... as you don't have anything to be repaired.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
你必須小心對待你的裝備...因為你沒有需要修理的東西。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Hmmm... let's see... oh.. hmm...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嗯...讓我看看...哦...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
------------------------
Damaged Equipment Estimate
Damaged Equipment: ^FF0000{0}^000000
Fee: ^0000FF{1} Zeny^000000
------------------------
Would you like to proceed with the repair?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Well, I don't care. After all, it's not my equipment. However, leaving equipment unchecked is not a wise choice.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
好吧，我不在乎。反正又不是我的裝備。不過，讓裝備保持破損狀態可不是明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair cost is 5000 Zeny per damaged equipment. You do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理費用是每件破損裝備5000 Zeny。您的錢不夠。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair has been completed. Be sure to take good care of your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理已完成。請務必好好保養您的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
If you don't have any equipment to be repaired, you may not have something to talk with me about.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
如果您沒有需要修理的裝備，那您可能沒什麼事要找我。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
A specific skill or boss monster could break your equipment frequently.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
某些特定的技能或Boss魔物可能會頻繁損壞您的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
This doesn't mean that your equipment is gone forever like what happens during refining.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
這並不意味著您的裝備會像精煉失敗那樣永遠消失。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
When your item breaks this way, they won't perform normally...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
當您的裝備以這種方式損壞時，它們將無法正常使用...

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
In this case, bring it to me, and I will repair it back to new at the cost of 5000 zeny for each equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
在這種情況下，請把它帶給我，我會以每件5000 Zeny的費用將其修復如新。

scripts.text:
[Training Instructor]
The training grounds have been revised.
I will send you to Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[訓練指導員]
訓練場已經翻新。
我將送您去依斯魯得島。
